# LIFE PATH MASTER NUMBER 11 – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2024/09/26/life-path-master-number-11/#content)

**Your Soul Life Path is the total of your birth day, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit (unless it is a Master number 11, 22, 33, 44 etc).**

**It describes the direction your life will take, what challenges you will encounter, and the opportunities you will come across. It tells you what your life journey will look like and how you connect with the outside world.**

**There are magnetic forces that draw various vibrations, events, and circumstances throughout your life, and all of these are influenced by your soul life path number.**

**Hello and welcome, I am Sara Bachmeier. The author of** _**[“Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the Fifth Dimension,”](https://www.amazon.com/Egyptian-Numerology-Emergence-Fifth-Dimension/dp/150439657X)**_ and [_**“The Path of a Wounded Healer; Liberation is for the Asking.”**_](https://www.amazon.com/Path-Wounded-Healer-Liberation-Asking/dp/1982266465)

**Your path is created from the sound off the eternal drum of life the moment we are born. The drum is symbolic of the circle of life representing vitality, wholeness,** **completion, perfection****, the sacred void, Alpha & Omega, the ouroboros of reincarnation, the infinite representation of Source. And although it is beyond time and space, the closest we can imagine being present within this circle would be a feeling of unconditional love. The fifth dimension is a state of love and light that some would refer to as nirvana. This is your natural state of being, without the concept of time and space.** 

**The personified energetic blueprint you create through the birthing process is called your resonance frequency. It is the vibration the Universe recognizes to ignite the fires of your living breath, burning a path that forges and sets the direction for your life’s mission.**

 **I believe that we all were originally born out of the center of this sacred zero and decided to experience and express life through the numeric vibrations of our birth dates and names. Everything involving numbers starts and ends with the number zero.**

**LEARN MORE – BE MORE** @ 

[www.egyptiannumerology.org](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)

**MASTER NUMBERS**

One of the biggest conceits in numerology is the idea that being a master number is somehow better than being any one of the other numbers. It is also a myth to think that the master number is luckier, more powerful, or has an easier time of life than other numbers.

If anything, the path of a master number is more karmic than others because they often must transcend more difficulties than other numbers to excel in the first place. As many of them are original thinkers, they end up working alone or find themselves in a position to defend ideas against a hostile majority.

They deal with obstacles that would daunt the stoutest of hearts, including physical disabilities, mental afflictions, and very mean childhoods. The truth is that you chose a master number and all the karmic hardships in this lifetime so you could overcome these difficulties and help heal the world in these specific areas.

In a master number, the lower number will be the dominating number in the first part of your life and can continue to be the dominating number if you choose not to utilize the higher number after maturity.

The problem with not moving forward into a  
master number vibration is often a lingering feeling of being stuck. Physical ailments caused by the resistance to move forward can result in depression if ignored for a long period.

The higher part of a master number will be activated during the second part of your life (forty years or older). You may feel the undercurrents of this number starting at a young age, but the actual power and abilities belonging to the master number won’t mature until you do.

  
I am not talking just about physical maturation but also the growth processes necessary to activate the higher frequencies; these must coincide with emotional and spiritual evolvement as well. Until then, you will be working the lower part of the master number for  
a good reason: it serves as a precursor to the lessons and challenges you will need to learn and overcome as necessary tools for the progress of evolving into the higher frequencies.

Almost all master numbers 11/2s and 22/4s experienced exceptionally painful, turbulent childhoods and must use these experiences to make a world a better place because of it and not in spite of it. All master numbers are endowed with many powers from within, significant strengths, and many more challenges not available to single-digit numbers.

They normally realize early in life that they have the capacity to accomplish a great deal with relatively little effort. They contain superpowers hidden within the number frequencies of their birth charts, specifically their soul life path numbers. They are here to obtain personal power and spiritual evolution but most of all to be healers for the wounded because they have survived the wrath of being a wounded healer.

**MASTER NUMBER 11**

Individuals that carry Master Number 11/2 in their Birth Chart will be under the influence of the Number two for the first portion of their lives. The power and magic of the eleven is not fully activated until the age of 40 or older.

The attributes of intuition, illumination, inspiration and imagination will be an underlining magnet which drives these people to conquer their challenges and achieve their goals with a driving force of determination, strength and conviction beyond the average human experience.

They often will not be aware of what this force is in its totality, but something keeps their fires lit until their life purpose is finally awakened within them. Until then, they can become restless, depressed, and bored with mundane daily life because they know deep down that they are here to make an enormous contribution to mankind.

What isn’t always clear as they travel their path, is that they must learn and achieve the lessons from the number two before they can evolve into the dynamic energy that the eleven has to offer.

This is so important because the universe will continually bring them opportunities to learn these lessons, and these can often be painful. Attaining the lessons within the number two is the prerequisite for entering into the higher energy from the number 11.

You simply cannot jump past these lessons and land into your Divine Path and Purpose because the understandings and perceptions that you need to adopt lie within the power of the number two and the wisdom contained from obtaining these lessons.  

So, what are these lessons? What has your life been trying to teach you? Mostly it can be found within relationships. Specifically, Love relationships.

If you are not in a Love relationship, then it could be found in your occupation when dealing with others such as co-workers, clients, colleagues, family members and anyone in your life that you come in frequent contact with.

Co-dependency will be a major lesson that needs to be overcome. You absolutely must learn to love yourself first and then communicate with others through compassion, forgiveness, and acceptance.

A part of overcoming codependency is choosing to develop and balance your masculine and feminine qualities. If you are out of balance, you will tend to seek those qualities you are lacking in your potential partners and by doing this, you depend on another person to fulfil you rather than seeking wholeness within yourself.

These lessons are not meant to be easy. The path of the Master Number 11/2 demands that you rise above the mundane and earn your badge as the illuminator. Your path was never meant to be a smooth flowing river but rather raging white water that forges valleys and canyons.

You cannot carry a victim consciousness on your travels while holding the cards of a Master Number. You need to take full responsibility for everything that you are attracted to in your life and involved in from the moment of conception and sometimes beyond.

The biggest challenge you will have to face will be the absolving of judgement. This is in the realm of self and others. Get rid of it. It will not serve you in this lifetime.

If you really want to get into alignment with your Soul Life Path and Purpose, you need to step up and do some inner work. Remove old disappointments, resentments, and traumas. You cannot take these into your new life with a Master Number 11. 

You have already been living the undercurrents of the number eleven all your life. But now as you mature, the higher energies of the master number become stronger. The electrical current starts pulsing from spirit to your mind and through your heart and can even enter your dreams with messages. 

In sacred geometry, the eleven symbolizes two pillars. One is illumination and the second is intuition and when these two energies are aligned, they bring forth dynamic manifestation abilities. Illumination is the gateway to divine connection for the answers to all your questions, and intuition is the portal to the hall of wisdom/knowledge.

You are visionaries, channels, teachers, artists, healers, psychics, clairvoyants, and prophets. You elevate the planetary frequency through your own healing process, and when you share your creative services with the world, you expand and multiply the vibration of peace, love, and understanding. You had a calling for humanitarian service at a young age, and if you are true to your path, you will reap an abundance of joy in return for all your hard, selfless work.

Duality and merging polarities is the process belonging to the frequency of the number two. The eleven symbolizes the potential to push the limitations of the human experience into the stratosphere of the highest spiritual perception: the link between the mortal and the immortal, between humans and spirit, darkness and light, ignorance and enlightenment. This is the ultimate symbolic power of the eleven. 

You are here to use your gifts of sensitivity, spiritual awareness, visionary insights, inspiration, charisma, inventive ideas, imagination, originality, and deep thinking to help others learn to rely on their faith rather than their logic in all of life’s situations. 

The master number eleven is called the illuminator, messenger, or the teacher and relates to those who are here to be inspirational guiding lights. Their soul life paths are to bring Illumination to others and to help raise spiritual awareness in our world.

# SACRED MEANING OF NUMBERS IN EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2024/07/22/sacred-meaning-of-numbers-in-egyptian-numerology/#content)

As I began to tap into the energy of our new calendar month, I received a pertinent download from my guides regarding the origin within the meaning of numbers.  

I was shown that the ancient meaning of numbers often coincides directly with our seasons, astrology, and the natural world we live in. As a Numerologist, I have become increasingly sensitive to the signs, symbols, and synchronicities of the Universe. When a random message downloads into my stream of thought, I listen.  

Hello and welcome, I am Sara Bachmeier from Egyptian Numerology. I am the author of [**_Egyptian Numerology; emergence into the Fifth Dimension”_**](https://www.amazon.com/Egyptian-Numerology-Emergence-Fifth-Dimension/dp/150439657X)
 and [**_“The Path of a Wounded Healer; Liberation is for the Asking.”_**](https://www.amazon.com/Path-Wounded-Healer-Liberation-Asking/dp/1982266465)

As I started working on this article, it made perfect sense how the meaning and vibrations of numbers correlate strongly from our human interactions with the Universe. I wondered if the meaning of numbers could be influenced by several natural occurring factors.  Have you ever wondered where the definition of numbers originally came from? I am only speculating from what resonates with what I have learned and observed through being an Egyptian Numerologist. I am going to share with you what I found.

For example, January is the number 1 month in our calendar year. In traditional or classic numerology, the number one is referenced as meaning new beginnings, opportunity, and welcoming prosperous changes into our lives. It is a motivator energy, sign of power, and conviction that can lead to a better life. This is also the energy that is associated with the celebration of beginning the New Year. It makes perfect sense that the New Year in January, which is a number 1 calendar month and the numeric version of the meaning of number one both have qualities that reflect each other. Is this a coincidence?

Or do they have the same meaning because the origin came from our projections often associated with the New Year?  It makes me wonder if the ancient philosophers and numerologists used the natural world to resonate their beliefs around numbers.

Egyptian numerology taps into the higher vibrations of numbers and although the classic meaning of numbers will always stand true for those that are on that level of consciousness, there is always going to be ongoing interpretations that move with the new energy of higher awareness.

Egyptian Numerology refers to the number one as a symbol of unity with the higher realms. Due to its shape, it resembles a straight line or antenna giving it the power to serve as a spiritual conduit and direct link to the spirit realm.

It is a symbol of alignment to our true and original nature. 

Number 2 has many meanings but the classic numeric definition of this energy centers around love, balance, friendship, peace, and relationships. February is the number 2 calendar month which coincides with Valentines Day. Although there are many stories around the origin of this holiday, we know that it was somewhere in the 15th century that it was officially celebrated.

In the higher octaves of energy, the number 2 represents the balance of polarities. It symbolizes the marriage of opposites where we understand that one cannot exist without the other. Here we are encouraged to seek true balance with the yin/ yang, negative/ positive, and dark/ light aspects of our personality.   

The number 3 characteristic principles are aligned with the astrological sign of Pisces. This entails unparalleled access to the element of water and the collective unconscious through the psychic gift of clairvoyance. This is the energy of creativity, self-expression, and is the artist archetype. 

The number three in Egyptian Numerology refers to the alignment with the sacred trinity of body, mind, and heart. The divine current that runs through the spiritual channels of intuition, creativity, and expression.   

Do you see where I am going with this information? 

It makes sense that ancient philosophers and numerologists relied on the natural wisdom surrounding their environment. By doing this, they displayed the concept that everything is connected. 

Let’s keep going. The number 4 in traditional numerology is represented as a methodical energy, foundational stability, solid, and from prehistoric times, the number four was employed to signify what was solid, what could be touched and felt in the physical world.  Additionally, the number 4 embodies practicality, structure, and hard work.

In Egyptian Numerology the number 4 represents the importance of sacred order and universal laws. 

It symbolizes the four major elements of our planet air, fire, water, and earth. It refers to the 4 seasons, 4 directions, 4 weeks in a month, and 4 times of the day. 

It is seen as spiritual structure and the foundational energy of our universe. 

May is the Universal number 5 month, bringing change, adaptation, and adventure but it also reflects our season of springtime where nature is in full bloom, creating the colorful symphony of rebirth in the many shades of the prism found in a rainbow. 

Many people take advantage of this season by traveling, spring cleaning, and tapping into their natural motivation to grow into a bigger and better version of themselves. 

In Egyptian Numerology, we use the Phoenix symbol to demonstrate the transformation of our spiritual power, growth, and personal freedom embedded in the 5 energies. 

The number 6 gets its reputation of love, marriage, and domestic characteristics from the month of June when many people plan their weddings. 

Not being a person tied to society traditions, I looked further into this energy. I found that the number 6 lays its foundation in the heart chakra where we discover the 3 chakras’ below and 3 chakras’ above. It is from this energy body that we connect with the spirit realm, ascended masters, and healing powers. 

The number 6 embodies its wisdom from love but not just human love, it is the energy of Universal love as well. 

Onto the mystical and magical number 7. This energy is closely associated with the astrological sign and characteristics of Cancer. 

This number seven is believed to carry the characteristics of insight, intuition, truth, introspective, intellectual, and wisdom. 

Cancer is a cardinal water sign and is represented by the crab. This oceanic creature flawlessly weaves between the sea and shore. This points to the ability to exist in both emotional and material realms simultaneously. 

This organic feature displays the magical and mystical powers of the number 7. It reflects the union of intellectual and intuitive marriage. 

This energy also coincides with our life cycles. Our first physical natural cycle represents the first 7 years of our lives. 

Nature exhibits the intriguing cycles of the number 7, from the seven colors in a rainbow, 7 major chakras, seven wonders of the natural world, and the 7 Hermetic principles of our lives. 

Number 8 is widely known as the abundance number. It is found in the calendar month of August when the beginning of harvesting the annual crops begins. 

It is the symbol of “plenty.”

People relied on the harvest to carry them through the winter months. 

It is the infinity number when laid on its side representing the life cycle absent of beginnings and endings. It is the representation of reincarnation, karmic cycles, and our link from earth to the heavens.

Our last single digit number is number 9. In traditional numerology, this energy refers to completion. Not only the completion of a numeric cycle, but the completion of the agricultural cycle as well. September is the number 9 calendar month, and the last harvest of the year is celebrated. 

In terms of spiritual significance, we find many attributes associated with the number 9. 

It refers to endings or death, as one might transpose this even further to describe the end of one’s life. Many cultures attach spiritual significance to the number nine qualities such as forgiveness, enlightenment, completion, compassion, and higher consciousness representing the self-discovery that comes at the end of each cycle of life.  

This energy is often associated to an advanced state of consciousness where we find higher wisdom, humanitarian services, and a deep connection to nature. The meaning of the number nine is very similar to the number seven. They are both important life cycles that hold the universal intelligence of personal growth and ascension. It is an altruistic energy representing the attributes of a master, shaman, priest, or healer.

Master numbers are literally the higher manifestation of the single digit numbers. If we were to go further in this investigation, we would correlate that October number 1 calendar month doubled is the master number 11/2. November numeric calendar month doubled is 22/4, and December calendar month of the number 12 doubled is the master number 33/6.

So, there you have it. If you are inspired to understand the meaning of numbers, it is important to observe the connection we have to our planet and the universe as One. There are always great mysteries around numbers, but the energy found in the numeric system is closely linked to the Universe we live in. The secret to Egyptian Numerology is to open your mind and heart to the sacred evolution of our human desire to ascend higher into the dimensions that are opening for us.

To fully embody the greater mysteries and magic of life, go beyond the physical world and touch the hand of Spirit.

I hope you resonated with this article. Let me know your thoughts in the comments below. Make sure you subscribe to Egyptian Numerology to get our Newsletters @ [www.egyptiannumerology.org](http://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)

 And if you want to learn more about your personal journey, [**_schedule a private reading._**](https://app.acuityscheduling.com/schedule/ff0b1a04)
 I also have a [**_pre-recorded beginning course available._**](https://egyptiannumerology.me/whenoptin1)

I would love to connect with you.

_Thank you, and Namaste’,  Sara_

# LIFE PATH 5 IN EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2024/08/21/life-path-5-in-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**Your soul life path is the total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit. It describes the direction your life will take, what challenges you will encounter, and the opportunities you will come across. It tells you what your life journey will look like and how you connect with the outside world. There are magnetic forces that draw to you various vibrations, events, and circumstances throughout your life, and all of these are influenced by your soul life path number.**

**Hello and welcome, I am Sara Bachmeier. The author of _[“Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the Fifth Dimension,”](https://www.amazon.com/Egyptian-Numerology-Emergence-Fifth-Dimension/dp/150439657X)_** and [**_“The Path of a Wounded Healer; Liberation is for the Asking.”_**](https://www.amazon.com/Path-Wounded-Healer-Liberation-Asking/dp/1982266465)

**Your path is sounded by the eternal drum of life the moment we are born. The drum is symbolic of the circle of life representing vitality****, wholeness, completion,  perfection,** **the sacred void, Alpha & Omega, the ouroboros of reincarnation, the infinite representation of Source. And although it is beyond time and space, the closest we can imagine being present within this circle would be a feeling of unconditional love. The fifth dimension is a state of love and light that some would refer to as nirvana. This is your natural state of being, without the concept of time and space.** 

**The personified energetic blueprint you create through the birthing process is called your resonance frequency. It is the vibration the Universe recognizes to ignite the fires of your living breath, burning a path that forges and sets the direction for your life’s mission. I believe that we all were originally born out of the center of this sacred zero and decided to experience and express life through the numeric vibrations of our birth dates and names. Everything involving numbers starts and ends with the number zero.**

**LEARN MORE – BE MORE** @ 

[www.egyptiannumerology.org](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)

**LIFE PATH NUMBER FIVE**

_This is the number of adventure and freedom. It is  a very sensual number and reminds us to enjoy life, try new experiences, and seek out physical pleasure. This number is also connected to experiencing life changes (such as marriage, divorce, new careers ) and making important choices._ 

_In Egyptian Numerology, the Number Five works with Spirit through transformation using the rising of the Phoenix and Fire healing energy to transmute lead into gold meaning transposing our challenges into possibilities._ 

_Motivation burns like a fire in your soul and can create restlessness deep down in your subconscious, leaving you with a sense of urgency when it is not directed. Transformation is also a fire element and a friend to the number five who takes the time to learn how to activate its powers._ 

_You are highly intuitive, clever, and wise and with all of your talents, we may find you in the occupation of being a healer, adventure guide, artist, or teacher._

_You express yourself best through the movement of energy. You are often blessed with numerous talents and abilities and have the potential to sustain a couple of careers at once. Number five individuals have the ability to adapt and change freely, as they are free spirits who have a sense of adventure and curiosity about life. They have the desire to expand their horizons and gain insights into the lifestyles of other cultures, as they have a talent for finding a common ground with nearly everyone they meet and are easy-going._

_Number 5 is the Spirit element of Aether. When Aether is your Spirit Element, it gives you access to all 4 elements and the gift of transformation._ 

_Observing the synchronicity of Number 5 having 5 letters & the word Fire also contains 5 letters._

_The power of the life path number Five can feel like a tornado of energy swirling around you; untamed, ferocious, and sometimes destructive. It is advisable to learn how to “Be” in the eye of the tornado and this is done through meditation and living in the present moment.  You won’t be productive if you get swept up in chaos, but if you remain calm and centered, you can harness your intuition and move forward with grace and ease._

_One last message from the Number Five is Personal Freedom._ _Speak your Truth without the fear of being judged. Allow yourself to pursue your dreams or even to experience appreciation without attachment._

_Whatever it means to you, explore the direction of personal freedom. Follow where it leads you and express yourself uninhibited. Dare to search out unfounded territory within yourself. Break some boundaries, tear down some walls, and challenge yourself to reach new goals._

_You are never too old to learn something new or undo something old that doesn’t fit us anymore._

90 Day Mastery Program with Egyptian Numerology. Mark Twain

Egyptian numerology is a philosophy and a way of life that promotes daily clarity, spiritual direction, and soul purpose.

There are specific life path numbers in Egyptian Numerology that reveal your Soul status as an old soul, wounded healer, empath, and spiritual leader. 

It helps you to remember why you came here and if you are following your “calling.”

I will give you a glimpse into what your personal numbers can achieve through your higher self. That is why my book is called “Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the 5th Dimension.”

Those who are following a path of self-awareness can feel the difference. Many of us have been getting glimpses of the 5th Dimension consciousness as it pulls us inward to follow our heart and dreams. 

But we don’t quite trust it yet. Egyptian Numerology provides a bridge between worlds. It carries us safely through the corridors of time and space. It helps us understand who we are and where we are going. 

Egyptian Numerology is predictable, progressive, honest, and true. 

Our Soul Life Mission is encoded in our chosen birth date, time, name. It reveals our Soul Life Path, Purpose, and Destiny and so much more. Egyptian Numerology is timeless, valuable, and leading information that is readily available for us to tap into at any time.

# 2026 YEAR OF ALIGNMENT – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2025/12/31/2026-year-of-alignment/#content)

The first thing I want to acknowledge are your efforts and hard inner work that the energy of 2025 released for us to work with. For many people the Universal 9 year was difficult and not one to be repeated. And I want to thank you for your continued patronage to Egyptian Numerology throughout the year.

The blessings in disguise were the spiritual trinity portals.  The past three months, October, November, and December granted us the 1010, 1111, 1212, and 1221 Solstice ascension codes that allowed some much-needed grace by which to end the year. These activations have been building a powerful numeric and energetic momentum leading up to the official transfer from a 9 universal year to a number one Universal year starting January 1. These ascension codes helped to elevate our vibration, and when our energy is raised, we create more exciting opportunities.

Hello and Welcome, I am Sara Bachmeier with Egyptian Numerology. I am the leading Egyptian Numerologist in North America and Have published 2 books. “Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the Fifth Dimension” and the “Path of a Wounded Healer; Liberation is for the Asking.”

We officially end a Universal number 9 year of 2025 and enter the Universal energy of the number 1 for 2026 on January 1st. 

Although it is official on our calendar, this energy has been slowly building since the autumn/ spring equinox last September 22. 

On January 1st, the energetic numeric momentum solidifies into its full power and emerges into the folds of your life creating a rising pressure used to enhance the areas of your life that you are most focused on.

The transfer of a Universal 9 to a 1 energy does not happen overnight. We are currently integrating everything the 2025 offered us in the way of spiritual growth and evolution. 

There is a natural “downtime” going on right now. We will continue to experience the ebb and flow tides of collective numeric energy throughout the first few weeks of the new year. 

Most of us are energetically psyched to start a new cycle. So, what does that mean for us and our spiritual journey? In this article, I don’t want to bombard you with information regarding the number one energy for 2026. I want to show you how this energy works and how to best apply it to your life. As with all spiritual wisdom, you are not learning new information, you are given keys to unlock your memory.

As you may have suspected, the old paradigm for numbers will keep you locked into the matrix.  Egyptian Numerology does not follow the ordinary and traditional matrix of numbers. It breaks open the confining walls of third dimension reasoning and opens your soul to a more cohesive understanding of numeric energy that aligns with Spirit.  

It is easy to fall for the fluffy slogans often found associated with the number one like New Beginnings, leadership, individuality, and unity. These are standard terms that you can find on almost every numerology website or source of information. We have crossed the threshold of old paradigms concerning what the number 1 means to us today. The number one isn’t about going somewhere new. We are not going to a new location, a so-called higher dimension in the clouds but rather, we are revealing our true origin towards divinity. It is a process of becoming, a connection, and a calling. 

I am not saying that those qualities don’t apply to us today, I mean that there is so much more, not in quantity but in quality. Look deeper because if you are on a spiritual journey, you have already mastered the basic understanding of the number one and our now merging into a higher paradigm where we can put these qualities to use in a more constructive and spiritual way.

To understand and work with the number 1 this year, we explore the raw energy and properties associated with this esoteric numeric symbol. Since this is the first year in the next 9-year cycle, it sets the direction for everything coming into your life as a result.  

The chasmic meaning for the number 1 this year is _“Alignment, Innovation, Interdependence, and enhanced intuition or Insight on steroids.”_

This year, On January 1, we enter a new universal year with the angel numbers 111 aligned and ready to serve you. 

January is a number 1 calendar month, with a number 1 calendar day and 2026 is a number 1 universal year. When aligned, it becomes angel numbers 111. 

The number 1 energy of 2026 is a masculine and grounding energy. It reflects our physical body, life force, vitality, our connection to the planet Earth, and how to be deeply rooted in our purpose, but fluid in our expression.

In my book, “Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the fifth dimension” It refers to the number one as related to the color red, grounding, root chakra, inspiration, and the kundalini awakening. This is important to know because our physical body needs to adjust to a higher frequency and it all starts at our root chakra.

Dragons are a spirit animal for the number 1. Ask the dragons from the four directions to purify an ignite your vital life force and awaken your Kundalini.  

The symbol of the number 1 is a straight unbreakable line projecting the qualities of alignment. This could be interpreted as many things but I like to imagine that in its higher state, it refers to becoming aligned with the areas of your life that bring you joy. 

The areas of Alignment that make this possible is of our mind and our heart, our God self and our shadow self, our masculine and feminine nature, and the earthly realm with the spiritual realm.

A good way to find a baseline with where you are in alignment with your ascension process is to reflect on what alignment means to you. How is it significant in your life today? What spiritual alignment have you already achieved and what still needs to be aligned? 

When you see the number is 111 this year, know that you are in the process of coming into alignment. 

The second term in the analogy of 111 this year is “innovation.”

Although for decades, we have we have been in the process of building new systems within ourselves which are then reflected in the outside world, it is vital that we continue our efforts in this department. 

In the process of being innovative, we will often make perceived mistakes or need to make necessary adjustments along the way because this is just part of the process of creation. 

Innovation requires trust in divine timing, letting go of control, and flowing where your vision is taking you. 

A simple definition of innovation means introducing something new (an idea, method, product, or service) that creates value, solves a problem, or makes something better, going beyond just invention to actually applying it successfully in the real world. 

It’s about fresh thinking leading to real-world impact, whether it’s a small improvement to your daily life or a major change. 

Applying an innovative style to your life can be as simple as rearranging your daily routine to include an original workout, joining a new group, or starting a new course. You can add new spiritual tools for study and practice, or improve the quality of food you consume, exercise, books, and movies. Anything that inspires or calls to you. 

The third quality associated with the number 1 is the highly advanced and important energetic quality of interdependence. 

For several decades, the spiritual journey has taken us through learning about and overcoming codependency and gaining independence. All of our efforts in these areas primes us to become interdependent. 

A sidenote is that interdependence can only be reached and practiced through mastering the paradigms of codependency and independence. 2026 leads us to developing interdependence in our relationships, occupations, family, and friends. 

What it looks like in our relationships is that we no longer believe that love equals two half people merging into one. In other words, two half people do not make a whole. 

Interdependence is rhythmic dance between two people who hold their center in alignment with their core truth and compliment the other through the even ebb and flow of give and take without expectations of changing the other or feeling like you need the other person to make you feel complete.

Interdependence is two independent people coming together with understanding, respect, compassion, and a vision of creating a beautiful dance or waltz that unfolds step-by-step.

We will be seeing two independent people or companies coming together to create a higher vision. This type of relationship will not come easy to those who have relied on a power struggle process based on unworthiness.

It will take practice, mistakes, stepping on each other’s toes, and learning when to take the lead and when to follow.

Interdependence is the state of mutual dependence, where two or more people, groups, or things agree to rely on each other for success, or to meet their needs. This means that each contributes something – creating a balance in a give-and-take relationship. 

The final quality interpretation for the number 1 is enhanced intuition or achieving insight on steroids. This occurs when you begin to live a more intuitive life rather than logical one.

We must learn when to follow our intuition and when to respect logical decisions. 

This happens when you start tracking signs, symbols, synchronicities, and learn how they interact with your spiritual progress. What is spirit, your subconscious mind, or higher self trying to show you when a deer crosses your path on your way home, when you find a crow feather on your way to work, when you continually see digital numbers appear throughout your day or week, or when the same topic shows up in a conversation, a song, or while reading a book. 

I’ve had a long time saying that if the same thing appears in my field three times in a row over a short period of time, that means I need to pay attention.

Learn to acknowledge and give yourself credit when your intuition is on target. Write it in your journal, or a note card where you can see it daily. 

This year, believe that everything that happens including fate chances belong to the law of destiny. Cultivate your eyes to see it, a mind to accept it, and a heart to own that everything is magical, necessary, and important.  

Fate is the idea of a powerful, unavoidable force or destiny that predetermines everything that happens in life, making outcomes inevitable. It’s what’s “ordained” or “spoken by the gods,” suggesting a destiny beyond human control, often involving chance and fortune. 

The providence of 2026 depends on how determined you are to make a difference with the qualities offered under the umbrella of a number 1 Universal year. I hope that I have given you some examples that will escort your progress and make it the best year ever. 

Let me know if you resonate with this information by liking, sharing, subscribing, and commenting below. 

Learn more about Egyptian Numerology on my website at [egyptiannumerology.org](http://egyptiannumerology.org/)
 or join our community Facebook group @ [https://www.facebook.com/groups/egyptian42828](https://www.facebook.com/groups/egyptian42828)

You can now learn how to use Egyptian numerology including the calculations and definitions through several online options I’ve posted on my website. Check it out. 

I wish all of you a very Blessed and Grateful new year!

**_Namaste’ Sara Bachmeier_**

# Egyptian Numerology; Number Sequences 111 – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2018/12/02/egyptian-numerology-number-sequences-111/#content)

111 or 11:11 – Wake-Up call, Activation Code, or Awakening code

_It is certainly a magical sign. 111 is a sign that the Universe is communicating with you. At the moment you see this sequence, a mystical portal is opening for you to pass through. Look around and pay attention to where you are, what you are thinking, and who you are with. This is a cosmic connection that you are moving in the right direction._

Eleven is a Master Number and an expression that signifies a spiritual path. When 1’s are doubled or multiple 1’s appear on your path, it is a confirmation that you serve the light and have the ability to uplift the consciousness of humanity.

The Number 1 is a direct conduit from the physical realm to the spiritual. It reminds you that you are a powerful creator through the use of your thoughts, beliefs, intentions and actions. It is a confirmation that you are aligned with your truth.

The multiple 1’s serve as an energetic gateway that opens for you to manifest your thoughts into reality. The message encourages you to choose your thoughts wisely, ensuring that they match your true desires. At this time, do not put energy focusing on your fears, but instead set your intentions on your highest vision and truth to ensure manifesting them into your life.

It could also clarify that an opportunity is currently unfolding and you are creating at the speed of light. The Universe has just aligned with your intentions, ideas, thoughts, and beliefs helping you to manifest your experiences into reality.

Keep open to what will serve your highest good and move forward with confidence.

# WHO IS YOUR AUTHORITY? – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2023/11/11/who-is-your-authority/#content)

**When you uplift your energy field, you tap into your _Inner Being_. It is this self that becomes your true authority.**

**It resonates with the higher beings, and you will intuitively know if the information you are receiving is authentic. This is the power greater than yourself, and when it flows through you, all that is not true simply disappears. All that is not of the light and truth of Source will fade away, and your higher self becomes one with all, the Universe.**

**Your Inner Being has many names and is one with all the guides, angels, and ascended Masters. So, when I ask who your authorities is, I am asking who your Higher Power is? And by what name does this force show itself through you? How are you prepared to receive it?**

**Your higher Source/Authority cannot be another man or woman. That just doesn’t make sense. That would mean that somehow you were made inferior in comparison to others, and that isn’t possible. We are all made equal in the eyes of Source and humankind.**

**Think about it. _“Ye are Gods, honor yourself above all others”_ is an affirmation given to support our third chakra. I believe that Source speaks through other people, places, and things, and I am grateful to be open to all things possible**.

**As humans, we share knowledge, education, and ideas, but we don’t share each other’s power. We can empower others through our own experiences and abilities, but we don’t create power; we receive it. If we don’t create it, then we don’t have the authority to take power away from others, even if it is only in perception. True power and knowledge comes from the source of the Holy Spirit.**

**Men and women wrote the books I read on numerology, but I believe the source of their knowledge had to come from higher transmissions. We are all just channels pulling information out of the ether and mixing it with practical experience and education. Don’t take things for granted; always question your authority. And while you are asking questions, start becoming your own channel.**

**How do you know if you are experiencing your life on the fifth dimension? You will know because you will not be reacting from a place of fear. You will be flowing from what I call your _“higher heart,”_ which is located above your beating heart in the location of your thymus gland. I call it the home of compassion, gratitude, and trust.**

**This dimension cannot be understood through the mind; it needs to be experienced and felt on a vibration of _“knowing.”_**

**This “knowingness” is clairaudience, (the superpower to hear) and is said to exist beyond the reach of ordinary experience or capacity. It becomes awakened within us. This is a heightened ability that we all have, and it becomes increasingly progressive every time we activate our superpowers.**

‘**Thank you for your ongoing support. Your** **contribution is appreciated and helps me to keep this website live and the information you receive up-to-date with the most current information.**” Sara Bachmeier

# LIFE PATH 9 WITH EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2024/09/09/life-path-9-with-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**Your Soul Life Path is the total of your birth day, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit (unless it is a Master number 11, 22, 33, 44 etc).**

**It describes the direction your life will take, what challenges you will encounter, and the opportunities you will come across. It tells you what your life journey will look like and how you connect with the outside world. There are magnetic forces that draw to you various vibrations, events, and circumstances throughout your life, and all of these are influenced by your soul life path number.**

**Hello and welcome, I am Sara Bachmeier. The author of _[“Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the Fifth Dimension,”](https://www.amazon.com/Egyptian-Numerology-Emergence-Fifth-Dimension/dp/150439657X)_** and [**_“The Path of a Wounded Healer; Liberation is for the Asking.”_**](https://www.amazon.com/Path-Wounded-Healer-Liberation-Asking/dp/1982266465)

**Your path is created from the sound off the eternal drum of life the moment we are born. The drum is symbolic of the circle of life representing vitality, wholeness, completion,  perfection, the sacred void, Alpha & Omega, the ouroboros of reincarnation, the infinite representation of Source. And although it is beyond time and space, the closest we can imagine being present within this circle would be a feeling of unconditional love. The fifth dimension is a state of love and light that some would refer to as nirvana. This is your natural state of being, without the concept of time and space.** 

**The personified energetic blueprint you create through the birthing process is called your resonance frequency. It is the vibration the Universe recognizes to ignite the fires of your living breath, burning a path that forges and sets the direction for your life’s mission. I believe that we all were originally born out of the center of this sacred zero and decided to experience and express life through the numeric vibrations of our birth dates and names. Everything involving numbers starts and ends with the number zero.**

**LEARN MORE – BE MORE** @ 

[www.egyptiannumerology.org](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)

**LIFE PATH NUMBER NINE**

Life Path number nine points to a life of fulfillment.  Wisdom, self-examination, enlightenment, and achieving higher consciousness are all qualities associated with number nine. It is connected to one’s higher purpose and ultimate life mission; this number encourages you to take a bird’s eye view of your life.

Egyptian Numerology recognizes the number 9 as a walker of integrity and light. It is the vibration of the light warrior and their true source of power comes from receiving the sacred initiation of forgiveness and compassion through completing their souls journey. 

The number nine relates to wisdom and responsibility, and their ultimate goal is to serve humanity. This vibration has come to serve the world and make it a better place for all to live in. They look for solutions in the form of inspiration, intuition, and creativity. They are psychic, sensitive, and thoughtful people who understand other people’s experiences because they have gone through many challenges and are equipped to offer empathy, support, love, and encouragement. 

The energy of the number nine carries a visionary and insightful path into the Universal higher laws of life and self-mastery.  It is often the path of the priestess, priest, shaman, and the Druid.

When nine appear in your path, you have come to earn a completion. This is why forgiveness, compassion, integrity, justice, higher wisdom, and selfless service may have been important to you. They are all tools needed for your ascension to the next level of your existence.

 Being a wounded healer may be necessary for you to overcome challenges you consented to before your birth. You have a tendency to be a recluse or entertain a hermit lifestyle mainly because inherently you don’t want to accumulate more drama/karma. Those who walk the path of the number nine gift the world with sage wisdom and incredible kindness, reminding us that by allowing our own divine light to shine, we can change the world.

# ACHIEVEMENT NUMBER SEVEN      EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2020/10/02/achievement-number-seven-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**ACHIEVEMENT NUMBER**

**_Our Achievement Number introduces the energy used to manifest everything we need to follow our path, pursue our passions and forge forward to achieve our Destiny. We calculate this placement by adding our Birth month to our Birth date and reducing the total to a single digit unless it is a Master Number_**.

**_I often describe our Achievement number in relation to our Soul Urge Number because both numbers in our chart describe our unique gifts, abilities, talents and potential._**

**_Our Soul Urge number is calculated through our “Day of Birth” and is responsible for bringing us opportunities to develop our unique qualities needed to succeed on our path, purpose, and destiny.  I describe our Soul Urge Number as the whisper or breath of life that entered our body the moment we are born. It is the frequency of who we are in Spirit, manifesting vibrational form._**

**_This frequency is how we view the world, affects how we think and forms our perspectives revealing how we go about bringing our “Inner Light” to others creating beneficial and fulfilling relationships. This is the frequency that we create from._**

 **_Our Achievement Number is like the wind behind our breath. It is about movement, inspiration and motivation. It shows us how we act and when to act. It is the driving force behind our expression and how we conduct our essential selves._**_**It is the flame of inspiration that gets us really moving on projects or the objects of our desire. It is the frequency we use to pounce on new opportunities and how we go about delivering our unique messages to the world.**_

   **_Our Achievement number is responsible for bringing us the energy and momentum needed to fulfill our life journey. Both work side by side to strengthen our desire to move forward and onward with our lessons & blessings._**

**_Achievement Numbers describe our personal power. It is what fuels our motivation in life. It is the force within us we call upon to pull us out of the trenches when the sky is dark and there is no one else around to save us. It is the vehicle we use to uplift our spirits and raise our vibrations in meditation to reach the state of nirvana. This frequency is how the outside world perceives us and our fallback character when we think no one is looking. Our achievement number is also called our “attitude number” and has been a driving force in our lives ever since we took our first breath of air, and it continues to mature throughout our lifetime._**

 **_Like all the numbers, its potency is contingent on our energy level. The higher we vibrate, the stronger it works for us, and the gifts and talents of this number continue to bear fruit and support us. If our frequency is low, it continues to challenge us and serves as a reminder to up our game. All our challenges are opportunities for growth, so the lower our frequency, the more challenges we encounter. This is a Universal Law, and it plays out beautifully in the vibrational force of numbers._**

 **_All we need to do is witness what happens to us when we choose to have a loving perspective versus a hateful one in any given situation, on any day, and at any moment. It is used as a barometer to measure the level of energy we are using. When our attitude takes a turn for the worse, we instantly attract negative energy and circumstances. How many more challenges do we encounter when we start the day on the wrong side of the bed? How many blessings do we attract when we begin our day in silent contemplation, gratitude, and compassion? This is how our achievement/attitude Number works. It is our choice. Do we want to work with it or against it?_**

**_It is in direct alignment with our Soul life agreement meaning that when we determined our souls mission before incarnation, we reviewed this information with our Spirit Guides and Angels and asked ourselves, “ What energy or force will I need within me to accomplish these things?”_**

**_The influence of our Achievement number guarantees that when we are focused on our mission, we have all that it takes to complete what we came here to do._**

**_Understanding our Achievement number gives us the opportunity to align with forces enhancing the outcome of any situation. We have special gifts that we can use to achieve the greatest possible outcome in any situation with confidence. We were born with this magic power to be productive to survival but most important it serves as the dynamic strength toward our success._**

**_When we embracing our Soul Urge and Achievement Numbers, we combine forces that ultimately drive us toward an opening beyond our wildest dreams. As with all the number frequencies, the higher our energy level, the more powerful these forces become._**

**_Knowing and understanding these numbers in our chart act as the driving force that improves the quality of our lives, attracts prosperity, nurture relationships, build careers and accelerate spiritual growth._**

**ACHIEVEMENT NUMBER – SEVEN**

**_You were born into higher wisdom, and celebrate an open mind filled with knowledge, curiosity, and wonder. You have a direct link to spirit and other worldly realms keeping you occupied and fascinated in your alone time. You fear no one could possibly understand your secret world of fantasy, so you keep to yourself and hold your imagination safe in your pocket of dreams._**

**_You love to learn about the holy mysteries, metaphysics, paranormal and planetary enigmas, and will research these topics endlessly. Somewhere deep down, you know you are a true mystic and seeker of our Universe._**

**_You have a kinship with the wilderness and elemental spirits. Nature in its true form will never deceive you, and it is here that you practice, trust, and love freely. You are attracted to people who share your passions, and you are always searching for a twin survivor._**

# EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY; SOUL URGE NUMBER THREE – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2019/10/26/egyptian-numerology-soul-urge-number-three/#content)

**VISIT EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY WEBSITE @ [www.egyptiannumerology.org](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

**WHAT IS A SOUL URGE NUMBER?**

**_Your Soul Urge Number is your exact Day of Birth in Egyptian Numerology. It is often referred to as your Character Number and reveals your_** **_gifts, talents, Souls Passion. It works directly with your Soul Life Path Number by influencing particular challenges for you to overcome and talents to develop._**

**This number shows you what your soul is urging you to accomplish in this lifetime. It exposes the gifts, abilities and full potential of the talents you were born with that will most prominently guide your life path in this incarnation. Knowing, developing, and using these character traits to strengthen your path will clear the way for your purpose to reveal itself.**

**_The best way to utilize your Soul Urge Number is by being able to determine your natural gifts and turn your strongest challenges into your Greatest Strengths. Your Soul Urge Number is directly related to your Soul Life Path Number and offers your highest opportunity toward happiness and abundance._**

Y**our Soul Urge number is active from the moment you draw your first breath of air and stays as the dominating energy featured in your life until the age of 36. After the age of 36, your Destiny frequency merges into place making it important to develop your abilities, talents and gifts before this time. You were born with these qualities and they are meant to be developed in order to navigate your path, purpose and destiny.**

**SOUL URGE NUMBER THREE**

**“MESSENGER”**

“**Communication, Joy, Sensitivity, and Self-Awareness**“

**_The expression of the three connects man and woman to a Higher Source, and this is called the Holy Trinity. The power of the triangle is unstoppable when the current of all three numbers are connected. The number one is the conduit and demonstrates the ever flowing current of life, the number two symbolizes the sacred balance of man and woman, and the number three invites Source to direct your way of life._**

_**The number three represents the divine**_ **_principle underlining the course of life such as; mind/body/spirit, birth/life/death, beginning/middle/end, past/present/future, maiden/mother/crone._**

**_The number three is divine expression in all communication._**

**_The messenger has a special gift through channeling Higher Source and delivering this energy through communication. When you are connected to Spirit and centered in your heart, you offer the world an opportunity to receive higher wisdom. We rely on your gift to keep us centered and_** **_aligned with the power from the higher realms._**

LEARN MORE:

In Egyptian Numerology, there are 3 major Numeric calculations that reveal your innate gifts, talents, and potential. These specific attributes were chosen by you before birth to support you on your Soul Life Path and journey. When you discover, align, and develop these Super-Powers, you are on the road to becoming your very own Inner Hero. These powers are a part of you and will lay dormant until activated. # SOUL URGE NUMBER TWO       EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2019/10/18/egyptian-numerology-soul-urge-2/#content)

**Website @ [http://www.egyptiannumerology.org](http://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

**SOUL URGE NUMBER**

**Your Day of Birth is your Soul Urge Number. I describe your Soul Urge Number as the whisper or the breath of life that entered your body the moment you are born. It is the frequency of who you are in Spirit, manifesting  physical vibrational form.  This number helps you create and enhance the direction of your life and gives you the freedom of choice to stay  in integrity with your authentic self. It reveals how you go about bringing your “Inner Light” to others to create beneficial and fulfilling relationships.**

**_This is the frequency that we create from._**

**Your Soul Urge number is referred to as your character number. It reveals your personality traits, character behaviors, and your soul’s passions.  It is the chief instigator to the challenges you encounter or the enhancement associated with your Life Path number.** 

**This energy affects how you view the world, it colors your thinking process and helps you form your unique perspectives of life.** 

**This number shows you what your soul is urging you to accomplish in this lifetime. It exposes the gifts, abilities and full potential of the talents you were born with that will most prominently guide your life path in this incarnation. Knowing, developing, and using these character traits to strengthen your path will clear the way for your purpose to reveal itself.**

**Utilizing these numbers in your chart act as the driving force to improve the quality of life, attract more prosperity, nurture relationships, build careers, and accelerate your spiritual growth.**

**Your Soul Urge number is active from the moment you draw your first breath of air and stays as the dominating energy featured in your life until the age of 36. After the age of 36, your Destiny frequency merges into place making it important to develop your abilities, talents and gifts before this time. You were born with these qualities and they are meant to be developed in order to navigate your path, purpose and destiny.**

**SOUL URGE NUMBER TWO**

**BALANCE = Duality, Beauty, Peace, and Creativity**

_**Balance between polarities of yin and yang, dark and light, and good versus bad is crucial for the advancement in consciousness for these people. The world relies on the balance of this matrix to assure that peace is possible in our world. Your ability to pursue and maintain a Divine connection allows you to be a mediator in spiritual affairs. This balance holds Two pillars standing side by side; one is creativity, and the second is beauty.**_

_**These people are easy-going, peace-loving souls who desire to create a sense of beauty in our world. The number two requires the absence of judgement while obtaining and holding a perspective of equilibrium to serve the betterment of humanity.**_ 

_**You were born with psychic tendencies and sensitivity to the energies around you. When you use your finer subtleties in nature to support your peace of mind and heart, you reflect your intention outward** **enhancing love and respect in our world.**_

In Egyptian Numerology, there are 3 major Numeric calculations that reveal your innate gifts, talents, and potential. These specific attributes were chosen by you before birth to support you on your Soul Life Path and journey. When you discover, align, and develop these Super-Powers, you are on the road to becoming your very own Inner Hero. These powers are a part of you and will lay dormant until activated. # EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY; SOUL URGE NUMBER 18 – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2020/03/06/egyptian-numerology-soul-urge-number-18/#content)

**SOUL URGE NUMBER**

**_Your Soul Urge Number is your exact Day of Birth in Egyptian Numerology and is used to describe your Character Behavior, Souls Passion and Personality traits. It is the chief instigator to your life’s challenges and is associated with your Life Path Number._** **_This frequency is what your Soul has been “Urging” you to accomplish in this lifetime_**.

**_I describe your Soul Urge as the whisper or breath of life entering your body the moment you were born. It is the frequency of who we are in Spirit while manifesting vibrational form. This is where we view the world, it affects how we think and helps us form our unique perspectives. Understanding our Soul Urge helps us to examine the roles we play in life and why. When in sync with this vibration, we can avoid obstacles and begin to use our innate gifts & strengths to navigate our path. It is what makes us rare in group settings and can trigger how we behave or approach relationships in general_**.

**_It helped me perceive and respect the value that I bring to the table in everyday situations and it is the underlying mechanism of my thought and emotional process. I can better design my life in terms of my approach to all circumstances when I aware and using my unique gifts and potential_**.

**_The frequency of this number helps us create the direction of our Soul Life Path and gives us the freedom of choice while staying in integrity with our authentic self. It reveals how we go about bringing our “Inner Light” to others to create beneficial and fulfilling relationships. This is the frequency we CREATE from_**!

**_As with all the number frequencies, the higher our own energy level is maintained, the more powerful these forces become. Knowing and understanding these numbers in your chart will act as the driving force that can improve the quality of life, attract prosperity, nurture relationships, build careers and accelerate your spiritual growth_**.

**SOUL URGE NUMBER 18 – PRIEST/ PRIESTESS**

**18 – Priest/Priestess = Intuition, Selfless Service, Awareness, and Flow/Resource**

**_Solid in your foundation of spiritual oneness, leadership qualities surface to be explored. You have the gift of channeling higher wisdom, and it flows through you as a powerhouse of energy when you become quiet, self-forgetting, and focused. This resource is needed to heal the sick, teach the young, and save the innocent as you stand ready to deliver selfless service for the good of all humankind._**

**_These people demonstrate a strong presence and aptitude of loving surrender when they forge their creativity on a single topic of discovery. Their passion can seem forceful but their inner drive is steered with confidence and sacred vision, not always understood by others. When they are connected with integrity, they are the ones you want to be standing behind in the front-lines of progress._**

**This information and more is available in my book “_Egyptian Numerology; Emergence Into the_ _5th Dimension_”. To learn more, visit my Website; [https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

**WRITTEN BY SARA BACHMEIER**

# ACHIEVEMENT NUMBER FIVE EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2020/09/18/achievement-number-five-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**ACHIEVEMENT NUMBER**

**_Our Achievement Number introduces the energy we use to manifest everything we need to follow our path, pursue our passions and forge forward to achieve our Destiny. We calculate this placement by adding our Birth month to our Birth date and reducing the total to a single digit unless it is a Master Number._**

**_I often describe our Achievement number in relation to our Soul Urge Number because both numbers in our chart describe our unique gifts, abilities, talents and potential._**

**_Our Soul Urge number is calculated through our “Day of Birth” and is responsible for bringing us opportunities to develop our unique qualities needed to succeed on our path, purpose, and destiny.  I describe our Soul Urge Number as the whisper or breath of life that entered our body the moment we are born. It is the frequency of who we are in Spirit, manifesting vibrational form._**

**_This frequency is how we view the world, affects how we think and forms our perspectives revealing how we go about bringing our “Inner Light” to others creating beneficial and fulfilling relationships. This is the frequency that we create from._**

     **_Our Achievement Number is like the wind behind our breath. It is about movement, inspiration and motivation. It shows us how we act and when to act. It is the driving force behind our expression and how we conduct our essential selves._** _**It is the flame of inspiration that gets us really moving on projects or the objects of our desire. It is the frequency we use to pounce on new opportunities and how we go about delivering our unique messages to the world.**_

   **_Our Achievement number is responsible for bringing us the energy and momentum needed to fulfill our life journey. Both work side by side to strengthen our desire to move forward and onward with our lessons & blessings._**

**_Achievement Numbers describe our personal power. It is what fuels our motivation in life. It is the force within us we call upon to pull us out of the trenches when the sky is dark and there is no one else around to save us. It is the vehicle we use to uplift our spirits and raise our vibrations in meditation to reach the state of nirvana. This frequency is how the outside world perceives us and our fallback character when we think no one is looking. Our achievement number is also called our “attitude number” and has been a driving force in our lives ever since we took our first breath of air, and it continues to mature throughout our lifetime._**

 **_Like all the numbers, its potency is contingent on our energy level. The higher we vibrate, the stronger it works for us, and the gifts and talents of this number continue to bear fruit and support us. If our frequency is low, it continues to challenge us and serves as a reminder to up our game. All our challenges are opportunities for growth, so the lower our frequency, the more challenges we encounter. This is a Universal Law, and it plays out beautifully in the vibrational force of numbers._**

 **_All we need to do is witness what happens to us when we choose to have a loving perspective versus a hateful one in any given situation, on any day, or at any moment. It is used as a barometer to measure the level of energy we are using. When our attitude takes a turn for the worse, we instantly attract negative energy and circumstances. How many more challenges do we encounter when we start the day on the wrong side of the bed? How many blessings do we attract when we begin our day in silent contemplation, gratitude, and compassion? This is how our achievement/attitude Number works. It is our choice. Do we want to work with it or against it?_**

 **_It is in direct alignment with our Soul life agreement meaning that when we determined our souls mission before incarnation, we reviewed this information with our Spirit Guides and Angels and asked ourselves, “ What energy or force will I need within me to accomplish these things?”_**

**_The influence of our Achievement number guarantees that when we are focused on our mission, we have all that it takes to complete what we came here to do._**

**_Understanding our Achievement number gives us the opportunity to align with forces that enhance the outcome of any situation. We have special gifts that we can use to achieve the greatest possible outcome in any situation with confidence. We were born with this magic power to be productive to survival but most important it serves as the dynamic strength toward our success._**

 **_When we embracing our Soul Urge and Achievement Numbers, we combine forces that ultimately drive us toward an opening beyond our wildest dreams. As with all the number frequencies, the higher our energy level, the more powerful these forces become._**

 **_Knowing and understanding these numbers in our chart act as the driving force that improves the quality of our lives, attracts prosperity, nurture relationships, build careers and accelerate spiritual growth. I am so excited to share this information with you, always._**

**ACHIEVEMENT NUMBER – FIVE**

**_You are highly sensitive, intuitive, and observant, and your high energy level puts you in overdrive, which gives you the ability to stay in motion at all times. You have a heart of gold and desire to use your energy to be of service to anyone less fortunate than yourself. Because this energy is so strong in the number five, it is not uncommon for them to become healers or physicians of one field or another.  
You have a close relationship with spirit and feel at home in your own skin from a very young age. Because of this, you are highly adaptable, thrive in challenging circumstances, and  
constant change. You know that all you need to survive is a warm heart and sunny disposition. Nobody can disconnect your union with Higher Source, and knowing this keeps everything balanced in our world._**

**More information regarding Chart Readings on my Website at** [**www.egyptiannumerology.org**](http://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
 **and in my book**

**“Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the 5th Dimension.**

**WRITTEN BY SARA BACHMEIER**

# LIFE PATH 1 IN EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2024/07/25/life-path-1-in-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**Your soul life path is the total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit. It describes the direction your life will take, what challenges you will encounter, and the opportunities you will come across. It tells you what your life journey will look like and how you connect with the outside world. There are magnetic forces that draw to you various vibrations, events, and circumstances throughout your life, and all of these are influenced by your soul life path number.**

Hello and welcome, I am Sara Bachmeier. The author of **_[“Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the Fifth Dimension,”](https://www.amazon.com/Egyptian-Numerology-Emergence-Fifth-Dimension/dp/150439657X)_** and [**_“The Path of a Wounded Healer; Liberation is for the Asking.”_**](https://www.amazon.com/Path-Wounded-Healer-Liberation-Asking/dp/1982266465)

**Your path is sounded by the eternal drum of life the moment we are born. The drum is symbolic of the circle of life representing vitality****, wholeness, completion,  perfection,** **the sacred void, Alpha & Omega, the ouroboros of reincarnation, the infinite representation of Source. And although it is beyond time and space, the closest we can imagine being present within this circle would be a feeling of unconditional love. The fifth dimension is a state of love and light that some would refer to as nirvana. This is your natural state of being, without the concept of time and space.** 

**The personified energetic blueprint you create through the birthing process is called your resonance frequency. It is the vibration the Universe recognizes to ignite the fires of your living breath, burning a path that forges and sets the direction for your life’s mission. I believe that we all were originally born out of the center of this sacred zero and decided to experience and express life through the numeric vibrations of our birth dates and names. Everything involving numbers starts and ends with the number zero.**

LEARN MORE – BE MORE @ [www.egyptiannumerology.org](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)

**LIFE PATH NUMBER ONE**

The number one is a direct line from the earth to the sky, making a clear conduit or channel for focus, awareness, intuition, creativity, and independence. Your expression is that of forming your individuality and personal attainment in this lifetime. You are learning to be strong and stand your ground. You tend to be physically healthier and mentally stronger than most people. 

The life path number one serves as a conduit between Spirit and matter through the alignment of electrical currents when connected to Source. The power of this energy is known to be innovative, creative, and strengthens intuition. It is the protector of free thinkers, guardian of the people and environment, and the inventor. It seeks authenticity, confidence, laser focus, and deep concentration.

Number one is a straight arrow reflecting willpower and precision. It embodies the qualities of individuality, self-discovery, and self-empowerment. Unlike the energy of the zero and the number two, which are feminine and receptive, the number one has a masculine and willful energy. It symbolizes leadership, creativity, strength, and confidence. The higher attribute for this frequency is _**“Interdependence.”**_

Learn more about your Life Path number and how to utilize your energy to align with your Soul Contract. Click link below.
