# SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER FOUR WITH EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/05/17/soul-life-path-number-four-with-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**FREE e-Book Available Now! “INTRODUCTION TO EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY” on my Website @ [http://www.egyptiannumerology.org](http://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

**Your Soul Life Path is ignited by the heartbeat of the eternal drum of life the moment we are born. The drum is symbolic of the circle of life representing vitality, wholeness, completion, wheel of life, perfection, the sacred void, Alpha & Omega, the ouroboros of reincarnation, the infinite representation of Source. and although it is beyond time and space, the closest we can imagine being present within this circle would be a feeling of unconditional love.**

 **The fifth dimension is a state of unconditional love and light that some would refer to as nirvana. This is your natural state of being, without the concept of time and space.** 

**The personified energetic blueprint you create through the birthing process is called your resonance frequency. It is your life path and the vibration the Universe recognizes to spark the fires of your living breath, burning a path that forges and sets the direction for your life’s mission.**

**I believe that we all were originally born out of the center of this sacred zero and decided to experience and express life through the numeric vibrations of our birth dates and names.**

**Everything involving numbers starts and ends with the number zero.  Each number has its own frequency, with defining qualities, personalities, characteristics, and potential,  but we were all meant to ascend back to the comfort of this defining zero at the end of our journey, and for some of us, it has taken many, many lifetimes.**

**Your soul path describes the direction your life will take, what challenges you will encounter, and the opportunities you will come across. It tells you what your life journey will look like and how you connect with the outside world. The life path and the numbers derived from it (soul urge and achievement numbers) represent the traits and talents you were born with. There are magnetic forces that draw to you various vibrations, events, and circumstances throughout your life, and all of these are influenced by your soul life path number.**

**Every numeric Path has a unique energy pattern that embodies your identity and is represented through symbols, images, or the personal logo of our soul. It is called an archetype. On a psychological, emotional, and spiritual level, we are all multidimensional beings and these archetypes make it easier for your guides and angels to work with you.  When you tap into your signature archetype, you trigger your imagination, the realm between time and space, which becomes the sacred meeting grounds between the worlds.** 

**Your Soul Life Path is your resonant frequency. It is the vibration you signal to the Universe to attract and deliver everything that you need to develop your own archetype or Inner Hero and become the best version of yourself moving forward.  Your “Inner Hero” is your higher-self beckoning you toward your true calling in life, your purpose and reason why you are here. Now and nobody else can hear this voice but you because it is your calling and meant for your ears only.** 

**There is a Universal sacred order to life. It requires that you walk your authentic path before you pursue your life purpose. When you are on the right path, it ultimately leads you to your purpose.  Your job is to make sure you are in alignment with the right path designated specifically for you**..

**CALCULATING YOUR SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER**

 **Your soul path is the sum total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit** **unless it is a Master Number of 11, 22, 33, 44 …**

**There are several ways to calculate your Soul Life Path Number but the basic way I teach is to add your day, month and year.**

**See Example.**

**MAY 31, 1963 IS SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER 1**

**31** **DAY OF BIRTH**

         **5** **MONTH OF BIRTH**

**1963** **YEAR OF BIRTH**

**TOTAL = 1999 = 1+9+9+9= 28  add 2+8=10 = 1**

**SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER FOUR**

**_The number four has been misunderstood in numerology for so long that it is time to break this unfortunate curse. Oftentimes, we find superstition around Powerful numbers to deter people from accessing the ancient wisdom locked within these auspicious frequencies. It is usually started by dark forces that know about these powers and don’t want people to learn how to access them.  The number four in basic numerology has been called a karmic number, sickly number, and just plain bad luck. But the truth is that the number is of course the opposite of all  those things._** 

**_Four is a grounded and stable number that evokes a feeling of calmness and solidity. It  is very much rooted in the physical world and is about being present and in the “now.” For example, there are four seasons, four elements, and four corners of the earth. Four is about building a strong foundation and developing a down-to-earth perspective._**

 **_It represents the balancing of the elements on our planet earth including air, water, fire and earth. It is the magic in sacred order and the number that druids use to conjure their alchemy to promote healing. Native Americans also know the significance of this number. Four carries the healing properties from the heart and uses these elements to build a better world. It anchors and balances a deeper meaning to our lives and holds an inner intelligence of the active ingredients that holds all of life in balance._** 

**_This is the number for self-discipline, hard work, and service, and we find its beauty in productivity, organization, wholeness, and unity. The soul path number four produces the most trustworthy, practical, and down-to-earth individuals—the cornerstone members of society and businesses. The goal of this soul life path number is learning to take orders and to carry them out with dedication and perseverance. They always demand as much from themselves as they do from others … and sometimes a lot more. They have the kind of willpower that is often mistaken for sheer stubbornness. It’s not. It is conviction and endurance._**

**_They find a Zen-like satisfaction in performing the simplest of repetitive chores, as they feel closest to Source when restoring harmony to unbalanced situations. They express themselves best by creating energy. They are highly systematic by nature and thrive in orderly corporate atmospheres because of their unique perspective toward organizations. Fours make excellent teachers, musicians, engineers, surgeons, healers, and so on. They work well with their hands and have an innate understanding of structure, design, and rhythm. Their highest potential is to invent or create a plan that eases humankind’s burdens._**

# EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY; REPEATING NUMBERS 444 – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2018/12/19/egyptian-numerology-repeating-numbers-444/#content)

> **“HARMONY WITH THE UNIVERSE”**

Whenever you’re seeing the repeating sequence numbers 444, the angels are telling that you are in resonance with the perfect synchronicity of the Universe. At this moment, you are living in a true balance of harmonic creation and ready to unravel it’s deepest mysteries.

The meaning of 444 is that you’ve stepped into a portal of awareness within the spiritual dimension and energies surrounding you. The more you learn about yourself as a spiritual being, the more you will understand that there is no separation in all of existence and this is an opportunity for you to experience the oneness with the Universe in complete and perfect Harmony with all that is. This is an amazing snapshot of genius for you to behold and absorb on all levels of consciousness.

LISTEN TO YOUR INTUITION

Once you understand that you are fully supported on the path of awakening and unconditionally loved while vibrating in harmony with the infinite of creation, all that’s left for you to do is listen to your intuition.

What this means is that you’ve reached the point in your life where your readiness to transcend personal limitations, society conditioning and anything that can stop you from evolving into your true self has finally come to surface. Follow your heart, feel and listen to what resonates with you at this moment and this will lead to your Soul Life Purpose and True aspirations.

SEEING 444 is never a coincidence. It is a Divine sign from the Universe to guide you on the right path. Embrace everything that happens in your life by trusting how it unfolds and remember; You are Always exactly where you need to be right here, right NOW!

Angels are surrounding, guiding, loving and supporting you whenever you see the number combination 444.

# SOUL URGE NUMBER 28 EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2020/05/15/soul-urge-number-28-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**SOUL URGE NUMBER**

**_Your Soul Urge Number is your exact Day of Birth in Egyptian Numerology and is used to describe your Character Behavior, Souls Passion and Personality traits. It is the chief instigator to your life’s challenges and is associated with your Life Path Number._** **_This frequency is what your Soul has been “Urging” you to accomplish in this lifetime_**.

**_I describe your Soul Urge as the whisper or breath of life entering your body the moment you were born. It is the frequency of who we are in Spirit while manifesting vibrational form. This is where we view the world, it affects how we think and helps us form our unique perspectives. Understanding our Soul Urge helps us to examine the roles we play in life and why. When in sync with this vibration, we can avoid obstacles and begin to use our innate gifts & strengths to navigate our path. It is what makes us rare in group settings and can trigger how we behave or approach relationships in general_**.

**_It helped me perceive and respect the value that I bring to the table in everyday situations and it is the underlying mechanism of my thought and emotional process. I can better design my life in terms of my approach to all circumstances when I aware and using my unique gifts and potential_**.

**_The frequency of this number helps us create the direction of our Soul Life Path and gives us the freedom of choice while staying in integrity with our authentic self. It reveals how we go about bringing our “Inner Light” to others to create beneficial and fulfilling relationships. This is the frequency we CREATE from_!**

**_As with all the number frequencies, the higher our own energy level is maintained, the more powerful these forces become. Knowing and understanding these numbers in your chart will act as the driving force that can improve the quality of life, attract prosperity, nurture relationships, build careers and accelerate your spiritual growth_**.

**SOUL** **URGE** **NUMBER 28 – “THE INVESTOR”**

**28 – INVESTOR – Connection, Beauty, Resource, and Foresight**

**_Relationships are easy-breezy for you to handle and comprehend. True partnership is the respect of individuality and divine interconnections, which is a quality that you understand and practice with ease. You also have the gifts of attracting and maintaining resources, and this guarantees wealth, health, and happiness when your inner resources are balanced with divine intention. Your leadership qualities will be enhanced by devoting your abilities to the guardianship of our dear elementals. The universe trusts you and knows you will deliver._**

**_These people are strong, inventive and energetic. They understand partnership as the sharing of value and respect. When they are connected to Source, their creativity knows no bounds. They can often be drawn to materialistic goals but their most powerful virtue lies in the path of protecting and enhancing our environment. When they use their source of inner vision and power for the betterment of mankind, they uplift the frequency of the masses._**

**This information and more is available in my book “_Egyptian Numerology; Emergence Into the_ _5th Dimension_”. To learn more, visit my Website; [https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

**WRITTEN BY SARA BACHMEIER**

# EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY; REPEATING NUMBERS – 777 – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2019/01/11/egyptian-numerology-repeating-numbers-777/#content)

“SPIRITUAL ENLIGHTENMENT”
=========================

Number Sequence 777 is a highly spiritual number with the mystical number 7 appearing tripled, making it’s influence most powerful. Number 7 resonates with the “Collective Consciousness”. A common name for the number 7 is the “Seeker” and I have a personal name for this number, it is the “Star Gazer” because of it’s unique qualities to enter the outer realms and to call on planetary assistance.

Angel Number 7777 also encourages you to look to higher learning, studying, investigating and researching topics that genuinely interest and resonate with you on a soul level. You are advised to turn your natural interests, curiosities and skills towards areas that involve the spiritual, esoteric and supernatural aspects of personal interest as this will enhance and help you with your inner-growth, soul awareness and mystical development. Take the time to engross yourself in pastimes that genuinely interest and engage you and share your spiritual perspectives with those around you.

Angel Number 777 indicates that you have listened to Divine guidance and are now putting that wisdom to work in your life, and the time has come to reap the rewards for your hard work and efforts. You are being commended by the angels as your successes are inspiring, helping and teaching others by example. Know that your wishes are coming to fruition in your life as a direct result of your positive efforts and attitude towards your life, and you can expect many more miracles to occur for you, both large and small.

Angel Number 777 brings a message from your angels that you are on the right path and living and serving your Divine life purpose. The Universe is happy with your progress and due to your positive efforts and hard work, you have earned angelic merit.

**WHAT IS A SOUL URGE NUMBER?**

**_Your Day of Birth is your Soul Urge Number.   I describe your Soul Urge Number as the whisper or the breath of life that entered your body the moment you are born. It is the frequency of who you are in Spirit, manifesting  physical vibrational form._  _This number helps you create and enhance the direction of your life. It reveals how you go about bringing your “Inner Light” to others to create beneficial and fulfilling relationships._**

**_This is the frequency that we create from._**

**_Your Soul Urge Number is your exact Day of Birth in Egyptian Numerology. It is referred to as your Character Number and reveals Personality traits, Character behaviors, and your Souls Passions. It works directly with your Soul Life Path Number by influencing particular challenges for you to overcome and gifts and talents to develop._**

**_This Number shows you what your Soul is Urging you to accomplish in this lifetime…._**

_**Your Soul Urge Number determines your natural gifts, abilities, and talents. It**_ **_encourages you to turn your strongest challenges into your greatest strengths._**

**_We never stop learning who we are and why we are here. The more we know about ourselves, the more we can develop our authentic nature and respect the fine_ _structure of infinite consciousness. Each soul urge number leads to an ability within us that needs to be explored, expanded, and expressed in our lifetime._** 

**_Our gifts, abilities, talents and potential outlined in our day of birth are just_ _the beginning clues to what we are capable of manifesting in our lifetime. Explore the meaning of your true nature and how you can develop your talents to support your life path._**

**SOUL URGE NUMBER 5**

**“TRANSFORMATION”**

**_“Passion,_ _Expression_, _Social,_ _Intuitive,_ _and Freedom_**_“_

**_Soul Urge number 5 expresses the love for adventure and freedom. It is a busy energy that enjoys new experiences, and seeking out pleasure. It is sensual and often driven and motivated by the desires of the 5 physical senses._**

**_In the spiritual realm, this energy is about transformation and using the Phoenix and fire energy to transmute lead into gold or in other words; challenges into opportunities._**

**_Like fire fueled by the element of earth and air, transformation burns with movement, change, and a master of adaptation. It can be cleansing or it can destroy, but whenever it is around, there is action. All of life depends on the laws of transformation. We would never evolve without the secrets of passion and the desires ignited through the pulse of creation._**

**_These people love excitement, movement, and learning. They are referred to as info-maniacs. They are very curious and embrace a sense of wonder that keeps them active and hungry to learn about people, places, events, and circumstances that interest them. They have a fire energy burning deep in their soul and the ability to assist other people in transforming their inner darkness into the light. They are creative, kind, and selfless at the core of their unique individuality._**

**LEARN MORE:**

In Egyptian Numerology, there are 3 major Numeric calculations from your Birth Date that reveal your innate gifts, talents, and potential. These specific attributes were chosen by you before birth to support you on your Soul Life Path and journey. When you discover, align, and develop these Super-Powers, you are on the road to becoming your very own Inner Hero. These powers are a part of you and will lay dormant until activated. **Knowing and understanding this number in your birth chart acts as the driving force to improve the quality of life, attract more prosperity, nurture relationships, build careers, and accelerate your spiritual growth.**

**Your Soul Urge number is active from the moment you draw your first breath of air and stays as the dominating energy featured in your life until the age of 36. **SOUL URGE NUMBER 7**

**_Higher Wisdom,_ _Channel, Intelligence,_ _Creative_**

You have an etheric library with planetary and inter-dimensional universes within you. Your authentic approach to life opens a relationship with the past, present, future, paranormal, reincarnation, planetary and geographic gateways.**_

_**The Soul Urge Number Seven individuals are usually found in small groups of people. They are very intuitive, intelligent and have the unique ability to connect with the Spirit Realm. They are adventurous when it comes to elevating their self awareness and can often be found communing in the wilderness because of the limitless lessons it has to offer. They are soul seekers and have the innate ability to channel Higher Wisdom which allows them to freely explore the realms of the outer/inner worlds.**_

**_The number seven is connected with the pursuit of truth and the desire for a deeper understanding of life. This energy is closely linked to esoteric science and many resonate with Ancient civilizations. They are known as the ” truth seekers.”_**

333 – Alignment in Body, Mind and Soul

The Ascended Masters are with you and you are Fully Protected!

When you see 333 repeatedly, all you have to do is ask for the Ascended Masters guidance, have faith and you will receive it! Trust that you are surrounded, protected, loved and guided by the Spiritual Masters of our planet. These Divine Beings from higher realms are steering you on your path every step of the way.

Three is the Trinity number; Mind, Body & Spirit. Confirmation that you are hitting it on all three levels and really in the zone at that moment. You may feel insanely fulfilled by life when 333 appears and continues to repeat in sequence. 

The number 3 is the number for joy, laughter, communication, social activity, creativity, self expression and intuition. It is the number of the performer and demands expression and release. It is encouraged to use this frequency to create joy in your life and those around you.

# EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY     MASTER NUMBER 66/12/3 – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2019/05/03/egyptian-numerology-master-number-66-12-3/#content)

**Master Number 66/12/3**

**_We have the double emphasis on empathy with the number six. Here, the healer, magician, and spiritual physician are hard at work. After adding the sixes, we get the number twelve, which is not only a cycle number but also the number of a true master. Properties of the number twelve resonate with independence, creativity, intuition, balance, and a genuine connection to Higher Source for the purpose of service to humankind._**

**_When you add the numbers of the twelve together, you get the number three, which illustrates your ability to target your means of expression through pure empathy toward others. You are able to read energy and actually feel another person’s emotional field within your own body. This is an excellent source of healing power after you’ve mastered your own ability to hold the frequency of love and light while channeling directly toward the person who needs healing._**

**_The master number sixty-six will be working the number three until maturity (around the age of forty or older). Learning the abilities and challenges of communication, creativity, intuition, self-love, joy, laughter, and social graces is paramount to the development of the master number sixty-six. Evolving through all these qualities is essential for the sacred powers to be released and become activated. You are a dynamic healer, channel, and artist who will rely on the strong self-esteem and creative expression that the number three promises. Your soul life path is to use your empathic and channeling abilities to heal animals, people, and our environment through creative expression and manifestation here on Earth._**

**Written By Sara Bachmeier/ [http://www.egyptiannumerology.org](http://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

# HEART’S DESIRE NUMBER FIVE         EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2021/01/15/hearts-desire-number-five-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**HEART’S DESIRE**

_**In  Egyptian numerology, our Hearts Desire is the numeric calculation of the vowels of our birth certificate name. The vowels in the name are considered fluid and soft, describing the deepest passions and motivators of our heart. They hold our true vision of what we came here to do in this lifetime.**_

**_This is where we Hold what is near and dear to our heart. It is the frequency of our heart vibration & what motivates our passion, purpose, beliefs & points to authenticity. It is inspired and ignited by an Awakening. Until then, it directs our experiences toward maturation teaching us who we are and why we are here._**

**_Because this vibration is linked to our hearts, we can only access it when our hearts are open. Anything blocking us from the flow of feelings will cause us to formulate our experiences through our minds leading to imbalance because it does not allow the heart energy body to mature. This is why an “Awakening” can be painful. The walls around our hearts need to come down.. whether by a feather or Sledgehammer. Keeping our hearts open is the journey after we open our eyes._**

**_The awakening process is a rather personal journey. Everyone who experiences their own awakening usually arrives at the same destiny and that is with eyes wide open._**

**_A Spiritual Awakening can manifest from several post experiences including a devastating loss, trauma, illness, and painful circumstances that have us trudging out of a period called the dark night of the soul._**

_**Spiritual Awakening is a moment of transcendence and, with awareness, this moment can stretch out, touching all areas of our lives.  
Awakening spiritually changes the way we move through the world, and allows an inner sense of peace and stillness to govern our actions and reactions.** **The Awakening can be a gradual process, or it can also happen as if struck by lightning whereby one single event unlocks a flood of insights which changes a person’s perception of reality completely. There is no set definition as to how an awakening should happen, everybody experiences it in his or her own unique way.**_

**_It is not a one-time event, just like waking up in physical life, awakening is something we do every day. Spiritual awakening is an ongoing and ever unfolding process. It is walking along our divinely guided path towards fully remembering ourselves as conscious and ethical beings whereby we begin the journey of turning away from layers of illusion present in the physical world, and choose to become aware of who we really are, and what we know is really true._**

_**Not all awakenings come from suffering and pain, we can also experience an awakening through deep meditative states of awareness and often times through prayer and contemplation.** **But those of us who graduate into a higher state of consciousness through pain and suffering need to find peace with our devastating loss.** **We simply cannot keep our eyes open without healing the past circumstances or we risk being pulled back into slumber while holding tightly onto our regressions.**_

_**For me, it was the trauma of being sexually assaulted as a young teen that threw me on my knees to a spiritual awakening, but post trauma found me still holding onto the feelings of betrayal, rejection, and abandonment.** **I also had a deep seeded feeling of shame that I carried around with me and although this feeling kept me searching for spiritual solutions, it was not until I faced my demons, healed my fear, and opened my heart that I was able to move on to become a sovereign , authentic, self- loving entity.**_

**_This process did not happen overnight. It occurred after continuing to make a Series of bad mistakes, poor judgment, and harmful experiences. I just could not understand how my spiritual knowledge and wisdom were expanding but my personal life was in shambles. What I knew and who I was, or my intentions and my actions were out of proportion with who I knew I was and what was driving the vehicle was unresolved emotional baggage that had not been resolved._**

**_PTSD is a perplexing phenomenon. In the book I am writing called the “Path of a Wounded Healer; Liberation is for the Asking”, I have a chapter dedicated to this subject. I re-named post-traumatic stress disorder to “Portal through Spiritual Doors”. I explain a theory based on my own experience._**

_**Often times when a person experiences a life threatening encounter, our Soul leaves the body or disassociates in order to protect ourselves.** **This can make healing exceedingly difficult because we need a soul retrieval ceremony or process in order to recall the incident so we can become aware of what happened.** **Sometimes even a hypnoses regression can be helpful under therapeutic observation.**_

_**What I am getting at, is that deep emotional trauma isn’t something you just “Get Over”. It is healed differently than our natural day to day losses.** **An Awakening pushes us to our limits and beyond. It isn’t something that just happens once, it is a continuous process of surrender, release, restore, and reprieve or it will continue to replay.**_

**_There are specific number frequencies that we choose to be born under that pre-determined our wounded healer path and even the dark night of the soul. I believe that when we contracted before birth to have a spiritual awakening, we did not take an account the suffering and pain involved but rather we viewed it as a gift of beauty, freedom, and illumination to ourselves and the world. I believe that pain and suffering are by-products of being born into the 3rd dimension._**

_**But we were not in the third dimension when we designed our soul life agreement with our spirit guides.** **In the spirit realm, being spiritually evolved enough to carry a high frequency such as a Master Number is an honor and privilege.**_

_**When we were Born, we passed through the veils of amnesia. Unfortunately, this keeps us in the dark to the advantages of our life’s journey. We simply do not have access to the bigger picture until we are able to tap into a higher consciousness.** **The reality of our nature is that we are far more than a physical being. We are a multidimensional spiritual being, and yet prior to our present life, we agreed to limit our awareness of this, to fully be immersed in duality, separation, and illusion. Now if we are going through an awakening then we also agreed and set the stage for ourselves to have the experience of waking up and remembering.**_

     **_In other words, it is our Soul that triggers our awakening process. However, there were several events, books, people, experiences, even movies that may have played a role in our pre-awakening process. All of our life experiences have essentially been preparing us for the journey of peeling back the veil of illusion, rinsing the sleep away from our eyes, and reclaiming our power to co-create in the physical world as a fully awakened Divine Being._**

**_When I work with individuals in my Mentor-ship program, I am able to take them through their Soul Life agreement, explain in detail their contracts, and how to get into alignment with their mission. It takes an enormous amount of willingness, openness, and honesty to break through the veils of amnesia, but our Hearts Desire holds the memories and truth of why we came here._**

_**The veils are thinning, and we are being given access to Ancient teachings from all around the world. They all have one thing in common and that is pointing to the ancient verse of**, **“Know Thyself and thou shall know the Universe”.**_

**_So, no matter what direction our lives have woven, rest assured that the vital information we seek about ourselves is never lost, we put it safely where it can be decoded in our Hearts Desire Number._**

**_You can learn more about your Heart’s Desire Number in my Book “Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the 5th Dimension”_**

**CALCULATING YOUR HEART’S DESIRE NUMBER**

**The Heart’s Desire number is the sum total of the vowels in a name. Reduce the total to a single digit unless it is a Master Number. Use the arithmancy conversion chart below. The vowels are A, E, I, O, U, and sometimes Y. The letter Y is used as a consonant except when it is the first letter in a person’s first or last name, such as Yolanda, Yvon, or Yvette. The letter Y is considered a vowel if there are no other vowels in the name, such as Bly or Flynn.**

J**O**HN **E**V**A**NS D**OE**/ **6+5+1+6+5= 23 (2+3=5)TOTAL=5**

**A J S – 1  
B K T – 2  
C L U – 3  
D M V – 4  
E N W – 5  
F O X – 6  
G P Y – 7  
H Q Z – 8  
I R – 9**

**HEART’S DESIRE NUMBER FIVE**

_**Info-mania is the word assigned to the heart’s desire of the number five. You are curious and need free rein to explore all your options in every direction and at all times. There is nothing wrong with this if you are willing to align with the universal laws to get there. Happiness is having the latitude to go where you want to go and do what you want to do. Tasting life in an unrestrained fashion produces a sense of fulfillment for those vibrating with the number five energy.**_

_**You express yourself best through the movement of energy. You are often blessed with numerous talents and abilities and have the potential to sustain a couple of careers at once. Your deepest desire is to travel and experience as many new things as possible. You are a philosophical individual who is endlessly fascinated by human nature. Your highest potential is the imparting or delivery of the kind of wisdom that could never be taught in a school, although many number fives make great teachers in the traditional sense.**_

**_Beauty is when you get in touch with your life force and use it creatively. Learn to bring your visions to your heart and then express yourself through the fire in your solar plexus._**

**_The number five energy is the energy of the phoenix rising out of the fire. It is the vibration of change, adaptation, and transformation. It burns with the flames of divine creation and cannot or will not be contained. It is the fuel from the wild horse medicine transmuting all negativities into pure passion that runs through your veins. This type of energy is not meant to be harnessed or understood, only to be consumed, and unfortunately, few people can define the rhythm of this frequency and do it justice because even words tend to imprison the true nature of this vibrant number._**

**View more information regarding Chart Readings on my Website [www.egyptiannumerology.org](http://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

**Schedule Private Readings at** [**https://bit.ly/ChartReadingEgyptian**](https://bit.ly/ChartReadingEgyptian)

 **and my book**,

**“Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the 5th Dimension”**

# LIFE PATH 6 WITH EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2024/08/30/life-path-6-with-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**Your soul life path is the total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit. It describes the direction your life will take, what challenges you will encounter, and the opportunities you will come across. It tells you what your life journey will look like and how you connect with the outside world. There are magnetic forces that draw to you various vibrations, events, and circumstances throughout your life, and all of these are influenced by your soul life path number.**

**Hello and welcome, I am Sara Bachmeier. The author of _[“Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the Fifth Dimension,”](https://www.amazon.com/Egyptian-Numerology-Emergence-Fifth-Dimension/dp/150439657X)_** and [**_“The Path of a Wounded Healer; Liberation is for the Asking.”_**](https://www.amazon.com/Path-Wounded-Healer-Liberation-Asking/dp/1982266465)

**Your path is created from the sound off the eternal drum of life the moment we are born. The drum is symbolic of the circle of life representing vitality, wholeness, completion,  perfection, the sacred void, Alpha & Omega, the ouroboros of reincarnation, the infinite representation of Source. And although it is beyond time and space, the closest we can imagine being present within this circle would be a feeling of unconditional love. The fifth dimension is a state of love and light that some would refer to as nirvana. This is your natural state of being, without the concept of time and space.** 

**The personified energetic blueprint you create through the birthing process is called your resonance frequency. It is the vibration the Universe recognizes to ignite the fires of your living breath, burning a path that forges and sets the direction for your life’s mission. I believe that we all were originally born out of the center of this sacred zero and decided to experience and express life through the numeric vibrations of our birth dates and names. Everything involving numbers starts and ends with the number zero.**

**LEARN MORE – BE MORE** @ 

[www.egyptiannumerology.org](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)

**LIFE PATH NUMBER SIX**

This life path represents a balance between the earthly and spiritual realms. It points to developing your intuitive gifts and is connected to clairvoyance, and our other extrasensory capacities (hence the “sixth” sense).

In Egyptian Numerology, the Number Six is called the “Light House”. When connected to Source, their purpose is to channel Higher wisdom and to learn to trust their intuition. When they do this, they form a sacred bond allowing them to relay messages from the Higher realms.

In sacred geometry, the number six represents harmony and balance. It embodies the qualities of love, commitment, and purpose.

Like the perfect honeycomb, the six- sided hexagon is formed by the interlocking of two triangles, the upward pointing triangle represents masculine energy and the downward facing triangle represents feminine energy.

The number six is also associated with the sixth chakra, the third eye, which governs seeing, intuition, imagination, dreams, and access to  the subconscious mind.

You have the ability to heal others, and heal the world, but only after you complete the process of healing yourself first. Only then will you create true abundance and make a massive difference in the lives of others, and become a beacon of light in our current reality.

The number six has a truly outstanding sense of responsibility, love, and balance. They are helpful and ever conscientious, making them quite capable of rectifying and balancing any sort of inharmonious situation. They are inclined to give help and comfort to those in need. They have a natural penchant for working with the old, the dying, the sick, or the underprivileged.

Although they may have considerable creative and artistic talents, the chances are that they will devote themselves to an occupation that shows concern for the betterment of the community.

# EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY; REPEATING NUMBERS 555 – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2018/12/28/egyptian-numerology-repeating-numbers-555/#content)

The Number 555 Sequence means Change and Transformation.

Major Changes and Significant Transformations are welcoming you at this time. You have the amazing opportunity to break free and out of the chrysalis from past or present events that may have been holding you back. It is time to release your courage to uncover the exciting life you truly deserve and may have been waiting for.

There is a change beckoning you like a fast moving current of flowing water or a gentle summer breeze whispering down the mountain valleys…. there is a rising momentum summoning you toward a new direction and new horizon. Don’t hold back because it is in this moment that you can release your fears, doubts and any reason you may have been holding onto that would prevent you from following the lingering music that sings the lyrics to try something different, adopt a fresh perspective and have the faith that you are being divinely guided into a brand new phase of your life.

Triple 5’s is a wake-up call from Higher Wisdom to get your chi moving, open your heart a little more and spring forth to take action around something you have been hesitating or procrastinating about. Sit quietly with a candle lit and summon your inner witness. Ask yourself what it is that you need to be doing in order to advance, inspire and expand your soul(?)

Your Personal Freedom is asking for the next dance and would like you to take control of your life while waltzing through the next phase of your development. Be excited and welcome the flames of transformation to ignite your passion and creativity so that you can manifest your highest imaginations into reality. Now THAT is the power of 555!

# EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY; SOUL URGE #12 – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2020/01/17/egyptian-numerology-soul-urge-12/#content)

**SOUL URGE NUMBER**

**_Your Soul Urge Number is your exact Day of Birth in Egyptian Numerology and is used to describe your Character Behavior, Souls Passion and Personality traits. It is the chief instigator to your life’s challenges and is associated with your Life Path Number._** **_This frequency is what your Soul has been urging you to accomplish in this lifetime._**

**_I describe your Soul Urge as the whisper or breath of life entering your body the moment you are born. it is the frequency of who we are in Spirit manifesting vibration form. This is where we view the world, affects how we think and forms our unique perspectives. Understanding our Soul Urge helps us see the roles we play and why. When is sync with this vibration, we can avoid obstacles and begin to use our strengths. It is what makes us rare in group settings and triggers how we behave or approach relationships in general._**

**_It helped me perceive and respect the value that I bring to the table in everyday situations and it is the underlying mechanism of my thought and emotional process. I can better design my life in terms of my approach to all circumstances._**

**_This number helps us create the direction of our Soul Life Path and gives us the freedom of choice while staying in integrity with our authentic self. It reveals how we go about bringing our “Inner Light” to others to create beneficial and fulfilling relationships. This is the frequency we CREATE from!_**

**SOUL URGE NUMBER 12 – MASTER**

12 – Master = Visionary Abilities, Independence, Leadership, and Diplomacy

**_Soul Urge Number 12: Master (Cycle Number) The true master is the disciple of the Lord, and the Lord is known in all things. Here we have the magic from the number one, which gives us strength, creativity, and intuition; and we have the number two, which holds our beauty, balance, and peace. When added together, they become the Holy Trinity and are expressed as the divine master, or teacher._**

**_Twelve is a cycle number and holds space for a portal of spiritual transportation to the outer realms. If you have the number 12 as your date of birth, it assigns you to the role of being a Master in one aspect or another in your life. You can use this force to accomplish great things in your life or you can choose to ignore it. If you embrace the qualities you were born with, you can manage productivity in any field you are called to explore. The secret is always to go within and “Know Thyself”. The Universe will take notice and ride the wave of synchronicity to fulfill your deepest and truest desires._**

**This information and more is available in my book “Egyptian Numerology; Emergence Into the 5th Dimension”. To learn more, visit my Website; [https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

**WRITTEN BY SARA BACHMEIER**

# EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY; MASTER NUMBER 77/14/5 – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2019/05/20/egyptian-numerology-master-number-77-14-5/#content)

**Master Number 77/14/5**

**_The number seven is a spiritual number and holds the qualities of the genius when riding solo, but when it is doubled, it holds those qualities plus the emphasis on the relationship between humans, channeling higher wisdom, and the connection with sacred guidance. The sevens have access to the kingdom realm of many sources, and nature is but one of their strongest fountains of knowledge._**

**_When we add the sevens, we get fourteen, and the properties of these numbers are self-sustenance, intuition, self-awareness, leadership, order, justice, boundaries, and perseverance. These qualities assist the powers of the seven and add momentum when adding these numbers together to get the number five. When the number five is working in its highest vibration, it collects knowledge from various sources and spreads spiritual tokens out into the community for the highest good of all. This number is about freedom, independence, and the right to follow where the heart will lead them in life._**

**_Deep down, their basic essence is the full expression of personal freedom, sensuality, analysis, curiosity, and intuition. The number 77/5 is introspective but adventurous, sensual, and spiritual, so long as its expression of personal freedom isn’t restrained._**

**_They are witty and spiritual and have astute intelligence. Imagine having the personal freedom to pursue any whim and experience whatever you are curious about. This is the ultimate dream for this number. Experiencing everything at least once is a natural part of their adventurous approach to life. They are interested in pretty much everything. They especially appreciate sensual experiences, including taste, touch, sound, physical movement, or excitement as examples. They also enjoy interacting with people of various backgrounds, ages, and points of view._**

**_Master number 77/5’s are known as masters of spiritual energies; they are challenged to contact their inner soul through silence. Known for their wisdom, they work to understand and then live by the spiritual principles of the earth. They are here to use their higher wisdom, leadership qualities, and healing properties to raise the consciousness of humankind._**

**Written By Sara Bachmeier** [https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)

# EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY;  MASTER NUMBER 55/10 – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2019/04/26/egyptian-numerology-master-number-55-10/#content)

**_Master Number 55/10_**
-------------------------

**_This is the amazing number of world leadership through the process of purification, transportation, and transformation. You are highly motivated through your impeccable intuition, sensitivity, strength, and power of expression._**

**_The double impact of the five promotes healing and transformation powers. When added together, we get the number one and all the abilities associated with leadership, independence, intelligence, intuition, and intense focus. Standing directly to the right of the number one is the zero and the qualities of sensitivity, strength, expression, and access to the realm of all possibilities._**

**_When your master number matures (around forty years or older), your powers of clarity will surface, along with the offer of leadership and transformation. Through your motivation, your path will be to assist the world in healing with your skills and abilities of transmutation._**

**_The number fifty-five will resonate with the seeds of innovation, the freedom of exploring new paths, and the rebirth of liberty through unveiling new perspectives. This number has an extraordinary high element of curiosity and will learn through experience, forward-thinking, intelligence, and inspiring important changes._**

**_The pure burning fires of their individual wills desire to blend with the higher will, wisdom, and truth of divine source to invoke the innovation and originality in others. They are outward-looking and forward-thinking, and both tendencies inspire the anticipation of new experiences and new learning that the world is waiting for._**

Written By Sara Bachmeier / [https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)

 and each of these signs has its own compatibility and personality. Knowing the characteristics of your sign, you can correct your weaknesses. Also, the [Zodiac signs compatibility](https://zodiac12signs.com/compatibility/)
 will help you to choose the right pair.**

# LIFE PATH 4 IN EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2024/08/19/life-path-4-in-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**Your soul life path is the total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit. It describes the direction your life will take, what challenges you will encounter, and the opportunities you will come across. It tells you what your life journey will look like and how you connect with the outside world. There are magnetic forces that draw to you various vibrations, events, and circumstances throughout your life, and all of these are influenced by your soul life path number.**

**Hello and welcome, I am Sara Bachmeier. The author of _[“Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the Fifth Dimension,”](https://www.amazon.com/Egyptian-Numerology-Emergence-Fifth-Dimension/dp/150439657X)_** and [**_“The Path of a Wounded Healer; Liberation is for the Asking.”_**](https://www.amazon.com/Path-Wounded-Healer-Liberation-Asking/dp/1982266465)

**Your path is sounded by the eternal drum of life the moment we are born. The drum is symbolic of the circle of life representing vitality****, wholeness, completion,  perfection,** **the sacred void, Alpha & Omega, the ouroboros of reincarnation, the infinite representation of Source. And although it is beyond time and space, the closest we can imagine being present within this circle would be a feeling of unconditional love. The fifth dimension is a state of love and light that some would refer to as nirvana. This is your natural state of being, without the concept of time and space.** 

**The personified energetic blueprint you create through the birthing process is called your resonance frequency. It is the vibration the Universe recognizes to ignite the fires of your living breath, burning a path that forges and sets the direction for your life’s mission. I believe that we all were originally born out of the center of this sacred zero and decided to experience and express life through the numeric vibrations of our birth dates and names. Everything involving numbers starts and ends with the number zero.**

**LEARN MORE – BE MORE** @ 

[www.egyptiannumerology.org](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)

**LIFE PATH NUMBER FOUR**

The number four has been misunderstood in numerology for so long that it is time to break this unfortunate curse. Oftentimes, we find superstition around Powerful numbers to deter people from accessing the ancient wisdom locked within this auspicious energy.

It is usually started by dark forces that know about these powers and don’t want people to learn how to access them.  The number four in basic numerology has been called a karmic number, sickly number, and just plain bad luck. But the truth is that the number is of course the opposite of all those things. 

Four is a grounded and stable number that evokes a feeling of calmness and solidity. It is very much rooted in the physical world and is about being present and in the “now.” For example, there are four seasons, four elements, and four corners of the earth. Four is about building a strong foundation and developing a down-to-earth perspective.

 It represents the balancing of the elements on our planet earth including air, water, fire and earth. It is the magic in sacred order and the number that druids use to conjure their alchemy to promote healing. Native Americans also know the significance of this number. Four carries the healing properties from the heart and uses these elements to build a better world. It anchors and balances a deeper meaning to our lives and holds an inner intelligence of the active ingredients that holds all of life in balance. 

This is the number for self-discipline, hard work, and service, and we find its beauty in productivity, organization, wholeness, and unity. The soul path number four produces the most trustworthy, practical, and down-to-earth individuals—the cornerstone members of society and businesses. The goal of this soul life path number is learning to take orders and to carry them out with dedication and perseverance. They always demand as much from themselves as they do from others … and sometimes a lot more. They have the kind of willpower that is often mistaken for sheer stubbornness. It’s not. It is conviction and endurance.

They find a Zen-like satisfaction in performing the simplest of repetitive chores, as they feel closest to Source when restoring harmony to unbalanced situations. They express themselves best by creating energy. They are highly systematic by nature and thrive in orderly corporate atmospheres because of their unique perspective toward organizations. Fours make excellent teachers, musicians, engineers, surgeons, healers, and so on. They work well with their hands and have an innate understanding of structure, design, and rhythm. Their highest potential is to invent or create a plan that eases the burdens of humanity.

# LIFE PATH 2 IN EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2024/08/06/life-path-2-in-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**Your soul life path is the total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit. It describes the direction your life will take, what challenges you will encounter, and the opportunities you will come across. It tells you what your life journey will look like and how you connect with the outside world. There are magnetic forces that draw to you various vibrations, events, and circumstances throughout your life, and all of these are influenced by your soul life path number.**

**Hello and welcome, I am Sara Bachmeier. The author** of **_[“Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the Fifth Dimension,”](https://www.amazon.com/Egyptian-Numerology-Emergence-Fifth-Dimension/dp/150439657X)_** and [**_“The Path of a Wounded Healer; Liberation is for the Asking.”_**](https://www.amazon.com/Path-Wounded-Healer-Liberation-Asking/dp/1982266465)

**Your path is sounded by the eternal drum of life the moment we are born. The drum is symbolic of the circle of life representing vitality****, wholeness, completion,  perfection,** **the sacred void, Alpha & Omega, the ouroboros of reincarnation, the infinite representation of Source. And although it is beyond time and space, the closest we can imagine being present within this circle would be a feeling of unconditional love. The fifth dimension is a state of love and light that some would refer to as nirvana. This is your natural state of being, without the concept of time and space.** 

**The personified energetic blueprint you create through the birthing process is called your resonance frequency. It is the vibration the Universe recognizes to ignite the fires of your living breath, burning a path that forges and sets the direction for your life’s mission. I believe that we all were originally born out of the center of this sacred zero and decided to experience and express life through the numeric vibrations of our birth dates and names. Everything involving numbers starts and ends with the number zero.**

**LEARN MORE – BE MORE** @ [www.egyptiannumerology.org](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)

**LIFE PATH NUMBER TWO**

This vibration represents two 1’s standing side-by-side. One is masculine and the other one is Feminine. Both seek balance and integration when in relationship with each other, and complement the opposing nature of their differences.

Polarized circumstances are frequently put in their path because this is their calling, to seek and understand every angle of a situation without judgment and allowing everything to harmonize in pure existence. They lean toward the tendencies of balance in their life and the outside world.

This energy reflects the gifts of balance, love, romance, beauty, diplomacy, acceptance, justice, liberty, harmony, music, creativity, art, and psychic awareness.

This is the frequency of yin and yang co-mingling in physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual bodies. Duality is a doorway that the person holding this frequency must walk through both in understanding and in exercising throughout one’s life. They seek to walk the middle ground in opposing situations, bringing any differences to neutrality. 

Two is the number of duality; the split we perceive in life between light and darkness, inside and outside, yin and yang, masculine and feminine, good and bad, life and death, mind and heart, logic and intuition, and so on.

This number is often called the romantic number, and its essence can be found in the fashion of the Renaissance and in the artwork of Maxfield Parrish. It brings forces together in harmonious balance, creating a bond. You desire to share your beauty with an equal partner because you invariably understand that knowledge comes from the balance and marriage of the two opposites.

You are a natural at balancing polarities, which brings peace when opposites find symmetry. Because you are empathic, you will have to learn about your intuition, sensitivities, and psychic gifts, as well as how to form boundaries and protect your feelings starting at a young age.

 In Egyptian numerology the number two’s highest potential is to establish a state of neutrality and rise above judgement of self and others. The number two symbolizes true partnership and when in balance, it is the number for tranquillity.

They are naturally creative, intuitive and psychic because they have the unique ability to open portals not often found in the human condition. They become the expression of love, beauty and compassion with their unique ability to balance extremes. Their talents often lead them into mastery of artistic endeavors whether it is music, canvas or design. They are often literary magnets with many books in their library and find comfort in writing and expressing themselves with words.

The number two holds the seed of creativity. You create from a song that lingers deep within your heart. You are often blamed for idealism—“People see what they want to see”—and you desire the world to see their vision through the eyes of beauty.

You enliven dreams and awaken the imagination. You balance the inner imagination with outer realities, making both aspects more appealing and beneficial.

The number two is about creating balance in your life between the yin and yang and with the five elements: earth, water, air, fire, and ether.

As the most feminine among all numbers, you are strong, powerful, resilient, and flexible.  

They are artists, diplomats, advisors, counselors, and caretakers. One of their biggest life challenges is codependency and possibly addiction. They desire partnership and seek relationships but sometimes lose themselves in the cohesiveness of both. As they mature and can separate themselves as an individual, they have much to teach the outside world.

This frequency develops empathic gifts quite young because it is necessary for them to learn how others feel in order to balance their own emotions, but if they don’t learn how to protect their own energy, addiction to outside substances can be used to comfort complications they are bound to struggle with. Once they overcome their own challenges, it serves to strengthen their experiences and allows them to become ever more powerful adults and teachers.

**LIFE PATH NUMBER EIGHT**

Life Path number eight is connected to abundance, personal power, prosperity, and financial well-being. Resourcefulness, hard work, determination, and inner strength are all qualities of eight. Spiritually, eight is seen as an equalizer or balancer (hence its shape) that unites the conscious with the unconscious, and earthly realm with the spiritual.

In Egyptian Numerology, the Number Eight is about balancing energy and receiving manifestation through connecting with inner abundance, inner authority, inner strength and being in integrity with communication.

This is widely known as the “abundance number” but more accurately would be the number for resource or flow because of the infinity loop the eight illustrates when turned on its side. In order for the eight’s to access this ability, they must be in integrity with their energy, including the spoken word. The loops in the eight are like a hose; if it is kinked or blocked, the flow of energy will back up and work against you rather than for you.

Eights are like a steel rod from the earth to the sky in a lightning storm. They have the ability to access pure electrical energy when they remain open, flowing and connected to Source which allows them to create. The cycle of karma, that we receive what we give, is what the number eight is here to learn and once understood and implemented, it naturally grants the eight abundance.  In other words, eight is reflected in the proverb “you will reap what you sow”.

When they make service the center of their life—sharing money, energy, and wisdom as freely as they are able—they embrace their soul life paths at the most elevated level, combining money and worldly power with the power of the heart.

On a very high plane, eights feel the inherent abundance of life, of nature, and of spirit and feel moved to share with others. Their sense of true power changes to grateful and loving surrender to a greater authority, higher power, or infinite source as manifested in the intricate intelligence and web of life as it unfolds.

# LIFE PATH 3 IN EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2024/08/12/life-path-3-in-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**Your soul life path is the total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit. It describes the direction your life will take, what challenges you will encounter, and the opportunities you will come across. It tells you what your life journey will look like and how you connect with the outside world. There are magnetic forces that draw to you various vibrations, events, and circumstances throughout your life, and all of these are influenced by your soul life path number.**

**Hello and welcome, I am Sara Bachmeier. The author of _[“Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the Fifth Dimension,”](https://www.amazon.com/Egyptian-Numerology-Emergence-Fifth-Dimension/dp/150439657X)_** and [**_“The Path of a Wounded Healer; Liberation is for the Asking.”_**](https://www.amazon.com/Path-Wounded-Healer-Liberation-Asking/dp/1982266465)

**Your path is sounded by the eternal drum of life the moment we are born. The drum is symbolic of the circle of life representing vitality****, wholeness, completion,  perfection,** **the sacred void, Alpha & Omega, the ouroboros of reincarnation, the infinite representation of Source. And although it is beyond time and space, the closest we can imagine being present within this circle would be a feeling of unconditional love. The fifth dimension is a state of love and light that some would refer to as nirvana. This is your natural state of being, without the concept of time and space.** 

**The personified energetic blueprint you create through the birthing process is called your resonance frequency. It is the vibration the Universe recognizes to ignite the fires of your living breath, burning a path that forges and sets the direction for your life’s mission. I believe that we all were originally born out of the center of this sacred zero and decided to experience and express life through the numeric vibrations of our birth dates and names. Everything involving numbers starts and ends with the number zero.**

**LEARN MORE – BE MORE** @ 

[www.egyptiannumerology.org](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)

**LIFE PATH NUMBER 3**

This Life Path is typically seen as a very fortunate and powerful number. It is symbolic of success, intuition, and good fortune. It embodies the divine principle that underlines all life and represents the triangle symbolizing the synergistic sacred current of the trinity such as birth, life and death/ beginning, middle and end/ past, present and future/ and body, mind, and spirit.

 It facilitates the highest expression of divinity. 

 In Egyptian Numerology, the number three comes in the form of “Divine Messenger,” it is the energy of expression used by the Angels, Guides,  & Ascended Masters to communicate with us via the power of the “Three’s” such as the triple number sequence. 111, 222, 333 etc.. The angels use the number three to strengthen their bond with humanity. There is always a conjuring of magic when the number three is being presented within the language of creativity.

The number three is a lighthearted, easy-going, loving, and creative energy. It encourages us to express ourselves, speak our truth, and engage in self-loving activities. 

With your acute sensitivity and empathy, you are an endless channel of creative energy with the ability to express yourself through various art forms.  The number three energy carries pure passion from the sun and is a continuous current of sacred light representing expansion, expression, and communication. Three also relates to giving outwardly, to openness, and optimism. It inspires your sensitivity, intuition, empathic nature, and psychic abilities while demanding that you experience your gifts on a deep and intimate level while expressing them creatively through the feelings of joy… and then share them with the world. 

At the highest levels, three’s serve as an open channel of loving energy, arousing others to joy and inspiration and becoming a force of light in the world.

They are also here to heal the wounded inner child in the areas of abandonment,  rejection, betrayal,  and any low self-worth and low self-esteem that follow these circumstances. 

If they carry a victim’s consciousness,  then this needs to be carefully considered and often with outside help.  Once they become liberated and take responsibility for their lives, they experience a freedom to live, love, and create in a world that is safe, nurturing, and supporting. This is when the magic occurs and they begin to shine their lights to become whatever their hearts desire. 

Egyptian numerology states that three’s liberate through the truth; the star wisdom numerology of ancient Egypt describes this number as “The truth shall set you free.” It symbolizes victory after a long struggle, after many tests of courage and determination. It reminds us that we have the power and the blessing to overcome all challenges, and all opposition. It is a very fortunate vibration on a path that carries many rewards.

**Learn more about your Life Path number and how to utilize your energy to align with your Soul Contract. Click link below.**

# EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY; MASTER NUMBER 88/16/7 – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2019/06/06/egyptian-numerology-master-number-88-16-7/#content)

**MASTER NUMBER – 88/16/7**

**_This is an extremely powerful number when in alignment with Higher Source. You will have a dynamic personality that intuitively knows how to be at the right place at the right time when opportunity knocks. An electric and atomic type of energy surges through your body, heart, mind, and spirit when you are focused on a project. Your source of self-discipline, perseverance, and unusual high stamina can manifest an enterprise from imagination into reality out of thin air._**

**_The number set of sixteen has the qualities of originality, intelligence, strength, empathy, healing, intuition, and creativity that serve as a momentum leading up to the addition of the number seven._**

**_Eighty-eights are efficient at most things they do. You are frequently analytical and intuitive, looking inward for answers and direction. You consult your own inner knowings and are generally excellent with all business matters. You hold a deep desire to build something that lasts for a long time and that can serve the better good for all humankind. Your essence is especially adept at seeing things exactly as they are, without perception filters. You tend to approach things scientifically but not exclusively, looking inward for answers as your true North Star._**

**_Seven is a very spiritual number and is the number of the genius. With the power of electrical current running through your veins, originality and creativity pumping from your heart chambers, and the channeling forces of higher wisdom, the master number 88/7 has the ability to manifest heaven on Earth with pure intention. You ride with the infinity portal that escorts you past all previous limitations and allows you to go beyond with universal blessings. Your divine Creator grants you with the generosity of the inheritance that you were promised when you practice the perfect balance of giving and receiving._**

**_Being an example and keeping vigilance to humility and personal surrender of earthly limitations will guarantee your soul life path momentum forward and upward into the realm of opulence and bounty._**

**WRITTEN BY SARA BACHMEIER From the Book – “EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY; EMERGENCE INTO THE FIFTH DIMENSION” [http://www.egyptiannumerology.org](http://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

# LIFE PATH 7 WITH EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2024/08/31/life-path-7-with-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**Your soul life path is the total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit. It describes the direction your life will take, what challenges you will encounter, and the opportunities you will come across. It tells you what your life journey will look like and how you connect with the outside world. There are magnetic forces that draw to you various vibrations, events, and circumstances throughout your life, and all of these are influenced by your soul life path number.**

**Hello and welcome, I am Sara Bachmeier. The author of _[“Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the Fifth Dimension,”](https://www.amazon.com/Egyptian-Numerology-Emergence-Fifth-Dimension/dp/150439657X)_** and [**_“The Path of a Wounded Healer; Liberation is for the Asking.”_**](https://www.amazon.com/Path-Wounded-Healer-Liberation-Asking/dp/1982266465)

**Your path is created from the sound off the eternal drum of life the moment we are born. The drum is symbolic of the circle of life representing vitality, wholeness, completion,  perfection, the sacred void, Alpha & Omega, the ouroboros of reincarnation, the infinite representation of Source. And although it is beyond time and space, the closest we can imagine being present within this circle would be a feeling of unconditional love. The fifth dimension is a state of love and light that some would refer to as nirvana. This is your natural state of being, without the concept of time and space.** 

**The personified energetic blueprint you create through the birthing process is called your resonance frequency. It is the vibration the Universe recognizes to ignite the fires of your living breath, burning a path that forges and sets the direction for your life’s mission. I believe that we all were originally born out of the center of this sacred zero and decided to experience and express life through the numeric vibrations of our birth dates and names. Everything involving numbers starts and ends with the number zero.**

**LEARN MORE – BE MORE** @ 

[www.egyptiannumerology.org](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)

**LIFE PATH NUMBER SEVEN**

Soul Life Path number seven is a mystical energy associated with synchronicity, luck, and perfection (seven chakras, seven heavens,  seven colors of the rainbow, seven days in the week, etc.) It is also seen as an esoteric energy connected to spiritual awakening, introspection, and the development of higher wisdom. This number is connected with the pursuit of truth and the desire for a deeper understanding of life.

 It is our first cycle number, the first seven years of our lives. It is a symbol of birth and rebirth, religious strength, sacred vows, path of solitude, analysis, and contemplation.

In Egyptian numerology, the number seven symbolizes a connection to ancient civilizations and is known as the “seeker.”  It promotes channeling abilities by releasing the intellect and opening to the higher realms. 

You are the historian, star seed, geographic tracer, planetary assistant, and the keeper of sacred rites, among other things. My original name for this number was the “stargazer” because you inhabit the frequency most closely linked to esoteric science, paranormal, and extraterrestrials. You are intelligent , psychic, intuitive, and a channel for higher wisdom. Your nervous system is highly sensitive, and your path thrives on nature being the ultimate teacher of the universe.

You are a spiritual person and believe wholeheartedly in the relationship between Mother Nature and science. You possess strength, curiosity, and a psychic connection between the spiritual and the physical worlds. Your intelligence and intuition often lead you to being in the right place at the right time.

You can be reserved, analytical, and a peace-loving soul who is blessed with intuition and intelligence. Your ability to concentrate, learn, and absorb information far outshines other numbers, and you often excel at all forms of scholastics. Usually your intellectual prowess as well as the clarity and foresight of mind are evident to others at an early age.

The soul life path of the number seven enables that person to excel at any career they choose, as they have the discipline and mental power to master anything in half the time as other numbers. As a number seven, your mind works at the speed of lightning, but this often makes it difficult for others to understand you.

 Others simply cannot evaluate or analyze information as fast as you can. Some sevens have such quick minds that they have difficulty expressing themselves. One of your life path challenges is to learn how to slow down and accommodate those who may not be as wit bound as you are, but who may offer you the rewards of emotional support in life.

Egyptian numerology states that number sevens often feel as if they don’t fit in socially, and this is due to the fact that they have not had many lives on this planet. On a deep level, they long to go home. The lives they have had on this planet were in advanced civilizations such as Atlantis, Lemuria, Mu, Babylon, Greece, Peru, and Egypt—and they met their untimely demise there. This may be the reason some number sevens are adamant and do not want to have anything to do with ancient wisdom or the esoteric sciences.

The soul life path of the number seven is here to use the gift of channeling higher wisdom and teaching the world what you find to be true in your heart. Although you may not be the most social number, it is important that your path leads you to sharing your knowledge with others.

 All of your gifts and abilities make you a truly interesting person to be around. It would not be uncommon to find you in the field of science, light language, research, nature, healing, geography, history, or astronomy.

Overcome your fear of being judged by the outside world and put your faith in the knowledge that both spirit and nature are one. This is something you were born to do, and deep down you will struggle until you find your unique outlet that allows you to do this.
