# EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY      DESTINY NUMBER 6 – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/02/04/egyptian-numerology-destiny-number-6/#content)

**Your destiny number describes your potential natural talents and abilities using the numerology arithmancy gathered from the total of the vowels and consonants given at birth, taken from your birth certificate name, and reduced to a single-digit number, unless it is a master number of eleven through ninety-nine.  
Your name has to do with the ways and reasons you project what you do into the world. The various ways we present ourselves in the world are shown by expression, and the choices we make are the aspects of our lives that we can use to mold our futures.  
Your name is your power of choice. The right words define your level of knowledge and experience. They are the keys that open the doors to the life you desire. Words are a control system for our own personal magic. The most powerful word in your personal universe is your name.**

**The power to create the future you want lies within you, and through the knowledge of power in your name, you’ll learn some keys that can help unlock your inner magic.  
Your destiny number embraces the truth of what you came here to do through the power of your heart’s desire number. We want to look at this number and discover the hidden passions,  
talents, and abilities that affect your world and how it is working for you now or how it can work for you in the future.  
Your personality number is your outward expression of yourself and how the world perceives you. It reflects what you are portraying back to you. How do you see yourself and the world  
around you? Are you using your abilities to your highest potential or are you attracting fear, negativity, and darkness? This number plays an important role in your destiny and demands that you stay in integrity with the highest frequency possible in order to conduct yourself in alignment with your destiny.  
Because your destiny is a combination of your heart’s desire number and your expression number, whenever you have a question about the authenticity of your ultimate path in life, look first at these two numbers and check to see if you are serving them in their highest frequency. Your destiny number will only be productive if you are being honest in your heart and showing the world who you truly are.**

**CALCULATING YOUR DESTINY NUMBER**

**The Destiny number is the sum total of the vowels and consonants in your Birth name. Reduce the total to a single digit unless it is a Master Number. Use the arithmancy conversion chart below. The letter Y is used as a consonant except when it is the first letter in a person’s first or last name, such as Yolanda, Yvon, or Yvette. The letter Y is considered a vowel if there are no other vowels in the name, such as Bly or Flynn.**

**EXAMPLE: SANDRA LEE SMITH – Sandra = 1+1+5+4+9+1= 21 (2+1) =3**

**Lee – 3+5+5= 13 (1+3) =4**

**Smith = 1+4+9+2+8 = 24 (2+4) = 6**

**ADD 3+4+6=13 (1+3)=4**

**TOTAL DESTINY NUMBER = 4**

**A J S – 1  
B K T – 2  
C L U – 3  
D M V – 4  
E N W – 5  
F O X – 6  
G P Y – 7  
H Q Z – 8  
I R – 9**

**DESTINY NUMBER SIX**

**You are sensitive, creative, empathic, and with all these abilities, you save time to care for others. While you should not completely sacrifice yourself to the service of others, helping  
those in need will open the door to beauty, love, and harmony in your own life. You will also strive to beautify the world around you with artistic endeavors. Honing your empathic skills will allow you to become a radar for people’s ailments, and you can learn to channel the healing grace of a Higher Source to direct wellness into the lives of others. You are a natural advisor and can give guidance to those who suffer, but it is wise to practice healthy boundaries for yourself before you go out to save the world.**

**You have a calming effect on others, and your even temper and sweetness make you an easy target for those who would take advantage of you. You always have the knack of seeing the other person’s point of view, and your partnerships are likely to be harmonious and long lasting. You are romantic, peace loving, domestic, family oriented, compassionate, and considerate. You love beautiful things and are a born romantic. Your ability to provide for others, to provide loyalty and security, ensures a lifetime of responsibility. The key to your destiny is to live your life as a humanitarian. Helping those who are less fortunate, down on their luck, or unhappy will help you find happiness in your own life**.

**Egyptian numerology states that the number six was a healer of some kind in a past life and met their untimely demise; therefore, they might resist stepping up to the plate as a healer in this** l**i**f**etime, but this is their true calling and Destiny. They must overcome any fear or challenges holding them back from moving forward as a healer in this lifetime. You have a strong desire to be of service and an immense sense of responsibility for family, friends, and community. You are a natural healer as a psychic reader and can look at people and know things about them or have a message that is truly important to share. You are called the mouthpiece of Source and are encouraged to give your messages of the heart, even to a stranger; you are being told to trust your instincts.**

**The most precious lesson for those with the number six Destiny is to learn how to heal** **themselves with the same love and compassion that they give to others. They will be dealing with relationship issues in this life, and it’s the relationship with themselves, with the god of their understanding, and then with another person. In this order!**

# SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER TWO       EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/04/09/soul-life-path-number-two-egyptian-numerology-2/#content)

**Your Soul Life Path is ignited by the heartbeat of the eternal drum of life the moment we are born. The drum is symbolic of the circle of life representing vitality, wholeness, completion, wheel of life, perfection, the sacred void, Alpha & Omega, the ouroborus of reincarnation, the infinite representation of Source. and although it is beyond time and space, the closest we can imagine being present within this circle would be a feeling of unconditional love.**

 **The fifth dimension is a state of unconditional love and light that some would refer to as nirvana. This is your natural state of being, without the concept of time and space.** 

**The personified energetic blueprint you create through the birthing process is called your resonance frequency. It is the vibration the Universe recognizes to spark the fires of your living breath, burning a path that forges and sets the direction for your life’s mission.**

**I believe that we all were originally born out of the center of this sacred zero and decided to experience and express life through the numeric vibrations of our birth dates and names.**

**Everything involving numbers starts and ends with the number zero.  Each number has its own frequency, with defining qualities, personalities, characteristics, and potential,  but we were all meant to ascend back to the comfort of this defining zero at the end of our journey, and for some of us, it has taken many, many lifetimes.**

**Your soul path describes the direction your life will take, what challenges you will encounter, and the opportunities you will come across. It tells you what your life journey will look like and how you connect with the outside world. The life path and the numbers derived from it (soul urge and achievement numbers) represent the traits and talents you were born with. There are magnetic forces that draw to you various vibrations, events, and circumstances throughout your life, and all of these are influenced by your soul life path number.**

**Every numeric Path has a unique energy pattern that embodies your identity and is represented through symbols, images, or the personal logo of our soul. It is called an archetype. On a psychological, emotional, and spiritual level, we are all multidimensional beings and these archetypes make it easier for your guides and angels to work with you.  When you tap into your signature archetype, you trigger your imagination, the realm between time and space, which becomes the sacred meeting grounds between the worlds.** 

**Your Soul Life Path is your resonant frequency. It is the vibration you signal to the Universe to attract and deliver everything that you need to develop your own archetype or Inner Hero and become the best version of yourself moving forward.  Your “Inner Hero” is your higher-self beckoning you toward your true calling in life, your purpose and reason why you are here Now and nobody else can hear this voice but you because it is your calling and meant for your ears only.** 

**There is a Universal sacred order to life. It requires that you walk your authentic path before you pursue your life purpose. When you are on the right path, it ultimately leads you to your purpose.  Your job is to make sure you are in alignment with the right path designated specifically for you**..

**CALCULATING YOUR SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER**

 **Your soul path is the sum total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit** **unless it is a Master Number of 11, 22, 33, 44 …**

**There are several ways to calculate your Soul Life Path Number but the basic way I teach is to add your day, month and year.**

**See Example.**

**MAY 31, 1963 IS SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER 1**

**31** **DAY OF BIRTH**

         **5** **MONTH OF BIRTH**

**1963** **YEAR OF BIRTH**

**TOTAL = 1999 = 1+9+9+9= 28  add 2+8=10 = 1**

**SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER TWO**

**_This is the vibration of two 1’s standing side-by-side. One is masculine and the other one is Feminine. Both seek balance and integration when in relationship to each other, and complement the opposing nature of their differences. Polarized circumstances are frequently put in their path because this is their calling, to seek and understand every angle of a situation without judgment and allowing everything to harmonize in pure existence. They lean toward the tendencies of balance in their life and the outside world._**

**_This energy reflects the gifts of balance, love, romance, beauty, diplomacy, acceptance, justice, liberty, harmony, music, creativity, art, and psychic awareness._**

**_This is the frequency of yin and yang co-mingling in physical, mental, emotional and spiritual bodies. Duality is a doorway that this frequency must walk through both in understanding and in exercising through one’s life. They seek to walk the middle ground in all opposites bringing any differences to neutrality._**

**_Two is the number of duality; the split we perceive in life between light and darkness, inside and outside, yin and yang, masculine and feminine, good and bad, life and death, mind and heart, logic and intuition, and so on._**

**_This number is often called the romantic number, and its essence can be found in the fashion of the Renaissance and in the artwork of Maxfield Parrish. It brings forces together in harmonious balance, creating a bond. You desire to share your beauty with an equal partner because you invariably understand that knowledge comes from the balance and marriage of the two opposites._**

**_You are a natural at balancing polarities, which brings peace when opposites find symmetry. Because you are empathic, you will have to learn about your intuition, sensitivities, and psychic gifts, as well as how to form boundaries and protect your feelings starting at a young age._**

 **_In Egyptian numerology the number two’s highest potential is to establish a state of neutrality and rise above judgement of self and others. The number two symbolizes true partnership and when in balance, it is the number for tranquillity._**

**_They are naturally creative, intuitive and psychic because they have the unique ability to open portals not often found in the human condition. They become the expression of love, beauty and compassion with their unique ability to balance extremes. Their talents often lead them into mastery of artistic endeavors whether it is music, canvas or design. They are often literary magnets with many books in their library and find comfort in writing and expressing themselves with words._**

**_The number two holds the seed of creativity. You create from a song that lingers deep within your heart. You are often blamed for idealism—“People see what they want to see”—and you  
desire the world to see their vision through the eyes of beauty._**

**_You enliven dreams and awaken the imagination. You balance the inner imagination with outer realities, making both aspects more appealing and beneficial. The number two is about creating balance in your life between the yin and yang and with the five elements: earth, water, air, fire, and ether._**

**_As the most feminine among all numbers, she is strong, powerful, resilient, and flexible._**

**_They are diplomats, advisors, counselors and caretakers. One of their biggest life challenges is codependency and possibly addiction. They desire partnership and seek relationships but sometimes lose themselves in the cohesiveness of both. As they mature and can separate themselves as an individual, they have much to teach the outside world._**

**_This frequency develops empathic gifts quite young because it is necessary for them to learn how others feel in order to balance their own emotions, but if they don’t learn how to protect their own energy, addiction to outside substances can be used to comfort complications they are bound to struggle with. Once they overcome their own challenges, it serves to strengthen their experiences and allows them to become ever more powerful adults and teachers._**

# SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER 8    EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/08/10/soul-life-path-number-8-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**FREE E-BOOK AVAILABLE NOW!**

**“INTRODUCTION TO EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY” on my Website @ [http://www.egyptiannumerology.org](http://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

**Your Soul Life Path is ignited by the heartbeat of the eternal drum of life the moment you are born. The drum is symbolic of the circle of life representing vitality, wholeness, completion, wheel of life, perfection, the sacred void, Alpha & Omega, the ouroboros of reincarnation, the infinite representation of Source. and although it is beyond time and space, the closest we can imagine being present within this circle would be a feeling of unconditional love.**

 **The fifth dimension is a state of unconditional love and light that some would refer to as nirvana. This is your natural state of being, without the concept of time and space.** 

**The personified energetic blueprint you create through the birthing process is called your resonance frequency. It is your life path and the vibration the Universe recognizes to spark the fires of your living breath, burning a path that forges and sets the direction for your life’s mission.**

**I believe that we all were originally born out of the center of this sacred zero and decided to experience and express life through the numeric vibrations of our birth dates and names.**

**Everything involving numbers starts and ends with the number zero.  Each number has its own frequency, with defining qualities, personalities, characteristics, and potential,  but we were all meant to ascend back to the comfort of this defining zero at the end of our journey, and for some of us, it has taken many, many lifetimes.**

**Your Soul Life Path describes the direction your life will take, what challenges you will encounter, and the opportunities you will come across. It tells you what your life journey will look like and how you connect with the outside world. The life path and the numbers derived from it (soul urge and achievement numbers) represent the traits and talents you were born with. There are magnetic forces that draw to you various vibrations, events, and circumstances throughout your life, and all of these are influenced by your soul life path number.**

**Every numeric Path has a unique energy pattern that embodies your identity and is represented through symbols, images, or the personal logo of our soul. It is called an archetype. On a psychological, emotional, and spiritual level, we are all multidimensional beings and these archetypes make it easier for your guides and angels to work with you.  When you tap into your signature archetype, you trigger your imagination, the realm between time and space, which becomes the sacred meeting grounds between the worlds.** 

**Your Soul Life Path is your resonant frequency. It is the vibration you signal to the Universe to attract and deliver everything that you need to develop your own archetype or Inner Hero and become the best version of yourself moving forward.  Your “Inner Hero” is your higher-self beckoning you toward your true calling in life, your purpose and reason why you are here. Nobody else can hear this voice but you because it is your calling and meant for your ears only.** 

**There is a Universal sacred order to life. It requires that you walk your authentic path before you pursue your life purpose. When you are on the right path, it ultimately leads you to your purpose.  Your job is to make sure you are in alignment with the right path designated specifically for you**..

**CALCULATING YOUR SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER**

 **Your soul path is the total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit unless it is a Master Number of 11, 22, 33, 44 …**

**There are several ways to calculate your Soul Life Path Number but the basic way I teach is to add your day, month and year.**

**SEE EXAMPLE**

**MAY 31, 1963 IS SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER 1**

**31** **DAY OF BIRTH**

         **5** **MONTH OF BIRTH**

**1963** **YEAR OF BIRTH**

**TOTAL = 1999 = 1+9+9+9= 28  add 2+8=10 = 1**

**SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER EIGHT**

**_Life Path number eight is connected to abundance, prosperity, and financial well-being. resourcefulness, personal power, hard work, determination, and inner strength are all qualities of eight. Spiritually, eight is seen as an equalizer or balancer (hence its shape) that unites the conscious with the unconscious, and earthly realm with the spiritual._**

**_In Egyptian Numerology, the Number Eight is about balancing energy and receiving manifestation through connecting with inner abundance, inner authority, inner strength. and being in integrity with communication._**

**_The eight is widely known as the “abundance number” but more accurately would be the number for “resource or flow” because of the infinity loop the 8 illustrates when turned on its side. In order for the eight’s to access this ability, they must be in integrity with their energy, including the spoken word (communication). The loops in the eight are like a hose; if it is kinked or blocked, the flow of energy will back up and work against you rather than for you._**

**_Eights are like a steel rod from the earth to the sky in a lightning storm. They have the ability to access pure electrical energy when they remain open, flowing and connected to Source. This immense energy gives them the power to create. The cycle of karma, that we receive what we give, is what the number eight is here to learn and once understood and implemented, it naturally grants the eight abundance.  In other words, eight is reflected in the proverb “you will reap what you sow”._**

**_When they make service the centre of their life—sharing money, energy, and wisdom as freely as they are able—they embrace their soul life path at the most elevated level, combining money and worldly power with the power of the heart._**

**_On a very high plane, eights feel the inherent abundance of life, of nature, and of spirit and feel moved to share with others. Their sense of power or control changes to grateful and loving surrender to a greater authority, higher power, or infinite source as manifested in the intricate intelligence and web of life as it unfolds._**

# DESTINY NUMBER 7                   EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/02/14/destiny-number-7-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**Your destiny number describes your potential natural talents and abilities using the numerology arithmancy gathered from the total of the vowels and consonants given at birth, taken from your birth certificate name, and reduced to a single-digit number, unless it is a master number of eleven through ninety-nine.  
Your name has to do with the ways and reasons you project what you do into the world. The various ways we present ourselves in the world are shown by expression, and the choices we make are the aspects of our lives that we can use to mold our futures.  
Your name is your power of choice. The right words define your level of knowledge and experience. They are the keys that open the doors to the life you desire. Words are a control system for our own personal magic. The most powerful word in your personal universe is your name.**

**The power to create the future you want lies within you, and through the knowledge of power in your name, you’ll learn some keys that can help unlock your inner magic.  
Your destiny number embraces the truth of what you came here to do through the power of your heart’s desire number. We want to look at this number and discover the hidden passions,  
talents, and abilities that affect your world and how it is working for you now or how it can work for you in the future.  
Your personality number is your outward expression of yourself and how the world perceives you. It reflects what you are portraying back to you. How do you see yourself and the world  
around you? Are you using your abilities to your highest potential or are you attracting fear, negativity, and darkness? This number plays an important role in your destiny and demands that you stay in integrity with the highest frequency possible in order to conduct yourself in alignment with your destiny.  
Because your destiny is a combination of your heart’s desire number and your expression number, whenever you have a question about the authenticity of your ultimate path in life, look first at these two numbers and check to see if you are serving them in their highest frequency. Your destiny number will only be productive if you are being honest in your heart and showing the world who you truly are.**

**CALCULATING YOUR DESTINY NUMBER**

**The Destiny number is the sum total of the vowels and consonants in your Birth name. Reduce the total to a single digit unless it is a Master Number. Use the arithmancy conversion chart below. The letter Y is used as a consonant except when it is the first letter in a person’s first or last name, such as Yolanda, Yvon, or Yvette. The letter Y is considered a vowel if there are no other vowels in the name, such as Bly or Flynn.**

**EXAMPLE: SANDRA LEE SMITH – Sandra = 1+1+5+4+9+1= 21 (2+1) =3**

**Lee – 3+5+5= 13 (1+3) =4**

**Smith = 1+4+9+2+8 = 24 (2+4) = 6**

**ADD 3+4+6=13 (1+3)=4**

**TOTAL DESTINY NUMBER = 4**

**A J S – 1  
B K T – 2  
C L U – 3  
D M V – 4  
E N W – 5  
F O X – 6  
G P Y – 7  
H Q Z – 8  
I R – 9**

**DESTINY NUMBER 7**

**You are sensitive and intuitive while being** **open to vibrations around you, so your surroundings are very important to you. You are empathic, which can make you guarded at times. When working in your higher frequency, you are a true light worker and light bearer.**

**When you come to trust your feelings, thoughts, instincts, and intuitions and to trust the spirit working through you and everyone else, you will learn to open up to the point of becoming transparent to a spiritual sense of love, wisdom, and justice operating within yourself and the world around you. You will then begin to let your light shine outward instead of protecting  
it, and in this way, you will become an insightful guide for others.**

**You are a reserved, analytical, and peace-loving soul who is blessed with intuition and intelligence. Your ability to concentrate, learn, and absorb information far outshines other numbers, and you often excel at all forms of scholastics. Usually your intellectual prowess as well as your clarity and foresight of mind are evident to others at an early age.**

**Your mind works at the speed of lightning, but often this makes it difficult for others to understand you. Most people simply cannot evaluate or analyze information as fast as you do. Some sevens have such quick minds that they have difficulty expressing themselves.**

**You possess strength, curiosity, and a psychic connection between the spiritual and the physical worlds. Your life destiny is to use your gift of channeling higher wisdom and teach the world what you find to be true in your heart.**

**One of your biggest challenges will be to overcome the fear of being judged by the outside world and to put your faith in knowing that both spirit and nature are one. This is something that you were born to do, and deep down you will struggle until you find your unique outlet that allows you to do this.**

# DESTINY NUMBER 4     EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/01/10/destiny-number-4-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**Your destiny number describes your potential natural talents and abilities using the numerology arithmancy gathered from the sum total of the vowels and consonants given at birth, taken off your birth certificate name, and reduced to a single-digit number, unless it is a master number of eleven through ninety-nine.  
Your name has to do with the ways and reasons you project what you do into the world. The various ways we present ourselves in the world are shown by expression, and the choices we make are the aspects of our lives that we can use to mold our futures.  
Your name is your power of choice. The right words define your level of knowledge and experience. They are the keys that open the doors to the life you desire. Words are a control system for our own personal magic. The most powerful word in your personal universe is your name.**

**The power to create the future you want lies within you, and through the knowledge of power in your name, you’ll learn some keys that can help unlock your inner magic.  
Your destiny number embraces the truth of what you came here to do through the power of your heart’s desire number. We want to look at this number and discover the hidden passions,  
talents, and abilities that affect your world and how it is working for you now or how it can work for you in the future.  
Your personality number is your outward expression of yourself and how the world perceives you. It reflects what you are portraying back to you. How do you see yourself and the world  
around you? Are you using your abilities to your highest potential or are you attracting fear, negativity, and darkness? This number plays an important role in your destiny and demands that you stay in integrity with the highest frequency possible in order to conduct yourself in alignment with your destiny.  
Because your destiny is a combination of your heart’s desire number and your expression number, whenever you have a question about the authenticity of your ultimate path in life, look first at these two numbers and check to see if you are serving them in their highest frequency. Your destiny number will only be productive if you are being honest in your heart and showing the world who you truly are.**

**CALCULATING YOUR DESTINY NUMBER**

**The Destiny number is the sum total of the vowels and consonants in your Birth name. Reduce the total to a single digit unless it is a Master Number. Use the arithmancy conversion chart below. The letter Y is used as a consonant except when it is the first letter in a person’s first or last name, such as Yolanda, Yvon, or Yvette. The letter Y is considered a vowel if there are no other vowels in the name, such as Bly or Flynn.**

**EXAMPLE: SANDRA LEE SMITH – Sandra = 1+1+5+4+9+1= 21 (2+1) =3**

**Lee – 3+5+5= 13 (1+3) =4**

**Smith = 1+4+9+2+8 = 24 (2+4) = 6**

**ADD 3+4+6=13 (1+3)=4**

**TOTAL DESTINY NUMBER = 4**

**A J S – 1  
B K T – 2  
C L U – 3  
D M V – 4  
E N W – 5  
F O X – 6  
G P Y – 7  
H Q Z – 8  
I R –** 9

**DESTINY NUMBER – 4**

**_You are here to build a strong foundation in all areas of your life. Stability, routine, and order are key words for you, and you thrive on all three of these qualities as you implement them into your daily life. You live systematically and have the intuitive nature of knowing how things work. You respect nature as a truthful teacher in helping you understand the inner workings of Your world. Because of this, you have the qualities of a healer and can practice as one if you are willing to take the time to learn these fine arts. More often than not, you become an engineer and choose to work in an occupation of hard labor. Your ultimate destiny is to learn dream materialization and the kind of teamwork that will support, heal, and motivate the world toward peace._**  
**_You are a trustworthy, practical, and down-to-earth individual who places these attributes above materialism and greed. You are a humanist at heart, and your life focus is usually related to manifesting the greater philosophical ideals into practical reality. For this reason, your expectations of yourself and others can rise unusually high. The superpower of this number is of strengthening and matter manipulation. You can stabilize and build in the physical world. The number four is commonly known as the “builder,” but I refer to it as the “cultivator of the elements.” You have a natural ability to see how the four elements (earth, air, water, and fire) work in our world, and you intuitively know how to put them together to create any fruitful situation. You have a natural talent for balancing energy, and this is often shown through the body and disciplines of the athlete. You have a strong and often large energy field, hard-working values, and the endurance of a camel traveling through the desert when you set your intentions on pursuing a project._**

# MASTER NUMBER 22 LIFE PATH  EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/11/25/master-number-22-life-path-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**FREE E-BOOK AVAILABLE NOW!**

**“INTRODUCTION TO EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY” on my Website @ [http://www.egyptiannumerology.org](http://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

**MASTER NUMBERS INTRODUCTION**

**Master Numbers have a sojourn quite different from those of the rest of the population. Their path is called a wounded healer, and many will experience the journey of the dark night of the soul at least once in their lifetimes. In fact, in Egyptian numerology, there are specific past-life insights to all the numbers, but these distinct individuals incarnated to lift the consciousness of humankind through their unique and courageous soul-life agreements.**

**Egyptian numerology lives under the premise that we all made a contract before birth to come into this lifetime to achieve specific goals and walk certain paths, and this information can be decoded through the number frequencies given in our birth dates and names. Under this theory, we chose these specific number vibrations to be born through and all the karmic hardships in our lifetimes so we could overcome these difficulties and help heal the world in qualified areas.**

**All master numbers are endowed with many powers from within, significant strengths, and many more challenges than other numbers. People with these numbers normally realize early in life that they have the capacity to accomplish a great deal with relatively little effort.**

**They contain superpowers hidden within their frequencies and are here to obtain personal power and spiritual evolution and, most of all, to be healers for the wounded through their own personal transformations. They will undergo the difficulties and challenges that only a true spiritual warrior and devotional disciple of higher wisdom could ever dream of combating in one lifetime.**

**People who carry the frequencies of master numbers may experience exceptionally painful, turbulent childhoods and must use these experiences to create a better world because of it and not despite it.**

**If anything, the path of master numbers is more karmic than others because they often must transcend more difficulties than other numbers to excel in the first place. As many of them are original thinkers, they often end up working alone or find themselves in a position to defend ideas against a hostile majority. They deal with obstacles that daunt the stoutest of hearts.**

**Only advanced souls with high spiritual directives choose to be born under these powerful frequencies. Our higher selves, angels, and spirit guides would never allow us to be born under these commanding forces unless convinced that we have the experience, stamina, foresight, and ability to use our potential wisely and for the highest good of all involved.**

**The true power of these numbers lies in the magic of transformation because when they transmute their challenges, they automatically raise the consciousness of the masses. Energetically and on a collective consciousness level, when one person heals from these experiences, it helps to heal hundreds of thousands of victims still held hostage by their  
suffering, fears, inner demons, and conflicts. Therefore, it is considered one of the highest honors given to human existence.**

**Past-life healing and soul awareness let you evolve faster when you heal the wounds that are constantly repeating while moving through this life with more guidance and understanding. That is powerful! In one lifetime, you hold the power to heal hundreds of past, current, and future versions of yourself. Not only that, but in healing yourself and breaking patterns, you release your ancestors and children from suffering these patterns and repair the world in the process.**

**This is literally one of the most profound conditions you are all here to accomplish. You are here to awaken to this potentiometer, clear these lives, and birth a new earth—a place where people are raised in love, awareness, healing, and soul. The beginning of your real-life utopia, new earth, and the salvation of humanity always starts with yourself.**

**CALCULATING YOUR SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER**

 **Your soul path is the total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit unless it is a Master Number of 11, 22, 33, 44 …**

**There are several ways to calculate your Soul Life Path Number but the basic way I teach is to add your day, month and year.**

**SEE EXAMPLE**

**MAY 31, 1963 IS SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER 1**

**31** **DAY OF BIRTH**

         **5** **MONTH OF BIRTH**

**1963** **YEAR OF BIRTH**

**TOTAL = 1999 = 1+9+9+9= 28  add 2+8=10 = 1**

**SOUL LIFE PATH MASTER NUMBER 22/4**

**_All Master Numbers are incarnated with the potential of being Wounded Healers. The 22 has all the elements of Master Number 11 and in addition, has the personal ambition to manifest._**

**_Because the lower equation of the master number 22 Is the number 4, this person must establish grounding in most areas of their life. They must learn the freedom found within stability, order, strength, and routine. The number 4 in a Master Number learns the qualities of courage before merging into the full mastery of their 22 powers.  Courage requires stepping outside your comfort zones and trusting your intuition enough to take action against all odds._**

**_Not all acts of courage need an audience. There are the spiritual acts of bravery that we succumb to when nobody is looking. These are quiet moments in seclusion when you surrender to your own truth and commit to a level of consciousness beyond your previous comprehension. It usually involves the shedding of old skin, willingness to surrender old beliefs, fears of the unknown, and willingness to grow wings to become a butterfly—the kind of courage that a caterpillar requires in the chrysalis process. It is a sojourn journey._**

**_Perfectionism runs deep within the fibers of their being and learning how to let go of control and allow the sacred natural order of the universe to be in the driver’s seat will ease the burdens of your creative process._**

**_When you work in tandem with Spirit, you deliver exceptional creative abilities and display your unique powers in the form of productivity and order. When in alignment with pure Source, your gift of manifestation spreads its wings to include family, friends, community, and humanity at large._**

**_Your path is to stay focused, learn to channel higher wisdom, and build your grandest castle that will serve the greater good. The master number twenty-two contains the superpower of dream materialization with incredible perception and intuition, with access to a dream/vision world, and the ability to ground it down into reality through a system of rounded tangible effort, work, and action._** 

**_You get intuitive insights that guide you like the North Star in the physical world. Be the dream materialization architect by taking your vision and solidifying it in the physical world so all of us can enjoy a new foundation and way of experiencing living life. You uniquely create your own reality. You must follow your North Star and dare to be different. You are the trailblazer, trendsetter, and master builder who possess certain gifts, strengths, and weaknesses others do not._** 

**_Whatever this number thinks about is almost sure to become a reality; therefore, it is exceedingly important to choose your thoughts carefully. If you are willing to work for what you desire, you can achieve enormous prestige, success, and fame and are endowed with many exceptional powers. You have a unique talent for manifesting ideas into the realm of reality._**

**_Master Number 22, known as the Master Cultivator, relating to balance, confidence, creativity, and bringing big ideas to life in the sense of productivity. Those with Master Number 22/4 are able to make their dreams a reality by harnessing unlimited potential. These individuals are hard-working, practical, and have the confidence to bring their intentions to fruition._**

**If you like what you read, please support this blog. Thank you, Sara**

# SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER SIX     EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/06/18/soul-life-path-number-six-egyptian-numerology-2/#content)

**FREE E-BOOK AVAILABLE NOW!**

**“INTRODUCTION TO EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY” on my Website @ [http://www.egyptiannumerology.org](http://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

**Your Soul Life Path is ignited by the heartbeat of the eternal drum of life the moment we are born. The drum is symbolic of the circle of life representing vitality, wholeness, completion, wheel of life, perfection, the sacred void, Alpha & Omega, the ouroboros of reincarnation, the infinite representation of Source. and although it is beyond time and space, the closest we can imagine being present within this circle would be a feeling of unconditional love.**

 **The fifth dimension is a state of unconditional love and light that some would refer to as nirvana. This is your natural state of being, without the concept of time and space.** 

**The personified energetic blueprint you create through the birthing process is called your resonance frequency. It is your life path and the vibration the Universe recognizes to spark the fires of your living breath, burning a path that forges and sets the direction for your life’s mission.**

**I believe that we all were originally born out of the center of this sacred zero and decided to experience and express life through the numeric vibrations of our birth dates and names.**

**Everything involving numbers starts and ends with the number zero.  Each number has its own frequency, with defining qualities, personalities, characteristics, and potential,  but we were all meant to ascend back to the comfort of this defining zero at the end of our journey, and for some of us, it has taken many, many lifetimes.**

**Your soul path describes the direction your life will take, what challenges you will encounter, and the opportunities you will come across. It tells you what your life journey will look like and how you connect with the outside world. The life path and the numbers derived from it (soul urge and achievement numbers) represent the traits and talents you were born with. There are magnetic forces that draw to you various vibrations, events, and circumstances throughout your life, and all of these are influenced by your soul life path number.**

**Every numeric Path has a unique energy pattern that embodies your identity and is represented through symbols, images, or the personal logo of our soul. It is called an archetype. On a psychological, emotional, and spiritual level, we are all multidimensional beings and these archetypes make it easier for your guides and angels to work with you.  When you tap into your signature archetype, you trigger your imagination, the realm between time and space, which becomes the sacred meeting grounds between the worlds.** 

**Your Soul Life Path is your resonant frequency. It is the vibration you signal to the Universe to attract and deliver everything that you need to develop your own archetype or Inner Hero and become the best version of yourself moving forward.  Your “Inner Hero” is your higher-self beckoning you toward your true calling in life, your purpose and reason why you are here. Now and nobody else can hear this voice but you because it is your calling and meant for your ears only.** 

**There is a Universal sacred order to life. It requires that you walk your authentic path before you pursue your life purpose. When you are on the right path, it ultimately leads you to your purpose.  Your job is to make sure you are in alignment with the right path designated specifically for you**..

**CALCULATING YOUR SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER**

 **Your soul path is the sum total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit** **unless it is a Master Number of 11, 22, 33, 44 …**

**There are several ways to calculate your Soul Life Path Number but the basic way I teach is to add your day, month and year.**

**See Example.**

**MAY 31, 1963 IS SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER 1**

**31** **DAY OF BIRTH**

         **5** **MONTH OF BIRTH**

**1963** **YEAR OF BIRTH**

**TOTAL = 1999 = 1+9+9+9= 28  add 2+8=10 = 1**

**SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER SIX**

**_Life Path number six represents a balance between the earthly and spiritual realms. It points to developing your intuitive gifts and is connected to clairvoyance, and our other extrasensory capacities (hence the “sixth” sense)._**

**_In Egyptian Numerology, the Number Six is called the “Light House”. When connected to Source, their purpose is to channel Higher wisdom and learn to trust their intuition. When they do this, they form a sacred bond allowing them to relay messages from the Higher realms._**

**_In sacred geometry, the number six represents harmony and balance. It embodies the qualities of love, commitment, and purpose._**

**_Like the perfect honeycomb, the six- sided hexagon is formed by the interlocking of two triangles, the upward pointing triangle represents masculine energy and the downward facing triangle represents feminine energy._**

**_The number six is also associated with the sixth chakra, the third eye, which governs seeing, intuition, imagination, dreams, and access to  the subconscious mind._**

**_You have the ability to heal others, and heal the world, but only after you complete the process of healing yourself first. Only then will you create true abundance, make a massive difference in the lives of others, and become a beacon of light in your current reality._**

**_The number six has a truly outstanding sense of responsibility, love, and balance. They are helpful and ever conscientious, making them quite capable of rectifying and balancing any sort of inharmonious situation. They are inclined to give help and comfort to those in need. They have a natural penchant for working with the old, the dying, the sick, or the underprivileged._**

**_Although they may have considerable creative and artistic talents, the chances are that they will devote themselves to an occupation that shows concern for the betterment of the community._**

**_The most precious lesson for those on the number six path is to learn how to heal themselves with the same love and compassion that they give to others. They will be dealing with relationship issues in this life, and it’s the relationship with themselves, with the higher power of their understanding, and then with another person. In this order!_**

# EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY; SOUL URGE NUMBER SIX – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2019/11/16/egyptian-numerology-soul-urge-number-six/#content)

[VISIT EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY WEBSITE: www.egyptiannumerology.org](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)

**WHAT IS A SOUL URGE NUMBER?**

**_Your Soul Urge Number is your exact Day of Birth in Egyptian Numerology. It describes your character behaviors, souls passions, gifts, abilities, and talents. It can be the chief instigator to the success associated with your Life Path Number. This frequency is what your soul has been urging you to accomplish in this lifetime._**

**_So let’s take a look at how the Soul Urge number is associated with your Soul Life Path Number. I previously described your Soul Life Path as the direction that you chose to take in this lifetime and your Soul Urge describes the lens in which you have chosen to view the world while you are on your path._**

**_Your Soul Urge is the fire underneath your feet and the chief motivator you use to adjust the sails in the direction of your destination. It is an important factor to understand when staying in alignment with your Soul Life Mission because once you understand your Soul Urge and Soul Life Path relationship you gain respect for the true warrior that you are._**

**_When you use these tools for your advantage, you know what you have to offer the world and where you need to ask for help. You become the master of your fate and the captain of your ship. When I work with members in my 90 Day Mentor-ship Program, we take a look at your Soul Life Path and where you are standing in the present moment and all the factors that you got you here. We then take a look at where you are being called to go and what might be blocking your path and why._**

**_Your Soul Urge number will tell us what you need to understand about yourself in order to achieve the best possible results for your future. Once you adjust your sails and remove the debris from your path, we call upon the wind (Spirit) to move you forward toward your highest destiny._**

**SOUL URGE NUMBER 6**

“**LIGHT KEEPER”**

**_Intuiti_**_**ve, Sensitive, Empathic, and Connection**_

**_Everyone is born empathic but the people born under the influence of the number 6 carry these abilities to a higher extreme. Being empathic means that you have extraordinary sensitivities, intuition, and psychic abilities._**

**_These abilities can be stronger than logic and reason which makes it difficult to explain your personal power to those who do not have these qualities._**

**_Being a psychic empath, essentially means that you have the strong ability to feel the emotions, energy, feelings, and even the mental state (thoughts) of others naturally._**

**_Regardless of the specific focus of your psychic tendencies, your empathic abilities may lead you to investigate a type of clairsentience or clear feeling._**

**_You are prone to being a sponge or magnet to outside energies and if not protected, you can easily take on energy that does not belong to you and wonder why you are feeling “off” when around groups of people._**

**_You are spiritually guided to help people but sometimes at the cost of your own well-being. In this lifetime, you are here to learn to love and care for yourself first, connect to a higher Source light, and then extend your gifts out toward others. In this Order!_**

**_This number invites celestial music and contains the divine inspiration for all arts. Born empathic and an open channel for the healing touch of Source, caring for others is your natural calling and you hold the qualities of the light keeper._**

**_When they are connected to Higher Source, they have the gift and ability to heal others with their words of wisdom and medicinal touch._**

**LEARN MORE:**

In Egyptian Numerology, there are 3 major Numeric calculations from your Birth Date that reveals your innate gifts, talents, and potential. These specific attributes were chosen by you before birth to support you on your Soul Life Path and journey. When you discover, align, and develop these Super-Powers, you are on the road to becoming your very own Inner Hero. These powers are a part of you and will lay dormant until activated.

# MASTER NUMBERS IN EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/06/24/master-numbers-in-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**FREE E-BOOK AVAILABLE NOW!**

**“INTRODUCTION TO EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY”**

**on my Website @ [http://www.egyptiannumerology.org](http://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

**In Numerology, when you see double-digit numbers that repeat the same number (such as 11, 22, 33 and so on), these are known as Master Numbers.  Many Numerologist’s only observe Master Numbers: 11, 22, and sometimes 33 when they work with your core numbers in your chart.** 

**In Egyptian Numerology, we work with all the Master Numbers including 11 through 99. In my book “Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the Fifth Dimension,” I go into detail describing the meaning within ALL the Master Numbers.**

**To find if you have a Master Number in your Core Chart, make sure you do not reduce the total down to a single digit number if you see numbers repeat themselves. In Egyptian Numerology, it is also important to register the lower number of the Master Number such as; 11/2, 22/4, 33/6, 44/8 etc…**

**You can refer to my Blog Posts regarding individual Master Numbers.**

**If you find Master Numbers anywhere in your chart, you’ll benefit from learning more about what this means for you. In Egyptian Numerology, you can have a Master Number in almost all the placements of your chart except your Karmic Lesson. The placements/ levels of your Chart include; Soul Urge, Achievement, Quintessence Code (time of birth), Life Path, Karmic Lesson, Life Purpose, Heart’s Desire, Personality, and Destiny numbers. There are more advanced levels such as; Personal Year, Inner Guidance, Conscious Creator, and Life Cycles.**

**One of the biggest conceits in numerology is the subscription to the idea that being a master number is somehow better than being any one of the other numbers. It is also a myth to think that the master number is luckier, more powerful, or has an easier time of life than other numbers.**

**If anything, the path of a master number is more karmic than others because they often have to transcend more difficulties than other numbers in order to excel in the first place. As many of them are original thinkers, they end up working alone or find themselves in a position to defend ideas against a hostile majority. They deal with obstacles that would daunt the stoutest of hearts, including physical disabilities, mental afflictions, and very difficult childhoods.**

**The truth is that you chose a master number and all the karmic hardships in this lifetime so you could overcome these difficulties and help heal the world in these specific areas. While you are still working the lower aspect of the master number and experiencing the healing process, you may not be completely aware of this, but somewhere deep down inside of you is an awareness that you are here to help serve humanity on a deep and profound level. All of this will begin to become clear when the higher part of the master number grows and fully matures.**

**Those carrying these powerful forces do not fully mature into their energy until the age of forty or older. Until then, you are working through the lessons of the lower number in the equation. These lessons are a prerequisite, and necessary to fully establish the enormous power offered by the higher number.**

**If the lessons are not learned before the master number activates, there are always difficulties and challenges in handling the energy. The universe will thrust you into circumstances demanding that you grow. You set up timelines, cycles, people, places, and events to occur in order to keep you aligned with your mission and your purpose, and those who chose to be wounded healers will intuitively know that they are here to do big things.**

**If you choose not to utilize the higher number after maturity. The problem with not moving forward into a master number vibration is often a lingering feeling of being stuck. Physical ailments caused by the resistance to move forward can result in depression if ignored for a long period.**

**The higher part of a master number will be activated during the second part of your life. You may feel the undercurrents of this number starting at a young age, but the actual power and abilities of the master number won’t mature until you do. I am not talking just about physical maturation but the spiritual growth processes necessary to activate the higher frequencies; these must coincide with emotional and spiritual involvement as well.**

**Almost all master numbers (especially 11/2’s and 22/4’s) experience exceptionally painful, turbulent childhoods and have to use these experiences to make a world a better place because of it and not despite it. All master numbers are endowed with many special powers, significant strengths, and many more challenges not available to single-digit numbers.**

**They normally realize early in life that they have the capacity to accomplish a great deal with relatively little effort. Master Numbers contain superpowers specifically in their Soul Life Path placement. These people are here to obtain personal power and spiritual evolution but most of all to be healers for the wounded… because they have survived the wrath of the Wounded Healer.**

**Learn more about the Master Numbers in your Core Chart through my Books**

**“Egyptian Numerology; Emergence into the Fifth Dimension” and “The Path of a Wounded Healer; Liberation is for the Asking,” Both books are available on Amazon and my Website**

**[www.egyptiannumerology.org](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

**If you like what you read, please support this blog. Thank you, Sara**

# DESTINY NUMBER 3    EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/01/04/destiny-number-3-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**Your destiny number describes your potential natural talents and abilities using the numerology arithmancy gathered from the sum total of the vowels and consonants given at birth, taken off your birth certificate name, and reduced to a single-digit number, unless it is a master number of eleven through ninety-nine.  
Your name has to do with the ways and reasons you project what you do into the world. The various ways we present ourselves in the world are shown by expression, and the choices we make are the aspects of our lives that we can use to mold our futures.  
Your name is your power of choice. The right words define your level of knowledge and experience. They are the keys that open the doors to the life you desire. Words are a control system for our own personal magic. The most powerful word in your personal universe is your name.**

**The power to create the future you want lies within you, and through the knowledge of power in your name, you’ll learn some keys that can help unlock your inner magic.  
Your destiny number embraces the truth of what you came here to do through the power of your heart’s desire number. We want to look at this number and discover the hidden passions,  
talents, and abilities that affect your world and how it is working for you now or how it can work for you in the future.  
Your personality number is your outward expression of yourself and how the world perceives you. It reflects what you are portraying back to you. How do you see yourself and the world  
around you? Are you using your abilities to your highest potential or are you attracting fear, negativity, and darkness? This number plays an important role in your destiny and demands that you stay in integrity with the highest frequency possible in order to conduct yourself in alignment with your destiny.  
Because your destiny is a combination of your heart’s desire number and your expression number, whenever you have a question about the authenticity of your ultimate path in life, look first at these two numbers and check to see if you are serving them in their highest frequency. Your destiny number will only be productive if you are being honest in your heart and showing the world who you truly are.**

**CALCULATING YOUR DESTINY NUMBER**

**The Destiny number is the sum total of the vowels and consonants in your Birth name. Reduce the total to a single digit unless it is a Master Number. Use the arithmancy conversion chart below. The letter Y is used as a consonant except when it is the first letter in a person’s first or last name, such as Yolanda, Yvon, or Yvette. The letter Y is considered a vowel if there are no other vowels in the name, such as Bly or Flynn.**

**EXAMPLE: SANDRA LEE SMITH – Sandra = 1+1+5+4+9+1= 21 (2+1) =3**

**Lee – 3+5+5= 13 (1+3) =4**

**Smith = 1+4+9+2+8 = 24 (2+4) = 6**

**ADD 3+4+6=13 (1+3)=4**

**TOTAL DESTINY NUMBER = 4**

**A J S – 1  
B K T – 2  
C L U – 3  
D M V – 4  
E N W – 5  
F O X – 6  
G P Y – 7  
H Q Z – 8  
I R –** 9

**DESTINY NUMBER – 3**

**_You are here to express yourself artistically and to use your gift of communication to connect joyfully with others. You bring light and love into our world like the sun breaking through clouds of gray. You are here to help others realize the power of joy, laughter, and imagination. By helping others who may have lost the joy of living learn to appreciate life and live it to its fullest, you will find your own joy and fulfillment. Expressing yourself creatively is the key to making this happen._**  
**_The number three is the vibration for self-expression and creativity. Individuals working this number are here to utilize their emotional sensitivity to bring positive, heartfelt self-expression  
into the world. Emotional self-expression is the sharing of their authentic feelings honestly and directly while encouraging others to do the same. The emotional connection you can feel to life and to others generates a rising energy that, once expressed, can uplift everyone around you. These individuals have the potential to revel in emotions the way a butterfly flutters through the air._**  
**_At the highest levels, you serve as an open channel of loving energy, arousing others toward joy and inspiration, becoming a force of light in our world. This number governs music, the arts,  
voice, writing, performing, singing, dancing, painting, and being fully engaged as a free-feeling, compassionate human being. You have the ability to bring life into perspective while knowing that laughter is the ultimate and spontaneous healer for everyone._**

# HOW TO HEAR AND FOLLOW YOUR CALLING WITH LIONS GATE ACTIVATION – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2023/07/27/how-to-hear-and-follow-your-calling-with-lions-gate-activation/#content)

**In numerology, the 8th day of the 8th month is a proclaimed spiritual and activated event in our calendar year. The Lions Gate is a time of enhanced and increased cosmic energy flowing between the physical and spiritual realms. Energetically, Lionsgate opens the energy portal for the new year.** 

**That’s right! This activation is not an ordinary occurrence. At this time of year, you are granted the ability to instantly manifest and alter your reality.**   

**Lions Gate is connected to ancient Egypt and for thousands of years was observed, honored, and revered as a time of great energetic influx. This gateway is marked by an alignment between the Earth and the star Sirius. As Sirius rises in the sky, Orion’s Belt directly aligns with the Pyramid of Giza and is considered a sacred occasion and marked the start of the new year in many cultures.** 

**The ancients believed it was a doorway to heaven and a central station for higher vibrational beings. They understood that the energy of this star carried highly advanced wisdom that could be intercepted when Sirius was strong in the sky.** 

**The opening of the Lionsgate 88 Portal is activated from July 27th until August 12, and can be a catalyst to your spiritual journey. It can bring awakenings, lift your consciousness to new heights, download light codes, encourage self-mastery, align with multiple levels of activations, and provides opportunities for progression on your ascension path.**  

**Those of you who follow me, know that Egyptian Numerology is not only about numbers, but also a philosophy, way of life, and commitment to living your highest potential using Numerology as your North Star.** 

**Numbers are light codes, symbols, vibrations, and energy. Like us they are subject to constant upgrades.** 

**The information we had about numbers a decade ago just won’t apply to us today because we are not the same people, we were 10 years ago. We’ve grown and expanded with the ebb and flow of the unending tides and the wisdom in numbers is rapidly downloading in the form of light codes. The universe is in constant flux…ever changing, ever evolving, and always moving in a forward motion.** 

**Consciousness is like a ladder you climb one rung at a time. You cannot miss a step or you will eventually have to go back and repeat it.**  

**We must graduate from levels of consciousness and master those dimensions before moving onto the next one.  You cannot get to the 5th dimension unless you evolve through the 4th and so on.** 

 **Egyptian Numerology serves as a higher dimensional vision placement. It helps people understand their greatest potential using Number Frequencies connected to their birth time, date, and name. If we can imagine it, we can create it.** 

**Over the past 18 months, I have been working with clients that are anxious to be in alignment with their soul mission.**  

**They know they have a calling. They know they have a purpose and feel compelled to get closer to this vision.** 

**But the vision isn’t always so clear… it comes with questions, uncertainty, and confusion.** 

 **Recent events have brought changes, shifts, and the opening of new portals leading to vital information.**  

**Besides dealing with all this new energy, the way of believing and experiencing life also must be digested and brought into alignment with your ordination.**  

**The Lionsgate activation is the perfect time to align with your true calling in life. It brings the surge you need to act. It is not a coincidence that this powerful energy comes forward at this time of year.**  

**You are being given an opportunity to advance further on your creative expedition.**  

**Every time you change your perception, every area of your life is altered, and you affect the collective. You must allow for a grounding to take place before your reality becomes clear.** 

**As soon as you integrate your new viewpoint, another perception comes to light. Right? The process goes on and on….** 

**What you are experiencing at this point on your spiritual journey is having to make personal revisions at a rapid pace to keep up with your spiritual calling.**   

**What worked for us last year won’t necessarily work for us this year. We are constantly moving forward in the way we conduct ourselves.** 

**On Tuesday August 1st and August 8th,  at 1:00 MST. I will be offering a 2-part seminar called**

**_“How to Hear your Calling”_** and **_“How to Follow your calling.”_** 

**In these presentations, I will explain the challenges you are being confronted with and the adjustments that you will have to make. I will show you how to anchor your vocation into the material world and give you the encouragement to manifest your life purpose.**  

**These presentations are for individuals that know they are here for a specific reason but may not know how to interpret what they are hearing. It is also for established spiritual healers that might feel that there is more that they should be doing (and there is), and it is for those who are just curious about what is next on their soul journey.**

**BECAUSE:** 

**YOUR LIFE HAS PURPOSE** !

**YOUR STORY IS IMPORTANT** !

**YOUR DREAMS COUNT** !

**YOUR VOICE MATTERS** !

**AND YOU WERE BORN TO MAKE AN IMPACT!** 

All of this coincides with the Lions Gate Activations (8/8/23). 

Join us by subscribing to **[www.egyptiannumerology.org](http://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)** or you can register by using the link below.  

**REGISTER FOR FREE SEMINAR LINK**

**If you desire more clarity about your vocation in life, please schedule an Egyptian Numerology Chart reading with me off my website or using the link below.**

# MASTER NUMBER 33 LIFE PATH  EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/12/23/master-number-33-life-path-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**FREE E-BOOK AVAILABLE NOW!**

**“INTRODUCTION TO EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY” on my Website @ [http://www.egyptiannumerology.org](http://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

**MASTER NUMBERS INTRODUCTION**

**Master Numbers have a sojourn quite different from those of the rest of the population. Their path is called a wounded healer, and many will experience the journey of the dark night of the soul at least once in their lifetimes. In fact, in Egyptian numerology, there are specific past-life insights to all the numbers, but these distinct individuals incarnated to lift the consciousness of humankind through their unique and courageous soul-life agreements.**

**Egyptian numerology lives under the premise that we all made a contract before birth to come into this lifetime to achieve specific goals and walk certain paths, and this information can be decoded through the number frequencies given in our birth dates and names. Under this theory, we chose these specific number vibrations to be born through and all the karmic hardships in our lifetimes so we could overcome these difficulties and help heal the world in qualified areas.**

**All master numbers are endowed with many powers from within, significant strengths, and many more challenges than other numbers. People with these numbers normally realize early in life that they have the capacity to accomplish a great deal with relatively little effort.**

**They contain superpowers hidden within their frequencies and are here to obtain personal power and spiritual evolution and, most of all, to be healers for the wounded through their own personal transformations. They will undergo the difficulties and challenges that only a true spiritual warrior and devotional disciple of higher wisdom could ever dream of combating in one lifetime.**

**People who carry the frequencies of master numbers may experience exceptionally painful, turbulent childhoods and must use these experiences to create a better world because of it and not despite it.**

**If anything, the path of master numbers is more karmic than others because they often must transcend more difficulties than other numbers to excel in the first place. As many of them are original thinkers, they often end up working alone or find themselves in a position to defend ideas against a hostile majority. They deal with obstacles that daunt the stoutest of hearts.**

**Only advanced souls with high spiritual directives choose to be born under these powerful frequencies. Our higher selves, angels, and spirit guides would never allow us to be born under these commanding forces unless convinced that we have the experience, stamina, foresight, and ability to use our potential wisely and for the highest good of all involved.**

**The true power of these numbers lies in the magic of transformation because when they transmute their challenges, they automatically raise the consciousness of the masses. Energetically and on a collective consciousness level, when one person heals from these experiences, it helps to heal hundreds of thousands of victims still held hostage by their  
suffering, fears, inner demons, and conflicts. Therefore, it is considered one of the highest honors given to human existence.**

**Past-life healing and soul awareness let you evolve faster when you heal the wounds that are constantly repeating while moving through this life with more guidance and understanding. That is powerful! In one lifetime, you hold the power to heal hundreds of past, current, and future versions of yourself. Not only that, but in healing yourself and breaking patterns, you release your ancestors and children from suffering these patterns and repair the world in the process.**

**This is literally one of the most profound conditions you are all here to accomplish. You are here to awaken to this potentiometer, clear these lives, and birth a new earth—a place where people are raised in love, awareness, healing, and soul. The beginning of your real-life utopia, new earth, and the salvation of humanity always starts with yourself.**

**CALCULATING YOUR SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER**

 **Your soul path is the total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit unless it is a Master Number of 11, 22, 33, 44 …**

**There are several ways to calculate your Soul Life Path Number but the basic way I teach is to add your day, month and year.**

**SEE EXAMPLE**

**MAY 31, 1963 IS SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER 1**

**31** **DAY OF BIRTH**

         **5** **MONTH OF BIRTH**

**1963** **YEAR OF BIRTH**

**TOTAL = 1999 = 1+9+9+9= 28  add 2+8=10 = 1**

**SOUL LIFE PATH MASTER NUMBER 33/6**

**Sensitivity, Empathy, Intuition, Awareness and Creativity are your strongest gifts if you hold this Master Number as your Life Path.**

**Water is an important element to the number 33. Water is a cleansing component very helpful to people with high sensitivity. It helps to wash your energy field, clear your chakras, and calm your nervous system.**

**It is a huge responsibility for this master Number to empower their sensitivity and empathic abilities by taking responsibility for their energy.**

**Besides being a channel for spirit, you express yourself best through teaching others. Your superpower is that of communication and self expression.** I **often call the Master Number 33/6 the “Spirit Dancer.”**

**You have a childlike wonder and curiosity that is filled with joy, love, and beauty. Your intuition and empathy keep you connected to your friends, family, and community. We may find you in the healing, advising, or creative fields, where caring and nurturing others predominates your other skills.**

  
**I call the number six the “lighthouse” because it is a beacon of light here on Earth, attracting others toward the truth and ingenuity of their own divine nature. Master number thirty-three adds up to the number six and in its purest form is a higher manifestation of the number six. The qualities of the six frequency are what you will be experiencing until you mature (around the age of forty years or older) and will evolve into the magic properties of the thirty-three.**

**Those on the number 6 path are being asked to come back into their authentic path and be true to themselves in several avenues. This is influenced by Chiron, a comet that orbits the Sun, revealing their power to process trauma and suffering so that they can in turn heal** **others. Chiron represents the saying “Heal thyself” and points to the  
wounded healer**.

**These people are often masked as light workers. A light worker is essentially a person, a soul who incarnates into physical form and is dedicated to shining light into the world. He or she anchors the higher dimensional light of Spirit and Divine into the physical realm to help others usher forth transformation on earth. They are here to bring earth out of darkness and into greater levels of light, connection, peace, harmony, and authenticity.**

**Light workers are driven to understand the world better by seeking out extreme experiences. Many are wounded healers and have experienced the dark night of the soul at least once in their lifetimes.** **With these experiences comes great empathy, which causes them to feel what others feel very deeply. This gives them leverage to develop their healing abilities to fulfill their true purpose in their lifetimes.**

**They often do not fit into traditional authority models or modern workplace structures, and they do not feel comfortable in them. This is largely due to their antiauthoritarian nature. Internally, they have a strong resistance to anything that places value on the dark side of power or hierarchy, and this prompts a rebellious response from them.**

**  
Expression, beauty, and development are important to them, and they gravitate to energy outlets such as writing or the arts to release their creative nature and serve as a voice for humanity. It is common for them to be drawn into activities that nurture their spirituality, and this can be anything from meditating or spending time in nature to reading self-help books.**

**When light workers are enlightened and self-actualized, they recognize this drive as their true purpose in life and find their own fulfillment in guiding themselves and others toward spiritual insights.**

  
**Thirty-three is the number of the master teacher and healer. This energy brings the following statement to light: “We are the ones we’ve been waiting for.”**

**Yours is the path of divine expression and the power of the spoken word. The master number thirty-three guides, heals, directs, and restores people with its altruistic powers and rather high energy. You have the gift of imagination, dream materialization, and illumination, which are the accumulations of all three master numbers combined.**

**Einstein said, “Imagination is everything. It is the preview of life’s coming attractions.” Your soul life path includes raising awareness and consciousness, uplifting and bringing joyful loving energy to the world. By balancing your thirty-three energy here on Earth, you are bringing the world to the state of order.**

**If you like what you read, please support this blog. Thank you, Sara**

**“INTRODUCTION TO EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY” on my Website @ [http://www.egyptiannumerology.org](http://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
