**Your Soul Life Path is ignited by the heartbeat of the eternal drum of life the moment you are born. The drum is symbolic of the circle of life representing vitality, wholeness, completion, wheel of life, perfection, the sacred void, Alpha & Omega, the ouroboros of reincarnation, the infinite representation of Source. and although it is beyond time and space, the closest we can imagine being present within this circle would be a feeling of unconditional love.**

 **The fifth dimension is a state of unconditional love and light that some would refer to as nirvana. This is your natural state of being, without the concept of time and space.** 

**The personified energetic blueprint you create through the birthing process is called your resonance frequency. It is your life path and the vibration the Universe recognizes to spark the fires of your living breath, burning a path that forges and sets the direction for your life’s mission.**

**I believe that we all were originally born out of the center of this sacred zero and decided to experience and express life through the numeric vibrations of our birth dates and names.**

**Everything involving numbers starts and ends with the number zero.  Each number has its own frequency, with defining qualities, personalities, characteristics, and potential,  but we were all meant to ascend back to the comfort of this defining zero at the end of our journey, and for some of us, it has taken many, many lifetimes.**

**Your Soul Life Path describes the direction your life will take, what challenges you will encounter, and the opportunities you will come across. It tells you what your life journey will look like and how you connect with the outside world. The life path and the numbers derived from it (soul urge and achievement numbers) represent the traits and talents you were born with. There are magnetic forces that draw to you various vibrations, events, and circumstances throughout your life, and all of these are influenced by your soul life path number.**

**Every numeric Path has a unique energy pattern that embodies your identity and is represented through symbols, images, or the personal logo of our soul. It is called an archetype. On a psychological, emotional, and spiritual level, we are all multidimensional beings and these archetypes make it easier for your guides and angels to work with you.  When you tap into your signature archetype, you trigger your imagination, the realm between time and space, which becomes the sacred meeting grounds between the worlds.** 

**Your Soul Life Path is your resonant frequency. It is the vibration you signal to the Universe to attract and deliver everything that you need to develop your own archetype or Inner Hero and become the best version of yourself moving forward.  Your “Inner Hero” is your higher-self beckoning you toward your true calling in life, your purpose and reason why you are here. Nobody else can hear this voice but you because it is your calling and meant for your ears only.** 

**There is a Universal sacred order to life. It requires that you walk your authentic path before you pursue your life purpose. When you are on the right path, it ultimately leads you to your purpose.  Your job is to make sure you are in alignment with the right path designated specifically for you**..

**CALCULATING YOUR SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER**

 **Your soul path is the sum total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit unless it is a Master Number of 11, 22, 33, 44 …**

**There are several ways to calculate your Soul Life Path Number but the basic way I teach is to add your day, month and year.**

**See Example.**

**MAY 31, 1963 IS SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER 1**

**31** **DAY OF BIRTH**

         **5** **MONTH OF BIRTH**

**1963** **YEAR OF BIRTH**

**TOTAL = 1999 = 1+9+9+9= 28  add 2+8=10 = 1**

**SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER** **SEVEN**

**_If you have a Life Path number 7, my name for you is the “Stargazer.” You have a unique connection to the solar system and are closely linked to the paranormal, and our relationship with ancient civilizations. You are known as the historian, geographic tracer, planetary assistant, and the keeper of sacred rites.  You are intelligent, psychic, intuitive, and channel for higher wisdom. Your nervous system is highly sensitive, and your path thrives on nature being the ultimate teacher of the universe._**

**_It symbolizes wisdom and our first cycle number, the first seven years of our lives. It is a symbol of birth and rebirth, religious strength, sacred vows, path of solitude, analysis, and contemplation. The number 7 is known as the “seeker” because it promotes channeling abilities by releasing the intellect and opening to the higher realms._** 

**_You are a spiritual number and believe wholeheartedly in the relationship between Mother Nature and science. You possess strength, curiosity, and a psychic connection between the spiritual and the physical worlds. Your intelligence and intuition often lead you to being in the right place at the right time._**

**_You can be reserved, analytical, and a peace-loving soul who is blessed with intuition and intelligence. Your ability to concentrate, learn, and absorb information far outshines other numbers, and you often excel at all forms of scholastics. Usually, your intellectual prowess as well as the clarity and foresight of mind are evident to others at an early age._**

**_Egyptian numerology states that number sevens often feel as if they don’t fit in socially, and this is due to the fact that they have not had many lives on this planet. On a deep level, they long to go home. The lives they have had on this planet were in advanced civilizations such as Atlantis, Lemuria, Mu, Babylon, Greece, Peru, and Egypt—and they met their untimely demise there._**

 **_All of your gifts and abilities make you a truly interesting person to be around. It would not be uncommon to find you in the field of science, research, nature, healing, geography, history, or astronomy. Overcome your fear of being judged by the outside world and put your faith in the knowledge that both spirit and nature are one. This is something you were born to do, and deep down you will struggle until you find your unique outlet that allows you to do this._**

**If you like what you read, please support this blog. Thank you, Sara**

**MAY 31, 1963 IS SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER 1**

**SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER ONE**

**_The number one is a direct line from the earth to the sky, making a clear conduit or channel for focus, awareness, intuition, creativity, and independence. Your expression is that of forming your individuality and personal attainment in this lifetime. You are learning to be strong and stand your ground. You tend to be physically healthier and mentally stronger than most people are_**. 

**_The life path number one serves as a conduit between Spirit and matter using electrical currents when connected to Source. The power of this energy is known to be innovative, creative, and strengthens intuition. It is the protector of free thinkers, guardian of the people and environment, and the inventor. It seeks authenticity, confidence, laser focus and deep concentration._**

**_Number one is like a straight arrow which reflects willpower and precision. It embodies the qualities of individuality, self-discovery, and self-empowerment. Unlike the energy of the  zero, which is feminine and receptive, the number one has a masculine and willful energy. One symbolizes leadership, creativity, strength, and confidence. The higher attribute for this frequency is interdependence._**

**_One can be a lonely number because of your drive for independence and the need to learn self-sustenance which has been installed in your DNA since birth. You have creative inspiration and possess the enthusiasm and drive to accomplish a great many things, and you will be less lonely when you share your knowledge, creativity, and interests with others._**

**_Your drive and potential for action comes directly from the enormous depth of strength you have. Staying focused on your interests and not allowing yourself to be derailed or distracted  
is one of your challenges. You are gifted with a deep need to focus and pay attention to fine details, patterns, and synchronicities, which feeds your fascination in the fields of science, research, mathematics, music, art, and leadership._**

**_Ones are often blamed for having control issues, but actually they can focus so intensely on what they’re interested in that they just don’t know how to let go. The number one agreement finds combined creativity and confidence as an important expression vital to the path. Creativity and innovation require willingness to be on the cutting edge of originality; this means being, acting, and often feeling different._**

**_Most ones have an intrinsic and different way of looking at and experiencing life. They focus on that which is unique. They may manifest this quality as early as infancy or as late as middle age._**

**_The summit of the mountain path for the number one is a joyful, passionate, and confident expression of personal magnetism and productivity that borders on magic.  
They excel in any form of work that involves some form of healing and creativity. At the highest levels, they become a pure and non-resistant channel, a clear conduit through which an unlimited amount of creativity flows into the world._**

# EXPRESSION MASTER NUMBER 44        EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/01/29/expression-master-number-44-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**EXPRESSION NUMBERS**

**_The arithmancy of our birth names is the process in numerology of assigning a numeric calculation value to each letter of the alphabet. Our birth certificate names are as important as our birth dates. We decode the specific meanings within our names through the dynamic process of arithmancy._**

**_Some people think that because our birth dates and birth names are chosen for us—as in planned cesarean births and the names that generally our parents settle on—there may not be anything sacred about these them, but the ancients believe that nothing is random._**

**Meaning of the Consonants in Our Names**

**_The personality or expression number is the arithmancy of the consonants in one’s birth certificate name. Our expressions define how we bring the heart’s desire into manifestation in the material world. The vowels maintain the fluidity of our names, and the consonants are the forms by which the vowels are expressed._**

**_The personalities are like the clothes we wear; they protect us, define us, or both. Personas are complements to the inner aspects of our selves. They portray our personal style and behaviors and how we imagine and present ourselves to the world on both the conscious and the unconscious levels._**

**_Our expressions describe learned behaviors and how we use them to express our essential selves. Our personas are built from experience, which is feedback the universe gives us about our choices, feelings, thoughts, words, and actions. This is especially important in the analysis of how present we are in the process of creating our destinies._**

**_Our heart’s desire numbers are the essences of our true selves, and our personality numbers are the frequencies at which we choose the world to view us. These are our full expressions of being humans in the physical form. They are how we protect, express, and manifest our destiny._**

**_Once we understand the essences of these frequencies, we appreciate the magic and source of power used to influence the outside world and evaluate the gifts and talents used when expressing our creativity._**

**_The personality or expression number is the initial vibration that people, animals, environments, plants, and spirits pick up from us organically. It is the base energy they use to psychically tell whether we are authentic about who we are, what we are doing, and our true intentions. If we are not in alignment with these frequencies, they will sense it, and something will just feel off._**

**_These are our energetic personality blueprints, and when we are in integrity with the vibrations we emit, our auras strengthen, expand, and become brighter. People, animals, and the environment around us will feel invited, interested, and attracted. They will trust, feel safe around, and open up to us naturally._**

**CALCULATING YOUR EXPRESSION NUMBER**

**The Expression number is the sum total of the consonants in a name. Reduce the total to a single digit unless it is a Master Number. Use the arithmancy conversion chart below. The letter Y is used as a consonant except when it is the first letter in a person’s first or last name, such as Yolanda, Yvon, or Yvette. The letter Y is considered a vowel if there are no other vowels in the name, such as Bly or Flynn.**

* * *

**JOHN EVANS DOE/ 1+8+5+4+5+1+4= 28 (2+8=10) TOTAL=1**

**A J S – 1  
B K T – 2  
C L U – 3  
D M V – 4  
E N W – 5  
F O X – 6  
G P Y – 7  
H Q Z – 8  
I R – 9**

**EXPRESSION MASTER NUMBER 44/8**

**This number is the vibration of self-discipline, abundance, and success through balance. Balancing between the two worlds— family/work, spirit/Earth, emotions/logic—forty-fours need to build a strong foundation in each of these areas. Balancing issues come up around the number eight, and the number forty-four is about business building and how it can be related to benefit the present and the future generations.**

**The master number forty-four/eight is known for magnificence and manifestation. It is a master architect and alchemist whose leadership skills can transform an idea and structure into a powerful and life-altering accomplishment. The lesson of the forty-four is to go beyond the hard work of the mundane and to see each moment as a creative challenge. The obstacle to push through might be perfectionism in order to gain humility.**

**Forty-four are hard-working, disciplined, systematic, professional, trustworthy, and composed both physically and mentally. They are deeply spiritual, wise, and inspirational to many people. They have the power of dream materialization and can break the chains of the material world by lifting the etheric veils to see reality. You have extraordinary talent for organization and envisioning complex and unreachable ideas but are fully capable of following through with your ideas. Not only can they foresee and implement what is needed to create something monumental; they also want that bigger picture to help humankind in a big way. They are insightful like the eleven, creative like the twenty-two, nurturing like the thirty-three, plus they refuse to be intimidated by any challenges along their path.**

**The superpower of the master number forty-four is in enterprise and business toward the path of sacred order. You have the ability of attracting resources in perfect harmony with nature and our environment. I envision you as a pure electrical current of energy balancing commodities in the perfect flow of giving and receiving.**

**Your expression is one of strength, matter manipulation, and forward thinking with incredible inner strength and the power to manifest with precision in the outside world. You get intuitive insight from a source beyond the physical world. Your inspiration thrives from the systematic sacred order of the Universe, and this includes the planetary elements, seasons, and the angelic realm. # SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER THREE   WITH EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/04/30/soul-life-path-number-three-with-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**Your Soul Life Path is ignited by the heartbeat of the eternal drum of life the moment we are born. The drum is symbolic of the circle of life representing vitality, wholeness, completion, wheel of life, perfection, the sacred void, Alpha & Omega, the ouroboros of reincarnation, the infinite representation of Source. and although it is beyond time and space, the closest we can imagine being present within this circle would be a feeling of unconditional love.**

 **The fifth dimension is a state of unconditional love and light that some would refer to as nirvana. This is your natural state of being, without the concept of time and space.** 

**The personified energetic blueprint you create through the birthing process is called your resonance frequency. It is your life path and the vibration the Universe recognizes to spark the fires of your living breath, burning a path that forges and sets the direction for your life’s mission.**

**I believe that we all were originally born out of the center of this sacred zero and decided to experience and express life through the numeric vibrations of our birth dates and names.**

**Everything involving numbers starts and ends with the number zero.  Each number has its own frequency, with defining qualities, personalities, characteristics, and potential,  but we were all meant to ascend back to the comfort of this defining zero at the end of our journey, and for some of us, it has taken many, many lifetimes.**

**Your soul path describes the direction your life will take, what challenges you will encounter, and the opportunities you will come across. It tells you what your life journey will look like and how you connect with the outside world. The life path and the numbers derived from it (soul urge and achievement numbers) represent the traits and talents you were born with. There are magnetic forces that draw to you various vibrations, events, and circumstances throughout your life, and all of these are influenced by your soul life path number.**

**Every numeric Path has a unique energy pattern that embodies your identity and is represented through symbols, images, or the personal logo of our soul. It is called an archetype. On a psychological, emotional, and spiritual level, we are all multidimensional beings and these archetypes make it easier for your guides and angels to work with you.  When you tap into your signature archetype, you trigger your imagination, the realm between time and space, which becomes the sacred meeting grounds between the worlds.** 

**Your Soul Life Path is your resonant frequency. It is the vibration you signal to the Universe to attract and deliver everything that you need to develop your own archetype or Inner Hero and become the best version of yourself moving forward.  Your “Inner Hero” is your higher-self beckoning you toward your true calling in life, your purpose and reason why you are here Now and nobody else can hear this voice but you because it is your calling and meant for your ears only.** 

**There is a Universal sacred order to life. It requires that you walk your authentic path before you pursue your life purpose. When you are on the right path, it ultimately leads you to your purpose.  Your job is to make sure you are in alignment with the right path designated specifically for you**..

**CALCULATING YOUR SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER**

 **Your soul path is the sum total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit** **unless it is a Master Number of 11, 22, 33, 44 …**

**There are several ways to calculate your Soul Life Path Number but the basic way I teach is to add your day, month and year.**

**See Example.**

**MAY 31, 1963 IS SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER 1**

**31** **DAY OF BIRTH**

         **5** **MONTH OF BIRTH**

**1963** **YEAR OF BIRTH**

**TOTAL = 1999 = 1+9+9+9= 28  add 2+8=10 = 1**

**SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER THREE**

**_Life Path 3 is typically seen as a lucky and powerful number and is symbolic of success, intuition, and good fortune. It embodies the divine principle that underlines all life and represents the triangle symbolizing the synergistic sacred current of the trinity such as birth, life and death/ beginning, middle and end/ past, present, and future/ body, mind, and spirit._**

**It facilitates the highest expression of divinity.** 

 **_In Egyptian Numerology, the number three comes in the form of “Divine Messenger,” it is the energy of expression used by the Angels, Guides, & Ascended Masters to communicate with us via the power of the “Three’s” such as the triple number sequence. 111, 222, 333 etc.. The angels use the number three to strengthen their bond with humanity. There is always a conjuring of magic when the number three is being presented within the language of creativity._**

 **_The number three is a lighthearted, easy-going, loving, and creative energy. It encourages us to express ourselves, speak our truth, and engage in self-loving activities._** 

**_With your acute sensitivity and empathy, you are an endless channel of creative energy along with the ability to express yourself through various art forms.  The number three energy carries pure passion from the sun and is a continuous current of light representing expansion, expression, and communication._**

**_Three also relates to giving outwardly, to openness and optimism. It inspires your sensitivity, intuition, empathic nature, and psychic abilities and demands that you experience your gifts on a deep and intimate level while expressing them creatively through the feelings of joy… and then share them with the outside world._** 

**_When connected to a Higher Source, Archangel Gabriel uses the energy of the number three as a conduit or portal to deliver inspiration through the use of your imagination and verbal or nonverbal expressions._**

# DESTINY NUMBER 8           EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/02/23/destiny-number-8-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**Your destiny number describes your potential natural talents and abilities using the numerology arithmancy gathered from the total of the vowels and consonants given at birth, taken from your birth certificate name, and reduced to a single-digit number, unless it is a master number of eleven through ninety-nine.  
Your name has to do with the ways and reasons you project what you do into the world. The various ways we present ourselves in the world are shown by expression, and the choices we make are the aspects of our lives that we can use to mold our futures.  
Your name is your power of choice. The right words define your level of knowledge and experience. They are the keys that open the doors to the life you desire. Words are a control system for our own personal magic. The most powerful word in your personal universe is your name.**

**The power to create the future you want lies within you, and through the knowledge of power in your name, you’ll learn some keys that can help unlock your inner magic.  
Your destiny number embraces the truth of what you came here to do through the power of your heart’s desire number. We want to look at this number and discover the hidden passions,  
talents, and abilities that affect your world and how it is working for you now or how it can work for you in the future.  
Your personality number is your outward expression of yourself and how the world perceives you. It reflects what you are portraying back to you. How do you see yourself and the world  
around you? Are you using your abilities to your highest potential or are you attracting fear, negativity, and darkness? This number plays an important role in your destiny and demands that you stay in integrity with the highest frequency possible in order to conduct yourself in alignment with your destiny.  
Because your destiny is a combination of your heart’s desire number and your expression number, whenever you have a question about the authenticity of your ultimate path in life, look first at these two numbers and check to see if you are serving them in their highest frequency. Your destiny number will only be productive if you are being honest in your heart and showing the world who you truly are.**

**CALCULATING YOUR DESTINY NUMBER**

**The Destiny number is the sum total of the vowels and consonants in your Birth name. Reduce the total to a single digit unless it is a Master Number. Use the arithmancy conversion chart below. The letter Y is used as a consonant except when it is the first letter in a person’s first or last name, such as Yolanda, Yvon, or Yvette. The letter Y is considered a vowel if there are no other vowels in the name, such as Bly or Flynn.**

**EXAMPLE: SANDRA LEE SMITH – Sandra = 1+1+5+4+9+1= 21 (2+1) =3**

**Lee – 3+5+5= 13 (1+3) =4**

**Smith = 1+4+9+2+8 = 24 (2+4) = 6**

**ADD 3+4+6=13 (1+3)=4**

**TOTAL DESTINY NUMBER = 4**

**A J S – 1  
B K T – 2  
C L U – 3  
D M V – 4  
E N W – 5  
F O X – 6  
G P Y – 7  
H Q Z – 8  
I R – 9**

**DESTINY NUMBER 8**

_**You will learn to harness your creative flow and move into harmony with all your open resources. In order to receive, you must give—and give generously. It is paramount and essential to gain self-discipline at a young age when learning to harness your inner abundance. You must know that the power that flows through you is not actually you but a gift from Higher Source. If you use your electric current of energy with clear intentions and integrity—especially with the spoken word—to access your resources, you will manifest the kind of power that will bring,healing energy to our human, animal, and elemental world. This is your highest destiny.**_

**_Eights need to experience inner abundance, power, and respect before they can build and manifest those qualities in the outside world. They are born with a natural source of wisdom and need to be in integrity with the spoken word—as well as money, authority, and fame—and they must avoid any kind of abuse in these areas. Those working this vibration need to develop the attitude, skill, and confidence to understand the laws of material success, such as the fair balance of energy exchange. When they make service the center of their lives, sharing money, energy, and wisdom as freely as they are able, they embrace their life destiny in the most positive sense, combining money and worldly power with the power of the heart._**

_**The loops in the eight are like a hose; if it is kinked or blocked, the flow of energy will back  
up and work against you rather than for you. If we look at the two loops upright, the bottom circle symbolizes humans/Earth linked to the spirit/heaven, acting as a direct channel from spirit to humans, and vice versa. The destiny of the number eight is all about staying fluid by learning to set clear intentions and finding your inner abundance. The outside world is only a reflection of what is happening,on the inside of you .**_

_**Eights are like a steel rod from the earth to the sky in a lightning storm. They have the ability to access pure electrical energy when they remain open and flowing, which allows them to create. The cycle of karma, that you receive what you give, is what the number eight is here to learn and once understood and implemented, it naturally grants the eight abundance.**_

_**At the higher qualities, eight’s feel the inherent abundance of life, of nature, and of spirit … and feel moved to share with others. Their sense of immense power or control changes to gratitude and loving surrender to a higher authority and higher power as manifested in the intricate intelligence and web of life as it unfolds.**_

# SOUL LIFE PATH NINE EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/09/10/soul-life-path-nine-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**FREE E-BOOK AVAILABLE NOW!**

**“INTRODUCTION TO EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY” on my Website @ [http://www.egyptiannumerology.org](http://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

**Your Soul Life Path is ignited by the heartbeat of the eternal drum of life the moment you are born. The drum is symbolic of the circle of life representing vitality, wholeness, completion, wheel of life, perfection, the sacred void, Alpha & Omega, the ouroboros of reincarnation, the infinite representation of Source. And although it is beyond time and space, the closest we can imagine being present within this circle would be a feeling of unconditional love.**

 **The fifth dimension is a state of unconditional love and light that some would refer to as nirvana. This is your natural state of being, without the concept of time and space.** 

**The personified energetic blueprint you create through the birthing process is called your resonance frequency. It is your life path and the vibration the Universe recognizes to spark the fires of your living breath, burning a path that forges and sets the direction for your life’s mission.**

**I believe that we all were originally born out of the center of this sacred zero and decided to experience and express life through the numeric vibrations of our birth dates and names.**

**Everything involving numbers starts and ends with the number zero.  Each number has its own frequency, with defining qualities, personalities, characteristics, and potential,  but we were all meant to ascend back to the comfort of this defining zero at the end of our journey, and for some of us, it has taken many, many lifetimes.**

**Your Soul Life Path describes the direction your life will take, what challenges you will encounter, and the opportunities you will come across. It tells you what your life journey will look like and how you connect with the outside world. The life path and the numbers derived from it (soul urge and achievement numbers) represent the traits and talents you were born with. There are magnetic forces that draw to you various vibrations, events, and circumstances throughout your life, and all of these are influenced by your soul life path number.**

**Every numeric Path has a unique energy pattern that embodies your identity and is represented through symbols, images, or the personal logo of our soul. It is called an archetype. On a psychological, emotional, and spiritual level, we are all multidimensional beings and these archetypes make it easier for your guides and angels to work with you.  When you tap into your signature archetype, you trigger your imagination, the realm between time and space, which becomes the sacred meeting grounds between the worlds.** 

**Your Soul Life Path is your resonant frequency. It is the vibration you signal to the Universe to attract and deliver everything that you need to develop your own archetype or Inner Hero and become the best version of yourself moving forward.  Your “Inner Hero” is your higher-self beckoning you toward your true calling in life, your purpose and reason why you are here. Nobody else can hear this voice but you because it is your calling and meant for your ears only.** 

**There is a Universal sacred order to life. It requires that you walk your authentic path before you pursue your life purpose. When you are on the right path, it ultimately leads you to your purpose.  Your job is to make sure you are in alignment with the right path designated specifically for you**..

**CALCULATING YOUR SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER**

 **Your soul path is the total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit unless it is a Master Number of 11, 22, 33, 44 …**

**There are several ways to calculate your Soul Life Path Number but the basic way I teach is to add your day, month and year.**

**SEE EXAMPLE**

**MAY 31, 1963 IS SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER 1**

**31** **DAY OF BIRTH**

         **5** **MONTH OF BIRTH**

**1963** **YEAR OF BIRTH**

**TOTAL = 1999 = 1+9+9+9= 28  add 2+8=10 = 1**

**SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER NINE**

**_Life Path number nine points to a life of fulfillment.  Wisdom, self-examination, enlightenment, and achieving higher consciousness. These are all qualities associated with number nine. It is connected to one’s higher purpose and ultimate life mission; this number encourages you to take a bird’s eye view of your life._**

**_Egyptian Numerology recognizes the number 9 as a walker of integrity and light. It is the vibration of the light warrior and their true source of power comes from receiving the sacred initiation of forgiveness and compassion through completing their souls journey._** 

**_The number nine relates to wisdom and responsibility, and their ultimate goal is to serve humanity. This vibration has come to serve the world and make it a better place for all to live in. They look for solutions in the form of inspiration, intuition, and creativity. They are psychic, sensitive, and thoughtful people who understand other people’s experiences because they have gone through many challenges and are equipped to offer empathy, support, love, and encouragement._** 

**_The energy of the number nine carries a visionary and insightful path into the Universal higher laws of life and self-mastery.  It is often the path of the Priestess, Priest, Shaman, and the Druid._**

**_When nine appear in your path, you have come to earn a completion. This is why forgiveness, compassion, integrity, justice, higher wisdom, and selfless service may have been important to you. They are all tools needed for your ascension to the next level of your existence._**

 **_Being a wounded healer may be necessary for you to overcome challenges you consented to before your birth. You have a tendency to be a recluse or entertain a hermit lifestyle mainly because inherently you don’t want to accumulate more drama/karma. Those who walk the path of the number nine gift the world with sage wisdom and incredible kindness, reminding us that by allowing our own divine light to shine, we can change the world._**

**1963** **YEAR OF BIRTH**

**TOTAL = 1999 = 1+9+9+9= 28  add 2+8=10 = 1**

**SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER FIVE**

**This Life Path number seeks adventure and freedom. It is a very sensual number and reminds us to enjoy life, try new experiences, and seek out pleasure. This number is also connected to experiencing life changes _(such as marriage, divorce, new jobs_) and making important choices. In Egyptian Numerology, the Number Five works with Spirit through transformation using the rising of the Phoenix and Fire healing energy to transmute lead into gold meaning transposing our challenges into possibilities.** 

**Motivation burns like a fire in your soul and can create restlessness deep down in your subconscious, leaving you with a sense of urgency when it is not directed. Transformation is also a fire element and a friend to the number five who takes the time to learn how to activate its powers. You are highly intuitive and wise and with all of your talents, we may find you in the occupation of being a healer, artist, or teacher.**

**You express yourself best through the movement of energy. You are often blessed with numerous talents and abilities and have the potential to sustain a couple of careers at once. Number five individuals have the ability to adapt and change freely, as they are free spirits who have a sense of adventure and curiosity about life. They have the desire to expand their horizons and gain insights into the lifestyles of other cultures, as they have a talent for finding a common ground with nearly everyone they meet and are easy-going.**

**This energy is commonly blamed for implusiveness which could appear to be a negative quality, but when I axamined it closer, I found that people who are under the influence of this quick moving energy are just acutely intuitve and don’t require going through the necessary channels that the majorty of us do when making decisions. Those that do own this frequency, their actions are based on an “inner-knowing” or better known as the gift of Clair-cognizance and are often not encouraged to acknowledge and practice their gift freely. _They just know and they know that they know!_ The best thing you can do to support a Life Path number five is to encourage them to follow their inner guidance and don’t judge them for exicuting their natural impulses when it comes to making a decision.**

**In astrology, the number five is an earth element under the influence of Taurus but in Egyptian Numerology, we recognize the _“Spirit”_ element which is under the influence of this Soul Life Path Number.** **Number five is the Spirit element of Aether. When Aether is your Spirit Element, it gives you access to all 4 elements and the gift of transformation.**

**Observing the synchronicity of Number five having 5 letters and the word Fire also contains 5 letters.** **Number five is also called the “Human” Number because of its relationship to our body: 5 fingers in each hand and 5 toes on each foot. We have 2 legs, 2 arms and a head which equals 5 limbs and we have 5 physical senses: sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch.**

**When I first started studying the meaning within the frequencies of numbers, the five appeared to be the most mis-understood of all the numbers. Commonly known in Numerology for the properties of change, adaptation, movement and travel, in Egyptian Numerology, I found this number to have fire energy. When I tuned into this frequency, I kept tapping into the phoenix rising out of the ashes which gave it the gift and abilities of transformation and transmutation. This is a rare commodity to have and is developed by individuals that have healing qualities and practice the art of alchemy.**

**Five energy can feel like a tornado of energy. Untamed, ferocious and sometimes destructive. If you can learn to be in the eye of the tornado, you are able to contact your Higher Self for guidance. You won’t be productive if you get swept up in chaos but if you remain calm and centered, you can harness your intuition and move forward with grace and ease.**

**One last message from the Number Five is Personal Freedom.** **Speak your Truth without the fear of being judged. Allowing yourself to pursue your dreams or even to experience appreciation without attachment.** **Whatever it means to you, explore the direction of personal freedom. Follow where it leads you and express yourself uninhibited** **and dare to search out unfounded territory within yourself. Break some boundaries, tear down some walls and challenge yourself to reach new goals.** **You are never too old to learn something new or undo something old that doesn’t fit you anymore**

# MANIFEST TRUE LOVE – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2024/02/14/manifest-true-love/#content)

**VISIT EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY WEBSITE @ [www.egyptiannumerology.org](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

**TWIN FLAMES, SOUL MATES, SOUL TRIBES**

**The hearts desire is a vibration, an energy, and frequency of absolute love that heralds the birth of a new consciousness and a new earth for all who are currently on this planet.** 

**The essence to unite with your twin flame is a hot topic on our planet today. It follows a natural stage in your spiritual development.** 

**As humanity moves into higher dimensions of light, the dream and comforts of the heart are to align with true love. This soul inspired decision is evolving and becoming undeniably stronger.** 

**This burning desire for love is an organic process of soul expansion, the evolutional desire for more light, and action towards enlightenment, both on an individual and collective level.** 

**When you integrate closer to your light body, you may feel the desire to share your love with someone on a higher plane.** 

**This Twin Flame search becomes a magnetic quest to connect sacred souls regardless of different continents, genders,  age, and all stages of life. The established placement of true love brings together unique moments of simplicity, elegance, power,  and of course unconditional love.** 

**I am often asked about the nature of twin flame relationships, how they meet, how they attract, the purpose of their union, and how they align with each other in the complexity of 3D – 5D life. The most frequent question is how do you free yourself from loneliness and separation caused by settling for mutual karmic unions (?)**

**These are all good questions!** 

**How do you merge closer with your destined partner and maintain alignment with Source? True love, twin hearts, Soul mates, rising higher into the light.** 

**As significant as it is to find your twin soul, it is not done by seeking it, looking back, looking around, or by wishing to find it in every person you encounter that holds your interest.** 

**No, it will not manifest as a result of wishful thinking. It happens through the mutual attraction of love, and most of all cultivating self~love. And this is the key to manifesting and attracting your twin soul.** 

**It is difficult to unite with a true love without great, authentic,  and strong self-love. It comes into manifestation with pure sacred resonance, and high vibration, in fact, the reality of this relationship is very simple.** 

**Come to terms that another person or master, can only love you to the extent that you are open to loving yourself.  This means that if there are aspects of yourself that remain in the shadows and you refrain from loving, it will be equally difficult for you to feel the love offered by someone other than your self because you don’t have the capacity to acknowledge it.** 

**People that you encounter are without a doubt, a reflection of your own divinity, including the shadow parts of yourself that you refuse to acknowledge and embrace.** 

**Everyone you meet is your mirror of the Divine, so if there is harmony in the relationship, it means that others are reflecting their own harmony. If there is disharmony in the relationship and you desire to rectify,  always look at the disharmony within yourself first.** 

**This is the same process we will find on a global and collective level; fear based elements of disharmony, chaos, and even wars on our planet are a direct reflection and result of disharmony and chaos within ourselves, within each individuals.** 

**If you look through your minds eye at our planet earth and envision the desire of peace, feel first the manifestation of serenity within yourself. If you want to end poverty and suffering, you must eliminate the sense of scarcity and fear within yourself.** 

**Yes, embrace abundance and manifest this organically within yourself. This is the path and dance to awaken great self-love within yourself.** 

**Love yourself and create new openings of love, for love, with love. Feel your own essence and ignite your own radiance.**

**Prepare yourself for deep love by walking quietly through your day and begin to notice, see, feel, and even taste the many rainbow colors of divinity that surrounds you. Open your heart to gratitude for everything in your life, even the challenging dilemmas that present themselves to support change for your highest good.** 

**This activity cultivates love within your heart and has a magnetic effect on the people around you. It is the manifestation of this love within yourself that begins to attract romance,  your dream partner, your twin soul, and other masters looking for an opportunity to serve you, or who are seeking guidance, support, cooperation, and healing.** 

**We can also call this process a journey into your superconscious, a journey to awaken the Christ consciousness within you, and evolving towards your personal ascension.** 

**The attraction and manifestation of your twin soul is the same as your journey into Christ consciousness, or in simple terms- into enlightenment. There is no separation, it is the same path.**

 **Imagine what it would be like to love yourself absolutely, to endure  all aspects of yourself and surrender to your inner light, inner love and let that feeling, that love, expand to encompass everything?**

**If you have been traveling on this path for quite some time , you may agree that Love has changed its frequency, its vibration because we have been moving  from unconditional love to absolute love. Your belief systems have been evolving  towards absolute love and the power and force behind this transformation  is felt both individually and collectively.** 

**This is all part of building the Christ consciousness or enlightenment on this planet.** 

**Many of you undoubtedly see the effects of this power moving in your lives as manifestation of miracles happening around you, to people you know, and the root phase of this development, is none other than love.** 

**If you want to manifest true love, to attract something wonderful into your life, something beyond your imagination, focus on this. Open yourselves to love, be love, contemplate it, feel it, and make room for it to dance within.** 

**Create room for it to guide and heal you and not just you, share it with others. When you share your love, your light, it has a profound effect on those you connect with.** 

**This higher awareness of love will begin to move the hearts and minds of many people. This part of the great plan that mother/ father Source of all creation,  the powerful presence of I Am, has in store for us.** 

**As we  ascend into higher levels of consciousness together some partnerships will change … people break up, others grow closer. It is all part of the natural transformation of consciousness to higher levels of light.** 

**As you fall deeply in love with yourself, when you are enchanted by your authentic nature, even dazzled by your brilliance and in awe over your magnificence, the true colors of your inner self will materialize and you will care less whether you are with your true love or not.** 

**There will be less striving for outside love and having to be together no order to be happy. The less striving, the less anxiety, the less seeking, and the less need for it to be in your life, the more likely it is to happen.** 

**You become so enchanted by life, its simplicity, the beauty and power of it all, the love of love, that before you know it, your twin soul will appear. It will be led to you and it will find you precisely because of this love you behold, this light and love shining in your heart.** 

**This effortless process results in true love coming into your life, or any other thing you desire and wish for. Any fantasy of imagination that is close to your heart can be manifested in this way. Through love, through desire, and through focusing on the light in your life.** 

**Look closely at your alter ego, your mind, and observe the games, habits, and routines that  may have prevented or inhibited you from loving yourself. Remove them from your daily life including behaviors, actions, and words, let them go. Replace them with ones that serve your higher self.** 

**Don’t overcomplicate your life. The less complexity, the more simplicity and  power you have, the easier it will be for you to attract and keep love. Know that this feeling you have in your heart, the dream of love, of being together, of sharing, of joining your heart to this one person is also a dream, and desire of your twin soul.** 

**If your twin flame is in the same incarnation with you, he/ she is also moving towards the light, towards love. If you are attracted to certain places, certain areas of creativity, your twin soul will follow a similar direction, a similar path.** 

**If you are attracted to a continent, a particular mountain, a village or even a river, your twin soul feels a similar attraction to those particular places.** 

**When you love yourself absolutely without any limitations or reservations, you will find new paths, new possibilities within you.** 

**The colors around your energy field,  your vibration and frequency will transform, change, becoming higher and brighter.** 

**As your frequency rises and becomes higher, your ability to attract also increases, like a magnet it becomes stronger.** 

We are talking about the light but also about the cosmic intelligence, omnipresent and omnipotent, seeing everything. The light knows what I want, the light sees your desires, your dreams. The truth is there is nothing that the light doesn’t know, so the basic premise is that we simply follow the light and it prepares everything for us, even before we arrive and every time you experience a sacred encounter.

Every time you experience love in a relationship , a miracle, or wonderful harmony, it was all prepared for you by the light before you came into this incarnation. So, you could say that the essence of manifesting a twin soul is to follow your intuitive compass and allow the light to guide you. 

**_Blessings, Sara_**

# MASTER NUMBER 44 LIFE PATH EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2023/05/02/master-number-44-life-path-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**FREE E-BOOK AVAILABLE NOW**!

**“INTRODUCTION TO EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY” on my Website @ [http://www.egyptiannumerology.org](http://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)
**

**MASTER NUMBERS INTRODUCTION**

**Master Numbers have a sojourn quite different from those of the rest of the population. Their path is called a wounded healer, and many will experience the journey of the dark night of the soul at least once in their lifetimes. In fact, in Egyptian numerology, there are specific past-life insights to all the numbers, but these distinct individuals incarnated to lift the consciousness of humankind through their unique and courageous soul-life agreements.**

**Egyptian numerology lives under the premise that we all made a contract before birth to come into this lifetime to achieve specific goals and walk certain paths, and this information can be decoded through the number frequencies given in our birth dates and names. Under this theory, we chose these specific number vibrations to be born through and all the karmic hardships in our lifetimes so we could overcome these difficulties and help heal the world in qualified areas.**

**All master numbers are endowed with many powers from within, significant strengths, and many more challenges than other numbers. People with these numbers normally realize early in life that they have the capacity to accomplish a great deal with relatively little effort.**

**They contain superpowers hidden within the the numbers and are here to obtain personal power and spiritual evolution and, most of all, to be healers for the wounded through their own personal transformations. They will undergo the difficulties and challenges that only a true spiritual warrior and devotional disciple of higher wisdom could ever dream of combating in one lifetime.**

**People who carry the frequencies of master numbers may experience exceptionally painful, turbulent childhoods and must use these experiences to create a better world because of it and not despite it.**

**If anything, the path of master numbers is more karmic than others because they often must transcend more difficulties than other numbers to excel in the first place. As many of them are original thinkers, they often end up working alone or find themselves in a position to defend ideas against a hostile majority. They deal with obstacles that daunt the stoutest of hearts.**

**Only advanced souls with high spiritual directives choose to be born under these powerful frequencies. Our higher selves, angels, and spirit guides would never allow us to be born under these commanding forces unless convinced that we have the experience, stamina, foresight, and ability to use our potential wisely and for the highest good of all involved.**

**The true power of these numbers lies in the magic of transformation because when they transmute their challenges, they automatically raise the consciousness of the masses. Energetically and on a collective consciousness level, when one person heals from these experiences, it helps to heal hundreds of thousands of victims still held hostage by their  
suffering, fears, inner demons, and conflicts. Therefore, it is considered one of the highest honors given to human existence.**

**Past-life healing and soul awareness let you evolve faster when you heal the wounds that are constantly repeating while moving through this life with more guidance and understanding. That is powerful! In one lifetime, you hold the power to heal hundreds of past, current, and future versions of yourself. Not only that, but in healing yourself and breaking patterns, you release your ancestors and children from suffering these patterns and repair the world in the process.**

**This is literally one of the most profound conditions you are all here to accomplish. You are here to awaken to this potentiometer, clear these lives, and birth a new earth—a place where people are raised in love, awareness, healing, and soul. The beginning of your real-life utopia, new earth, and the salvation of humanity always starts with yourself.**

**CALCULATING YOUR SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER**

 **Your soul path is the total of your birth date, birth month, and birth year reduced to a single digit unless it is a Master Number of 11, 22, 33, 44 …**

**There are several ways to calculate your Soul Life Path Number but the basic way I teach is to add your day, month and year.**

**SEE EXAMPLE**

**MAY 31, 1963 IS SOUL LIFE PATH NUMBER 1**

**31** **DAY OF BIRTH**

         **5** **MONTH OF BIRTH**

**1963** **YEAR OF BIRTH**

**TOTAL = 1999 = 1+9+9+9= 28  add 2+8=10 = 1**

**SOUL LIFE PATH MASTER NUMBER 44**

**The superpower of the master number forty-four is in enterprise and business toward the path of sacred order. You have the ability of attracting resources in perfect harmony with nature and our environment.**

**I envision you as a pure electrical current of energy  
balancing commodities in the perfect flow of giving and receiving. Your primary gift is in stability and correcting establishments that are corrupt by exposing truth, repairing injustice, and rebuilding sacred structure. You can bring natural order through communication, communities, and institutions.**

**With your ability of attracting accumulation, flow, and balance, your path will be to assist the world of business by bringing it into alignment with integrity. You have extraordinary talent for organization and envisioning complex and unreachable ideas but are fully capable  
of following through with your ideas. Forty-fours combine the strengths of the master numbers eleven, twenty-two, and thirtythree.**

**Not only can they foresee and implement what is needed to create something monumental; they also want that bigger picture to help humankind in a big way. They are insightful like the eleven, creative like the twenty-two, nurturing like the thirty-three, plus they refuse to be intimidated by any challenges along their path.**

**Forty-fours are hard-working, disciplined, systematic,  
professional, trustworthy, and composed both physically and mentally. They are deeply spiritual, wise, and inspirational to many people. It is believed that this number is working through the process of reincarnation and ending its cycle. They are here to help others and themselves advance to the next level of incarnation.**

**They have the power of dream materialization and can break the chains of the material world by lifting the veils to see reality. This number is the vibration of self-discipline, abundance, and success through balance. Balancing between the two worlds— family/work, spirit/Earth, emotions/logic—forty-fours need to  
build a strong foundation in each of these areas.**

**Balancing issues come up around the number eight, and the number forty-four is about business building and how it can be related to benefit the present and the future generations.**

**The master number forty-four/eight is known for magnificence and manifestation. It is a master architect and alchemist whose leadership skills can transform an idea and structure into a powerful and life-altering accomplishment.**

**The lesson of the fortyfour is to go beyond the hard work of the mundane and to see each moment as a creative challenge. The obstacle to push through might be perfectionism in order to gain humility.**

**

**WHAT IS A SOUL URGE NUMBER?**

**_Your Soul Urge Number in Egyptian Numerology is your exact Day of Birth. It is often referred to as your Character Number and reveals your Personality Traits, Souls Passion, and Character Behaviors._**

_**It works directly with your Soul Life Path Number by influencing challenges for you to overcome and encourages you to develop your gifts and talents.**_

_**This Number shows you what your Soul is Urging you to accomplish in this lifetime….**_

_**Your Soul Urge Number determines your natural gifts, abilities, and talents. It encourages you to turn your strongest challenges into your greatest strengths.**_

_**We never stop learning who we are and why we are here. The more we know about ourselves, the more we can develop our authentic nature and respect the fine**_ _**structure of infinite consciousness. Each soul urge number leads to an ability within us that needs to be explored, expanded, and expressed in our lifetime.**_ 

_**Our gifts, abilities, talents and potential outlined in our day of birth are just**_ _**the beginning clues to what we are capable of manifesting in our lifetime. Explore the meaning of your true nature and how you can develop your talents to support your life path.**_

**_This is the frequency you CREATE from._**

**Soul Urge Number 9**

**“HERMIT”**

**_Nurturing, Selfless, Healer, and Warrior_**

**_This is the energy for fulfillment, wisdom, self-examination, and higher consciousness. It is connected to your higher purpose and ultimate life mission._**

**_This frequency encourages you to take an expanded view of your life. Egyptian Numerology recognizes the number nine as a walker of integrity and light. Their true source of power comes through forgiveness and compassion._**

**_Integrity is in high regards with the number nine. It is the number of selfless service to others, and hermits walk the path of higher wisdom. They are leaders, healers, and light warriors with a strong impulse to help others. Their love for humanity runs as fierce as their dedication for true spiritual justice._**

**_The hermit is also the priest/priestess, shaman, and sage of our culture. They have a fierce loyalty towards justice and equality. Self awareness and spirituality are embedded in their path and helping others to achieve attainment goes hand in hand with their high standards and values._**

**LEARN MORE:**

In Egyptian Numerology, there are 3 major Numeric calculations from your Birth Date that reveals your innate gifts, talents, and potential. These specific attributes were chosen by you before birth to support you on your Soul Life Path and journey. When you discover, align, and develop these Super-Powers, you are on the road to becoming your very own Inner Hero. These powers are a part of you and will lay dormant until activated.

# DESTINY MASTER NUMBER ELEVEN    EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/03/10/destiny-master-number-eleven-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**Your destiny number describes your potential natural talents and abilities using the numerology arithmancy gathered from the total of the vowels and consonants given at birth, and reduced to a single-digit number, unless it is a master number of eleven through ninety-nine.  
Your name has to do with the ways and reasons you project what you do into the world. The various ways we present ourselves in the world are shown by expression, and the choices we make are the aspects of our lives that we can use to mold our futures.  
Your name is your power of choice. The right words define your level of knowledge and experience. They are the keys that open the doors to the life you desire. Words are a control system for our own personal magic and the most powerful word in your personal universe is your name.**

**The power to create the future you want lies within you, and through the knowledge of power in your name, you’ll learn some keys that can help unlock your inner magic.  
Your destiny number embraces the truth of what you came here to do through the power of your heart’s desire number. We want to look at this number and discover the hidden passions,  
talents, and abilities that affect your world and how it is working for you now or how it can work for you in the future.**

**Your personality number is your outward expression of yourself and how the world perceives you. It reflects what you are portraying back to you. How do you see yourself and the world around you? Are you using your abilities to your highest potential or are you attracting fear, negativity, and darkness? This number plays an important role in your destiny and demands that you stay in integrity with the highest frequency possible in order to conduct yourself in alignment with your destiny.**

**Because your destiny is a combination of your heart’s desire number and your expression number, whenever you have a question about the authenticity of your ultimate path in life, look first at these two numbers and check to see if you are serving them in their highest frequency. Your destiny number will only be productive if you are being honest in your heart and showing the world who you truly are.**

**CALCULATING YOUR DESTINY NUMBER**

**The Destiny number is the sum total of the vowels and consonants in your Birth name. Reduce the total to a single digit unless it is a Master Number. Use the arithmancy conversion chart below. The letter Y is used as a consonant except when it is the first letter in a person’s first or last name, such as Yolanda, Yvon, or Yvette. The letter Y is considered a vowel if there are no other vowels in the name, such as Bly or Flynn.**

**EXAMPLE: SANDRA LEE SMITH – Sandra = 1+1+5+4+9+1= 21 (2+1) =3**

**Lee – 3+5+5= 13 (1+3) =4**

**Smith = 1+4+9+2+8 = 24 (2+4) = 6**

**ADD 3+4+6=13 (1+3)=4**

**TOTAL DESTINY NUMBER = 4**

**A J S – 1  
B K T – 2  
C L U – 3  
D M V – 4  
E N W – 5  
F O X – 6  
G P Y – 7  
H Q Z – 8  
I R – 9**

**DESTINY MASTER NUMBER 11**

**_You have already been living the powerful undercurrents of the master number eleven all your life, and as you mature, the higher frequencies become stronger. The electrical current will start to pulsate from spirit to your mind, down into your heart, and even enters your dreams with messages. In sacred geometry, the number eleven represents two pillars, a spiritual gateway, which opens a direct portal between (one energy) inspiration and (one energy) intuition, and when linked together, they create manifestation (eleven energy). Elevens usually had turbulent childhoods, but they are here to make the world a better place because of it and not despite it._**

**_The 11/2 path, purpose, and destiny are here to overcome the period in their lives referenced as the dark night of the soul, or the wounded healer, and to be in touch with the inspiration, imagination, and intuition that results from such defeats. You are to use these tenacious energies and creative powers to manifest magic in the world._**

**_You are the inspired healer, creative artist, and the spiritual catalyst of our world. Throughout life, elevens walk a path of spiritual enlightenment and inspire others with their strong  
intuitive and empathic abilities. They are the most intuitive of all the numbers and will understand the unique aspects of all the relationships with which they surround themselves. Many will live in the limelight and raise spiritual awareness because they are here to lift the frequency of the masses._**

**_You have the master number 11/2 as your destiny number. The energy of the number two will be dominant in your life until around the age of forty or older. The energy of the number eleven activates with maturity, but you would’ve felt these undercurrents all your life. It might make you feel as if you have a superpower bubbling up within you in the form of inspiration, ideas, and motivations._**

**_The number two vibration is about peace and connection. You can bring forces together into harmonious balance, creating a mutual bond. You are empathetic, compassionate, intuitive,  
loving, and understanding. Cooperation is also a word associated with the number two. You have the potential to be a master of duality and be able to see many sides of a single situation. This makes you a valuable asset in a group arena when mediation, guidance, or psychic reading is concerned. This frequency also holds the seed of creativity. You enliven dreams and awaken the imagination in yourself and in others. You can balance the inner imagination with outer realities, which makes both aspects more colorful and beneficial. The higher energy of the number two is about duality and creating balance in your life between the yin/yang and with the five elements: earth, water, fire, air, and ether._**

# DESTINY NUMBER NINE          EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2022/03/02/destiny-number-nine-egyptian-numerology/#content)

**Your destiny number describes your potential natural talents and abilities using the numerology arithmancy gathered from the total of the vowels and consonants given at birth, taken from your birth certificate name, and reduced to a single-digit number, unless it is a master number of eleven through ninety-nine.  
Your name has to do with the ways and reasons you project what you do into the world. The various ways we present ourselves in the world are shown by expression, and the choices we make are the aspects of our lives that we can use to mold our futures.  
Your name is your power of choice. The right words define your level of knowledge and experience. They are the keys that open the doors to the life you desire. Words are a control system for our own personal magic. The most powerful word in your personal universe is your name.**

**The power to create the future you want lies within you, and through the knowledge of power in your name, you’ll learn some keys that can help unlock your inner magic.  
Your destiny number embraces the truth of what you came here to do through the power of your heart’s desire number. We want to look at this number and discover the hidden passions,  
talents, and abilities that affect your world and how it is working for you now or how it can work for you in the future.  
Your personality number is your outward expression of yourself and how the world perceives you. It reflects what you are portraying back to you. How do you see yourself and the world  
around you? Are you using your abilities to your highest potential or are you attracting fear, negativity, and darkness? This number plays an important role in your destiny and demands that you stay in integrity with the highest frequency possible in order to conduct yourself in alignment with your destiny.  
Because your destiny is a combination of your heart’s desire number and your expression number, whenever you have a question about the authenticity of your ultimate path in life, look first at these two numbers and check to see if you are serving them in their highest frequency. Your destiny number will only be productive if you are being honest in your heart and showing the world who you truly are.**

**CALCULATING YOUR DESTINY NUMBER**

**The Destiny number is the sum total of the vowels and consonants in your Birth name. Reduce the total to a single digit unless it is a Master Number. Use the arithmancy conversion chart below. The letter Y is used as a consonant except when it is the first letter in a person’s first or last name, such as Yolanda, Yvon, or Yvette. The letter Y is considered a vowel if there are no other vowels in the name, such as Bly or Flynn.**

**EXAMPLE: SANDRA LEE SMITH – Sandra = 1+1+5+4+9+1= 21 (2+1) =3**

**Lee – 3+5+5= 13 (1+3) =4**

**Smith = 1+4+9+2+8 = 24 (2+4) = 6**

**ADD 3+4+6=13 (1+3)=4**

**TOTAL DESTINY NUMBER = 4**

**A J S – 1  
B K T – 2  
C L U – 3  
D M V – 4  
E N W – 5  
F O X – 6  
G P Y – 7  
H Q Z – 8  
I R – 9**

**DESTINY NUMBER 9**

**The Destiny of the number nine points to a life of fulfilment.  Wisdom, self-examination, enlightenment, and achieving higher consciousness are all qualities associated with number nine. It is connected to one’s higher purpose and ultimate life mission; this number encourages us to take a bird’s eye view of our lives.**

**Egyptian Numerology recognizes the number 9 as a walker of integrity and light. It is the vibration of the light warrior and their true source of power comes from receiving the sacred initiation of forgiveness and compassion through completing their souls journey.** 

**Your destiny is the road to completion. Leaving a legacy of** p**eace,** l**ove, and compassion is important, and humanitarian service is number one on your list of things to do in this lifetime. The number nine often leads to the path of forgiveness and in this search must  
fall into the corridors of the dark night of the soul. After retrieving light from a long haul of darkness, this frequency transforms into a** **light warrior and a true leader/healer for humankind to follow. Pain is often the touchstone to spiritual growth, and nobody knows this better than the path, purpose, and destiny of the number nine.**

**Being a wounded healer may be necessary for you to overcome challenges you consented to before your birth. You have a tendency to be a recluse or entertain a hermit lifestyle mainly because inherently you don’t want to accumulate more drama/karma. Those who walk the path of the number nine gift the world with sage wisdom and incredible kindness, reminding us that by allowing our own divine light to shine, we can change the world.**

**The number nine symbolizes sanctuary, contemplation, and self-awareness. This is the true destiny of the seeker, which eventually leads to ascension. Spirituality cannot abide stagnant  
water. You have unquenchable thirst and a desire to understand the greater mysteries in life. You have natural tendencies to look within and above for all the answers to the questions asked from the mundane world. Nature is often found as the ultimate teacher for this frequency. This is true not just for pure solitude reasons but also for the unlimited lessons the wilderness can provide.**

**Your destiny is one of selfless service and the humanitarian way. You use love and inspiration as a drive to solutions. You are visionaries, healers, psychics, and artists. You are spiritually here to hold space for the spiritual disciplines and the natural order of the universe. You are a protector of the environment, animal rights, and equality for all, and you intuitively know and respect** **the vibrations of all other numbers and are here to help and protect all people complete their cycles. You are here as sacred guardians**.

**The energy of the number nine carries a visionary and insightful path into the Universal higher laws of life and self-mastery.  It is often the path of the priestess, priest, shaman and the Druid.**

# EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY; SOUL URGE NUMBER TEN – Egyptian Numerology

[Skip to content](https://egyptiannumerology.blog/2020/01/03/egyptian-numerology-soul-urge-number-ten/#content)

[**VISIT EGYPTIAN NUMEROLOGY WEBSITE @ www.egyptiannumerology.org**](https://www.egyptiannumerology.org/)

**WHAT IS A SOUL URGE NUMBER?**

**_Your Soul Urge Number is your exact Day of Birth in Egyptian Numerology and is used to describe your Character Behavior, Souls Passion and Personality Traits. It is the chief instigator to your life’s challenges and is associated with your Soul Life Path Number. This frequency is what your Soul has been urging you to accomplish in this lifetime._**

**_I describe your Soul Urge as the whisper or breath of life entering your body the moment you are born. It is the frequency of who we are in Spirit manifesting vibrational form. This number shows how you view the world, affects how you think, and forms your unique perspectives._**

**_Understanding your Soul Urge helps you see the roles you play and why. When aligned with this vibration, you can avoid obstacles and begin to use your strengths. It is what makes you unique and rare in group settings and triggers how you behave or approach relationships in general._**

**_This number helps you create the direction of your Soul Life Path. It reveals how you bring your “Inner Light” to others to create beneficial and fulfilling relationships._**

**_This is the frequency we CREATE from!_**

**SOUL URGE NUMBER 10**

**“COMMUNITY LEADER**“

**_Independent, Sensitive, Strong, Expressive & Intuitive_**

**_With your abilities of strength, independence, and creativity, you can focus on activities that interest you and become involved in the process of manifesting your desires. Your tenacious willpower attracts the attention that your soul craves. The zero in the number ten brings you the qualities of sensitivity, expression, and intuition. This recipe is a magnet for your standing in our community as a leader._**

**_These people normally achieve great things in their lifetime. They can be fiercely independent and focused once they set their minds on something. They are deep thinkers and tenacious in their efforts at achieving their goals. They are strong willed, creative, and intelligent which allows them the gift of leadership when they learn to lead from the heart as opposed by their minds._**

_**The number ten represents completion: the ending of a cycle and the attainment of wholeness. It is both masculine and feminine and reflects the unity that is possible in partnerships once the fragmented pieces of your soul are integrated.**_

_**In Egyptian Numerology, the number ten represents Community Leadership and the attainment of high standing. It recognizes the integration of a higher source into lives that have elevated from duality and have entered the realm of all possibilities.**_

**LEARN MORE:**

In Egyptian Numerology, there are 3 major Numeric calculations from your Birth Date that reveals your innate gifts, talents, and potential. These specific attributes were chosen by you before birth to support you on your Soul Life Path and journey. When you discover, align, and develop these Super-Powers, you are on the road to becoming your very own Inner Hero. These powers are a part of you and will lay dormant until activated.
